FMA3710.name: vascular tree
FMA3710.text: Hollow tree, the organ parts of which are arteries, veins or lymphatic vessels and its lumen contains either blood or lymph. Anatomical type — Hollow tree organ: Organ with organ cavity, which consists of an arborizing set of tubular organ parts, the walls of which are continuous and surround a continuous lumen.

FMA3711.name: segment of artery
FMA3711.text: Regional segment of arterial tree is an arborial segment of arterial tree organ. Anatomical type — Segment of blood vessel tree organ: Organ segment which is regional part of blood vessel tree organ.

FMA3714.name: variant artery
FMA3714.text: Variant artery is an arterial tree.

FMA3726.name: anastomosis
FMA3726.text: Anastomosis is a zone of continuity. Anatomical type — Zone of continuity: Zone of connectivity where there is no bona fide boundary between some parts of two contiguous structures.

FMA3727.name: vascular anastomosis
FMA3727.text: Vascular anastomosis is an anastomosis. Anatomical type — Zone of continuity: Zone of connectivity where there is no bona fide boundary between some parts of two contiguous structures.

FMA3728.name: arterial anastomosis
FMA3728.text: Arterial anastomosis is a vascular anastomosis.

FMA3729.name: venous anastomosis
FMA3729.text: Venous anastomosis is a vascular anastomosis.

FMA3736.name: ascending aorta
FMA3736.text: Ascending aorta is a segment of thoracic aorta. It is a regional part of Aorta. It is continuous with Left ventricle and Arch of aorta.

FMA3768.name: arch of aorta
FMA3768.text: Arch of aorta is a segment of thoracic aorta. It is a regional part of Aorta. It is continuous with Descending aorta and Ascending aorta.

FMA3784.name: descending aorta
FMA3784.text: Descending aorta is a segment of aorta. It is a regional part of Aorta. It is continuous with Trunk of left common iliac artery, Trunk of right common iliac artery and Arch of aorta.

FMA3789.name: abdominal aorta
FMA3789.text: Abdominal aorta is a segment of aorta. It is a regional part of Descending aorta. It forms part of Content of abdomen. It is continuous with Thoracic aorta.

FMA3802.name: trunk of right coronary artery
FMA3802.text: Trunk of right coronary artery is a trunk of coronary artery. It is a regional part of Right coronary artery. It is continuous with Aorta. It belongs to Set of trunks of coronary arteries.

FMA3807.name: right conus artery
FMA3807.text: Branch of right coronary artery which runs over the anterior part of conus arteriosus and supplies the pulmonary conus and the upper part of right ventricle. It branches from Proximal portion of right coronary artery and Right coronary artery. It is a regional part of Right coronary artery. It supplies blood to Outflow part of right ventricle.

FMA3813.name: anterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery
FMA3813.text: Ventricular branch of right coronary artery which courses at nearly perpendicular to the trunk of the right coronary artery , curving upward and then downward to supply the anterior wall of right ventricle and the apex. It branches from Proximal portion of right coronary artery.

FMA3815.name: first anterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery
FMA3815.text: First anterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery is an anterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery. It branches from Right coronary artery. It is a regional part of Right coronary artery.

FMA3818.name: marginal branch of right coronary artery
FMA3818.text: Anterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery which runs downward along the the acute margin and supplies the anterior wall of right ventricle and the apex. It branches from Right coronary artery and Proximal portion of right coronary artery. It is a regional part of Right coronary artery. It supplies blood to Myocardial zone 10, Myocardial zone 20 and Myocardial zone 15, among other structures.

FMA3835.name: posterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery
FMA3835.text: Ventricular branch of right coronary artery which runs obliqually to the right upper and middle third of the posterior interventricular sulcus to supply the posterior wall of right ventricle. It branches from Distal portion of right coronary artery.

FMA3837.name: first posterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery
FMA3837.text: First posterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery is a posterior ventricular branch of right coronary artery. It branches from Right coronary artery and Distal portion of right coronary artery. It is a regional part of Right coronary artery.

FMA3840.name: posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery
FMA3840.text: Branch of right coronary artery which runs along the upper third of the posterior interventricular sulcus to supply the posterior wall of right and left ventricles and the posterior third of the interventricular septum. It branches from Right coronary artery. It is a regional part of Right coronary artery. It supplies blood to Right branch of atrioventricular bundle, Septal wall of left ventricle and Lateral wall of left ventricle, among other structures.

FMA3845.name: septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery
FMA3845.text: Septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery is a branch of right coronary artery. Anatomical type — Coronary artery: Systemic artery which supplies the heart.

FMA3847.name: first septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery
FMA3847.text: First septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery is a septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery. It branches from Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery.

FMA3848.name: second septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery
FMA3848.text: Second septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery is a septal branch of right posterior interventricular artery. It branches from Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery.

FMA3855.name: trunk of left coronary artery
FMA3855.text: Trunk of left coronary artery is a trunk of coronary artery. It is a regional part of Left coronary artery. It is continuous with Aorta. It belongs to Set of trunks of coronary arteries.

FMA3860.name: diagonal branch of anterior descending branch of left coronary artery
FMA3860.text: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the terminal end of the left coronary artery between the angle formed by the anterior interventricular branch and the circumflex branch of the left coronary artery and supplies the left ventricle. It branches from Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Myocardium of mid zone of left ventricle, Myocardium of left ventricle and Anterior wall of left ventricle, among other structures.

FMA3868.name: conus branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA3868.text: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the proximal part of the anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and crosses over the top of the conus arteriosus and the base of the anterior cusp of the pulmonary artery and supplies the outflow part of the right ventricle. It branches from Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Outflow part of right ventricle.

FMA3870.name: right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA3870.text: Anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the right side to supply the anterior wall of the right ventricle. It branches from Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle and Anterior wall of right ventricle.

FMA3872.name: first right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA3872.text: First right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery is a right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It branches from Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.

FMA3874.name: second right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA3874.text: Second right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery is a right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It branches from Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.

FMA3876.name: third right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA3876.text: Third right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery is a right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It branches from Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Proximal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.

FMA3892.name: septal branch of anterior interventricular artery
FMA3892.text: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which enters the muscular part of the interventricular septum. It branches from Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Distal portion of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Right branch of atrioventricular bundle.

FMA3895.name: circumflex branch of left coronary artery
FMA3895.text: Branch of left coronary artery which runs perpendicular to the anterior interventricular branch of the left coronary artery on the left side of the interventricular sulcus and supplies the left side of the heart. It branches from Left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Left atrium, Left ventricle and Myocardium of left atrium.

FMA3932.name: brachiocephalic artery
FMA3932.text: Brachiocephalic artery is a systemic artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum.

FMA3939.name: common carotid artery
FMA3939.text: Common carotid artery is a systemic artery. Anatomical type — Systemic artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which carries oxygenated blood from some heart.

FMA3941.name: right common carotid artery
FMA3941.text: Right common carotid artery is a common carotid artery. It branches from Brachiocephalic artery. It is a regional part of Brachiocephalic artery.

FMA3947.name: internal carotid artery
FMA3947.text: Subdivision of common carotid artery, each instance of which supplies some brain. It branches from Common carotid artery. It is a regional part of Common carotid artery.

FMA3949.name: right internal carotid artery
FMA3949.text: Right internal carotid artery is an internal carotid artery. It branches from Right common carotid artery. It is a regional part of Right common carotid artery.

FMA3951.name: subclavian artery
FMA3951.text: Systemic artery the trunk of which is continuous with either the trunk of brachiocephalic artery on the right side, or the aorta on the left side. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum.

FMA3953.name: right subclavian artery
FMA3953.text: Subclavian artery the trunk of which is continuous with trunk of brachiocephalic artery. It branches from Brachiocephalic artery. It is a regional part of Brachiocephalic artery.

FMA3956.name: vertebral artery
FMA3956.text: Vertebral artery is a branch of subclavian artery. It branches from Subclavian artery and First part of subclavian artery proper. It is a regional part of Subclavian artery. It supplies blood to Spinal cord.

FMA3958.name: right vertebral artery
FMA3958.text: Right vertebral artery is a vertebral artery. It branches from Right subclavian artery and First part of right subclavian artery proper. It is a regional part of Right subclavian artery.

FMA3960.name: internal thoracic artery
FMA3960.text: Internal thoracic artery is a branch of subclavian artery. It branches from Subclavian artery. It is a regional part of Subclavian artery. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum.

FMA3969.name: right internal thoracic artery
FMA3969.text: Right internal thoracic artery is an internal thoracic artery. It branches from First part of right subclavian artery proper and Right subclavian artery. It is a regional part of Right subclavian artery.

FMA3988.name: right superior epigastric artery
FMA3988.text: Right superior epigastric artery is a superior epigastric artery. It branches from Right internal thoracic artery. It is a regional part of Right internal thoracic artery.

FMA3990.name: thyrocervical trunk
FMA3990.text: Trunk of branch of subclavian artery, each instance of which arises superiorly from some subclavian artery just medial to some anterior scalene muscle and at once gives rise to the trunks of some inferior thyroid, transverse cervical, and suprascapular arteries, supplying some thyroid, neck, and scapular regions. It is a regional part of Thyrocervical artery.

FMA3992.name: right thyrocervical trunk
FMA3992.text: Right thyrocervical trunk is a thyrocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Right thyrocervical artery. It is continuous with Trunk of right subclavian artery.

FMA3994.name: second posterior intercostal artery
FMA3994.text: Second posterior intercostal artery is a posterior intercostal artery. Anatomical type — Systemic artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which carries oxygenated blood from some heart.

FMA4057.name: right dorsal scapular artery
FMA4057.text: Right dorsal scapular artery is a dorsal scapular artery. It branches from Right transverse cervical artery, Third part of right subclavian artery proper and Right subclavian artery. It is a regional part of Right transverse cervical artery.

FMA4058.name: left common carotid artery
FMA4058.text: Left common carotid artery is a common carotid artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum.

FMA4062.name: left internal carotid artery
FMA4062.text: Left internal carotid artery is an internal carotid artery. It branches from Left common carotid artery. It is a regional part of Left common carotid artery.

FMA4066.name: left vertebral artery
FMA4066.text: Left vertebral artery is a vertebral artery. It branches from First part of left subclavian artery proper and Left subclavian artery. It is a regional part of Left subclavian artery.

FMA4068.name: left internal thoracic artery
FMA4068.text: Left internal thoracic artery is an internal thoracic artery. It branches from First part of left subclavian artery proper and Left subclavian artery. It is a regional part of Left subclavian artery.

FMA4077.name: left musculophrenic artery
FMA4077.text: Left musculophrenic artery is a musculophrenic artery. It branches from Left internal thoracic artery. It is a regional part of Left internal thoracic artery.

FMA4083.name: left superior epigastric artery
FMA4083.text: Left superior epigastric artery is a superior epigastric artery. It branches from Left internal thoracic artery. It is a regional part of Left internal thoracic artery.

FMA4084.name: left thyrocervical trunk
FMA4084.text: Left thyrocervical trunk is a thyrocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Left thyrocervical artery.

FMA4086.name: left costocervical trunk
FMA4086.text: Left costocervical trunk is a costocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Left costocervical artery.

FMA4088.name: left superior intercostal artery
FMA4088.text: Left superior intercostal artery is a superior intercostal artery. It branches from Left costocervical artery and Left costocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Left costocervical artery.

FMA4112.name: left second posterior intercostal artery
FMA4112.text: Left second posterior intercostal artery is a second posterior intercostal artery. It branches from Left superior intercostal artery.

FMA4134.name: left deep cervical artery
FMA4134.text: Left deep cervical artery is a deep cervical artery. It branches from Left costocervical trunk and Left costocervical artery. It is a regional part of Left costocervical artery.

FMA4149.name: esophageal artery
FMA4149.text: Esophageal artery is a systemic artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree and Thoracic aorta. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It supplies blood to Esophagus.

FMA4176.name: posterior intercostal artery
FMA4176.text: Posterior intercostal artery is a systemic artery. Anatomical type — Systemic artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which carries oxygenated blood from some heart.

FMA4613.name: subcostal artery
FMA4613.text: Subcostal artery is a systemic artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree.

FMA4634.name: right subcostal artery
FMA4634.text: Right subcostal artery is a subcostal artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree.

FMA4654.name: left subcostal artery
FMA4654.text: Left subcostal artery is a subcostal artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree.

FMA4677.name: trunk of branch of coronary artery
FMA4677.text: Trunk of branch of coronary artery is a systemic arterial trunk. Anatomical type — Arterial trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the ventricles of the heart, directly or indirectly through branches of the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

FMA4694.name: left subclavian artery
FMA4694.text: Left subclavian artery is a subclavian artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree.

FMA4706.name: coronary sinus
FMA4706.text: Trunk of systemic vein which is formed by the union of the great cardiac vein and the left marginal vein and terminates in the right atrium. It is a regional part of Coronary sinus tree. It forms part of Heart. It is continuous with Inflow part of right atrium and Right atrium.

FMA4707.name: great cardiac vein
FMA4707.text: Cardiac vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some coronary sinus situated in some anterior longitudinal sulcus that collects blood from the anterior region of some right and left ventricles. It is a tributary of Coronary sinus. It is a regional part of Coronary sinus tree. It forms part of Left side of heart.

FMA4708.name: left marginal vein
FMA4708.text: Left marginal vein is a cardiac vein. It is a tributary of Coronary sinus and Great cardiac vein. It is a regional part of Coronary sinus tree. It belongs to Set of veins of heart.

FMA4712.name: posterior vein of left ventricle
FMA4712.text: Posterior vein of left ventricle is a cardiac vein. It is a tributary of Coronary sinus. It is a regional part of Coronary sinus tree. It belongs to Set of veins of heart.

FMA4713.name: middle cardiac vein
FMA4713.text: Cardiac vein, each instance of which is a a tributary of some coronary sinus situated in some posterior longitudinal sulcus that collects blood from the diaphragmatic region of some right and left ventricles. It is a tributary of Coronary sinus. It is a regional part of Coronary sinus tree. It belongs to Set of veins of heart.

FMA4714.name: small cardiac vein
FMA4714.text: Cardiac vein, each instance of which is a a tributary of some coronary sinus that collects blood from some right atrium and ventricle, and follows the coronary sulcus before draining into it. It is a tributary of Coronary sinus. It is a regional part of Coronary sinus tree. It forms part of Right side of heart.

FMA4716.name: right marginal vein
FMA4716.text: Right marginal vein is a cardiac vein. It is a tributary of Anterior cardiac vein. It is a regional part of Anterior cardiac venous tree. It forms part of Right side of heart.

FMA4720.name: superior vena cava
FMA4720.text: Trunk of systemic vein which is formed by the union of the right and left brachiocephalic veins and terminates in the right atrium. It is a regional part of Superior systemic venous tree. It is continuous with Biatrial part of heart, Inflow part of right atrium and Right atrium. It belongs to Set of vena cava trunks.

FMA4723.name: brachiocephalic vein
FMA4723.text: Brachiocephalic vein is a subdivision of superior systemic venous tree. Anatomical type — Systemic vein: Vein in the systemic venous system.

FMA4724.name: internal jugular vein
FMA4724.text: Internal jugular vein is a subdivision of brachiocephalic vein. It is a tributary of Brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4725.name: subclavian vein
FMA4725.text: Subclavian vein is a subdivision of brachiocephalic vein. It is a tributary of Brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4729.name: internal thoracic vein
FMA4729.text: Subdivision of brachiocephalic vein, each instance of which is a vena comitans of some internal thoracic artery that drains some chest all and breast. It is a tributary of Brachiocephalic vein. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum.

FMA4731.name: superior epigastric vein
FMA4731.text: Superior epigastric vein is a tributary of internal thoracic vein. It is a tributary of Vena comitantes of internal thoracic artery. It drains into Internal thoracic vein.

FMA4732.name: musculophrenic vein
FMA4732.text: Musculophrenic vein is a tributary of internal thoracic vein. It is a tributary of Vena comitantes of internal thoracic artery. It drains into Internal thoracic vein.

FMA4751.name: right brachiocephalic vein
FMA4751.text: Right brachiocephalic vein is a brachiocephalic vein. It is a tributary of Superior systemic venous tree. It is a regional part of Superior systemic venous tree. It is continuous with Right lymphatic duct tree.

FMA4754.name: right internal jugular vein
FMA4754.text: Right internal jugular vein is an internal jugular vein. It is a tributary of Right brachiocephalic vein. It is a regional part of Right brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4755.name: right subclavian vein
FMA4755.text: Right subclavian vein is a subclavian vein. It is a tributary of Right brachiocephalic vein. It is a regional part of Right brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4758.name: right internal thoracic vein
FMA4758.text: Right internal thoracic vein is an internal thoracic vein. It is a tributary of Right brachiocephalic vein. It is a regional part of Right brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4761.name: left brachiocephalic vein
FMA4761.text: Left brachiocephalic vein is a brachiocephalic vein. It is a tributary of Superior systemic venous tree. It is a regional part of Superior systemic venous tree. It is continuous with Thoracic duct tree.

FMA4762.name: left internal jugular vein
FMA4762.text: Left internal jugular vein is an internal jugular vein. It is a tributary of Left brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4763.name: left subclavian vein
FMA4763.text: Left subclavian vein is a subclavian vein. It is a tributary of Left brachiocephalic vein.

FMA4771.name: right superior epigastric vein
FMA4771.text: Right superior epigastric vein is a superior epigastric vein. It is a tributary of Vena comitantes of right internal thoracic artery.

FMA4772.name: right musculophrenic vein
FMA4772.text: Right musculophrenic vein is a musculophrenic vein. It is a tributary of Vena comitantes of right internal thoracic artery.

FMA4785.name: left superior epigastric vein
FMA4785.text: Left superior epigastric vein is a superior epigastric vein. It is a tributary of Vena comitantes of left internal thoracic artery.

FMA4786.name: left musculophrenic vein
FMA4786.text: Left musculophrenic vein is a musculophrenic vein. It is a tributary of Vena comitantes of left internal thoracic artery.

FMA4797.name: left superior intercostal vein
FMA4797.text: Left superior intercostal vein is a subdivision of brachiocephalic vein. It is a tributary of Left brachiocephalic vein. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum.

FMA4838.name: azygos vein
FMA4838.text: Tributary of superior systemic venous tree, each instance of which is a vein that drains some right posterior intercostal veins and connects some superior and inferior vena cavae; it arises from the union of some right ascending lumbar and subcostal veins and empties into some superior vena cava. It is a regional part of Superior systemic venous tree. It forms part of Content of thorax, Content of posterior mediastinum and Content of middle mediastinum.

FMA4843.name: right ascending lumbar vein
FMA4843.text: Right ascending lumbar vein is an ascending lumbar vein. It is a tributary of Azygos vein.

FMA4844.name: right subcostal vein
FMA4844.text: Right subcostal vein is a subcostal vein. It is a tributary of Azygos vein.

FMA4877.name: right superior intercostal vein
FMA4877.text: Right superior intercostal vein is a tributary of azygos vein. It is a tributary of Azygos vein.

FMA4944.name: hemiazygos vein
FMA4944.text: Hemiazygos vein is a tributary of azygos vein. It is a tributary of Azygos vein. It forms part of Content of posterior mediastinum.

FMA4950.name: left ascending lumbar vein
FMA4950.text: Left ascending lumbar vein is an ascending lumbar vein. It is a tributary of Hemiazygos vein.

FMA4951.name: left subcostal vein
FMA4951.text: Left subcostal vein is a subcostal vein. It is a tributary of Hemiazygos vein.

FMA5011.name: accessory hemiazygos vein
FMA5011.text: Accessory hemiazygos vein is a tributary of azygos vein. It is a tributary of Azygos vein.

FMA5018.name: bone organ
FMA5018.text: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system. Anatomical type — Organ with cavitated organ parts: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround two or more macroscopic anatomical spaces.

FMA5022.name: muscle organ
FMA5022.text: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of skeletal muscle tissue aggregated into macroscopic fasciculi by connective tissue; together with other muscles, it constitutes the muscular system. Anatomical type — Nonparenchymatous organ: Solid organ which consists of organ parts that are arranged as fascicles or sheets.

FMA5039.name: right costocervical trunk
FMA5039.text: Right costocervical trunk is a costocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Right costocervical artery. It is continuous with Trunk of right subclavian artery.

FMA5041.name: right second posterior intercostal artery
FMA5041.text: Right second posterior intercostal artery is a second posterior intercostal artery. It branches from Right superior intercostal artery.

FMA5042.name: right superior intercostal artery
FMA5042.text: Right superior intercostal artery is a superior intercostal artery. It branches from Right costocervical artery. It is a regional part of Right costocervical artery.

FMA5865.name: cranial nerve
FMA5865.text: Neural tree organ which is continuous with the brain. Anatomical type — Neural tree organ: Nonparenchymatous organ which has as its direct parts an aggregate of neurons, the somas of which are located in the neuraxis and their network of neurites (axons) predominantly located outside the neuraxis.

FMA5884.name: ganglion
FMA5884.text: Ganglion is a segment of neural tree organ. It is a regional part of Neural tree organ.

FMA5889.name: autonomic ganglion
FMA5889.text: Autonomic ganglion is a ganglion. Anatomical type — Segment of neural tree organ: Cell part cluster which is regional part of neural tree organ.

FMA5894.name: parasympathetic ganglion
FMA5894.text: Parasympathetic ganglion is an autonomic ganglion.

FMA5895.name: cranial parasympathetic ganglion
FMA5895.text: Cranial parasympathetic ganglion is a parasympathetic ganglion.

FMA5897.name: anatomical space
FMA5897.text: Immaterial anatomical entity, each instance of which has three spatial dimensions. Anatomical type — Immaterial anatomical entity: Physical anatomical entity, each instance of which is a three-dimensional space, surface, line or point associated with some material anatomical entity.

FMA5898.name: anatomical junction
FMA5898.text: Anatomical cluster in which parts of two or more anatomical structures establish physical continuity with one another or intermingle their component parts. Anatomical type — Anatomical cluster: Postnatal anatomical structure, each instance of which has as it direct parts a heterogeneous collection of some instances of two or more subclasses of anatomcial structure, which are spatially related to one another; the collections as a whole does not satisfy the definition of any other subclass of anatomical structure. Eaxmples: root of lung, back, anatomical snuffbox, motor unit, juxtaglomerular complex.

FMA5913.name: nerve trunk
FMA5913.text: Nerve trunk is a segment of nerve. Anatomical type — Segment of neural tree organ: Cell part cluster which is regional part of neural tree organ.

FMA6964.name: ciliary ganglion
FMA6964.text: Ciliary ganglion is a cranial parasympathetic ganglion.

FMA7037.name: branch of ciliary ganglion
FMA7037.text: Branch of ciliary ganglion is a subdivision of parasympathetic nervous system.

FMA7041.name: short ciliary nerve
FMA7041.text: Short ciliary nerve is a branch of ciliary ganglion. It branches from Ciliary ganglion.

FMA7131.name: esophagus
FMA7131.text: Organ with organ cavity, each instance of which is continuous superiorly with some pharynx and inferiorly with some stomach. It is a regional part of Gastrointestinal tract and Upper gastrointestinal tract. Its nerve supply includes Posterior esophageal nerve plexus and Anterior esophageal nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Esophageal branch of left first bronchial artery, Esophageal branch of left second bronchial artery and Esophageal artery, among other structures.

FMA7145.name: membrane organ
FMA7145.text: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue organized into a sheet which interconnects two or more organs, separates two or more body spaces from one another, or surrounds an organ or body part. Anatomical type — Nonparenchymatous organ: Solid organ which consists of organ parts that are arranged as fascicles or sheets.

FMA7146.name: organ component gland
FMA7146.text: Organ component gland is an organ component. Anatomical type — Organ component: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.

FMA7148.name: stomach
FMA7148.text: An expanded part of the digestive tract that stores food and participates in digestion. Its wall contains muscle and a glandular lining, and its outlet leads into the duodenum.

FMA7163.name: skin
FMA7163.text: Nonparenchymatous organ that consists of the epidermis, dermis and sets of hair and nails and which surrounds the entire body. Subdivisions of the skin surround various body parts; as a whole, the skin constitutes the external layer of the body. It forms part of Integumentary system.

FMA7196.name: spleen
FMA7196.text: An organ that filters blood and participates in immune functions. It also serves as a reservoir for blood cells and platelets.

FMA7198.name: pancreas
FMA7198.text: An abdominal organ with digestive and endocrine roles. It produces precursors of digestive enzymes and hormones that regulate blood glucose.

FMA7202.name: gallbladder
FMA7202.text: Organ with organ cavity, each instance of which is continuous proximally with some cystic duct and distally terminates at its fundus. It is a regional part of Biliary system. It is contained in Abdominal cavity. Its nerve supply includes Celiac ganglion, Celiac nerve plexus and Hepatic nerve plexus.

FMA7203.name: kidney
FMA7203.text: Corticomedullary organ which has as its part renal pelvis shared with and connected to ureter. It is a regional part of Upper urinary tract. It is contained in Retroperitoneal space. Its arterial supply includes Renal artery.

FMA7204.name: right kidney
FMA7204.text: Kidney located right of sagittal midplane of body. It is a regional part of Right upper urinary tract. It is contained in Space of right side of retroperitoneal compartment. Its nerve supply includes Right renal nerve plexus.

FMA7205.name: left kidney
FMA7205.text: Kidney located left of sagittal midplane of body. It is a regional part of Left upper urinary tract. It is contained in Space of left side of retroperitoneal compartment. Its nerve supply includes Left renal nerve plexus.

FMA7206.name: duodenum
FMA7206.text: Duodenum is a segment of small intestine. It is a regional part of Small intestine and Upper gastrointestinal tract. It is continuous with Jejunum and Pyloric part of stomach.

FMA7210.name: testis
FMA7210.text: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which consists of seminiferous tubules which communicate with the duct of the epididymis. It is a regional part of Male internal genitalia.

FMA7211.name: right testis
FMA7211.text: Testis located right of sagittal midplane of body. It forms part of Right hemiscrotum and Parenchyma of right testis. Its nerve supply includes Testicular nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Right testicular artery.

FMA7212.name: left testis
FMA7212.text: Testis located left of sagittal midplane of body. It forms part of Parenchyma of left testis and Left hemiscrotum. Its nerve supply includes Testicular nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Left testicular artery.

FMA7232.name: cusp of cardiac valve
FMA7232.text: Organ component which has as its parts the cusp proper, lunule and nodule of semilunar valvule. Anatomical type — Organ component: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.

FMA7237.name: leaflet of tricuspid valve
FMA7237.text: Leaf of caridac valve which has as its parts the anterior, posterior and septal leaflets that is is attached to the chorda tendinea of the right ventricle and the fibrous ring of tricuspid valve. It is a regional part of Segment of valve. It is continuous with Endocardium of inflow part of right ventricle and Endocardium of outflow part of right atrium.

FMA7238.name: anterior leaflet of tricuspid valve
FMA7238.text: Leaflet of tricuspid valve which is attached to the anterior and septal papillary muscles through the chorda tendinea of right ventricle. It is a regional part of Tricuspid valve.

FMA7239.name: posterior leaflet of tricuspid valve
FMA7239.text: Leaflet of tricuspid valve which is attached to the anterior and posterior papillary muscles through the chorda tendinea of the right ventricle. It is a regional part of Tricuspid valve.

FMA7240.name: septal leaflet of tricuspid valve
FMA7240.text: Leaflet of tricuspid valve which is attached to the posterior and septal papillary muscles through the chorda tendinea of the right ventricle. It is a regional part of Tricuspid valve.

FMA7241.name: leaflet of mitral valve
FMA7241.text: Leaf of cardiac valve which has as its parts the anterior, and posterior leaflets that is attached to the chorda tendinea of left ventricle and to the frbrous ring of mitral valve. It is a regional part of Segment of valve. It is continuous with Endocardium of inflow part of left ventricle and Endocardium of outflow part of left atrium.

FMA7242.name: anterior leaflet of mitral valve
FMA7242.text: Leaflet of mitral valve which is attached to the anterior head of the posterior papillary muscle of left ventricle through the chorda tendinea of the left ventricle. It is a regional part of Subaortic curtain of left ventricle and Mitral valve. It forms part of Myocardial zone 1 and Myocardium of basal zone of left ventricle. It is continuous with Fibrous trigone of heart and Subaortic curtain of left ventricle.

FMA7243.name: posterior leaflet of mitral valve
FMA7243.text: Leaflet of mitral valve which is attached to the posterior head of the lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle through the chorda tendinea of the left ventricle. It is a regional part of Mitral valve. It forms part of Myocardial zone 4 and Myocardium of basal zone of left ventricle.

FMA7247.name: left anterior cusp of pulmonary valve
FMA7247.text: Left anterior cusp of pulmonary valve is a cusp of pulmonary valve. It is a regional part of Pulmonary valve.

FMA7248.name: cusp of pulmonary valve
FMA7248.text: Organ component which is attached to the semilunar fibrous scallop of pulmonary valve anulus. It is a regional part of Segment of valve. It is continuous with Endocardium of outflow part of right ventricle and Endocardium of right ventricle.

FMA7249.name: right anterior cusp of pulmonary valve
FMA7249.text: Right anterior cusp of pulmonary valve is a cusp of pulmonary valve. It is a regional part of Pulmonary valve.

FMA7250.name: posterior cusp of pulmonary valve
FMA7250.text: Cusp of pulmonary valve which is adjacent to the left posterior cusp of aortic valve. It is a regional part of Pulmonary valve.

FMA7251.name: cusp of aortic valve
FMA7251.text: Cusp of cardiac valve which is attached to the semilunar fibrous scallop of aortic valve anulus. It is a regional part of Segment of valve. It is continuous with Endocardium of outflow part of left ventricle and Endocardium of left ventricle.

FMA7252.name: right posterior cusp of aortic valve
FMA7252.text: Cusp of aortic valve which is attached to the membranous part of the interventricular septum, the atrioventricular septum and the right fibrous trigone of the heart. It is a regional part of Aortic valve and Subaortic curtain of left ventricle.

FMA7253.name: anterior cusp of aortic valve
FMA7253.text: Cusp of aortic valve which is adjacent to the origin of the ostium of the right coronary artery. It is a regional part of Aortic valve.

FMA7254.name: left posterior cusp of aortic valve
FMA7254.text: Cusp of aortic valve which is adjacent to the origin of the ostium of the left coronary artery and is attached to the left fibrous trigone of heart. It is a regional part of Aortic valve and Subaortic curtain of left ventricle.

FMA7260.name: anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle
FMA7260.text: Papillary muscle of right ventricle which is attached to the wall of right ventricle below the anteroposterior commissure of tricuspid valve and the septomarginal trabecula. It is a regional part of Papillary muscle of right ventricle. It forms part of Anterior wall of right ventricle. Its arterial supply includes Right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.

FMA7261.name: posterior papillary muscle of right ventricle
FMA7261.text: Papillary muscle of right ventricle which is attached to the wall of right ventricle below the posteroseptal commissure of tricuspid valve. It is a regional part of Papillary muscle of right ventricle. It forms part of Inferior wall of right ventricle.

FMA7262.name: septal papillary muscle of right ventricle
FMA7262.text: Papillary muscle of right ventricle which is attached to the septomarginal trabecula. It is a regional part of Papillary muscle of right ventricle. It is continuous with Septomarginal trabecula.

FMA7264.name: lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle
FMA7264.text: Papillary muscle of left ventricle which has as its parts the anterolateral and posterior heads of the lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle that is continuous with the lateral wall of left ventricle. It is a regional part of Papillary muscle of left ventricle. It forms part of Myocardial zone 11, Anterior wall of left ventricle and Wall of inflow part of left ventricle. It is continuous with Lateral wall of left ventricle.

FMA7265.name: anterolateral head of lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle
FMA7265.text: Region of lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle which is attached to the lateral wall of left ventricle. It is a regional part of Anterior papillary muscle of left ventricle. It forms part of Anterior wall of left ventricle, Myocardium of mid zone of left ventricle and Lateral wall of left ventricle, among other structures.

FMA7394.name: trachea
FMA7394.text: Trachea is a segment of tracheobronchial tree. It is a regional part of Tracheobronchial tree. It is continuous with Laryngopharynx, Left main bronchus and Main bronchus, among other structures.

FMA7396.name: left main bronchus
FMA7396.text: Left main bronchus is a main bronchus. It is a regional part of Left bronchial tree. It forms part of Root of left lung, Content of mediastinum and Content of posterior mediastinum. It is continuous with Trachea.

FMA7405.name: main bronchus
FMA7405.text: Main bronchus is a bronchus. It is a regional part of Bronchial tree. It forms part of Root of lung. It is continuous with Trachea and Lobar bronchus.

FMA7409.name: bronchus
FMA7409.text: Bronchus is a segment of tracheobronchial tree. Anatomical type — Segment of tracheobronchial tree: Organ segment which is regional part of tracheobronchial tree.

FMA7474.name: long bone
FMA7474.text: Bone organ, each instance of which has as its parts some diaphysis, distal and proximal epiphyses, and bone marrow cavity. Anatomical type — Bone organ: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system.

FMA7475.name: short bone
FMA7475.text: Short bone is a bone organ. Anatomical type — Bone organ: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system.

FMA7476.name: flat bone
FMA7476.text: Flat bone is a bone organ. Anatomical type — Bone organ: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system.

FMA7477.name: irregular bone
FMA7477.text: Irregular bone is a bone organ. Anatomical type — Bone organ: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system.

FMA7478.name: pneumatized bone
FMA7478.text: Pneumatized bone is an irregular bone. Anatomical type — Bone organ: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system.

FMA7486.name: manubrium
FMA7486.text: Zone of sternum, each instance of which is the cranial or superior end of some sternum which articulates with some clavicles and some first two ribs. It is a regional part of Sternum.

FMA7487.name: body of sternum
FMA7487.text: Body of sternum is a zone of sternum. It is a regional part of Sternum.

FMA7488.name: xiphoid process
FMA7488.text: Xiphoid process is a zone of sternum. It is a regional part of Sternum.

FMA7538.name: cartilage organ component
FMA7538.text: Cartilage organ component is an organ component. Anatomical type — Organ component: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.

FMA7574.name: rib
FMA7574.text: A curved bone of the thoracic cage that articulates posteriorly with the thoracic vertebral column. Ribs help protect the chest organs and move during breathing.

FMA7591.name: costal cartilage
FMA7591.text: Costal cartilage is a skeletal cartilage organ. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7592.name: true rib
FMA7592.text: One of ribs 1–7, each connected to the sternum through its own costal cartilage. These ribs articulate posteriorly with the thoracic vertebrae.

FMA7593.name: typical rib
FMA7593.text: A rib with the usual arrangement of a head, neck, tubercle and curved shaft. The head and tubercle provide posterior articulations with the thoracic vertebral column.

FMA7594.name: false rib
FMA7594.text: One of ribs 8–12, without its own direct costal-cartilage connection to the sternum. Ribs 8–10 usually connect indirectly through the cartilage above, while ribs 11–12 have free anterior ends.

FMA7595.name: floating rib
FMA7595.text: One of ribs 11–12, which articulate posteriorly with the thoracic vertebrae but have no anterior connection to the sternum or the costal cartilage of another rib.

FMA7596.name: atypical rib
FMA7596.text: A rib whose shape differs from the usual arrangement of head, neck, tubercle and shaft. This is a category of rib shapes rather than an additional bone of the thoracic cage.

FMA7597.name: first rib
FMA7597.text: First rib is an atypical rib.

FMA7603.name: first costal cartilage
FMA7603.text: First costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7620.name: second rib
FMA7620.text: Second rib is an atypical rib.

FMA7638.name: third rib
FMA7638.text: Third rib is a typical rib.

FMA7646.name: retinaculum
FMA7646.text: Retinaculum is a membranous layer. Anatomical type — Membranous layer: Organ component layer arranged in sheets or lamellae.

FMA7703.name: second costal cartilage
FMA7703.text: Second costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7741.name: third costal cartilage
FMA7741.text: Third costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7749.name: fourth rib
FMA7749.text: Fourth rib is a typical rib.

FMA7768.name: fourth costal cartilage
FMA7768.text: Fourth costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7776.name: fifth rib
FMA7776.text: Fifth rib is a typical rib.

FMA7795.name: fifth costal cartilage
FMA7795.text: Fifth costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7822.name: sixth costal cartilage
FMA7822.text: Sixth costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7830.name: seventh rib
FMA7830.text: Seventh rib is a typical rib.

FMA7849.name: seventh costal cartilage
FMA7849.text: Seventh costal cartilage is a costal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA7857.text: Right first rib is a first rib. It forms part of Right side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA7875.name: right first costal cartilage
FMA7875.text: Right first costal cartilage is a first costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA7882.name: right second rib
FMA7882.text: Right second rib is a second rib. It forms part of Right side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA7886.name: right second costal cartilage
FMA7886.text: Right second costal cartilage is a second costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA7909.name: right third rib
FMA7909.text: Right third rib is a third rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA7913.text: Right third costal cartilage is a third costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA7976.text: Right fourth costal cartilage is a fourth costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA7987.text: Left first rib is a first rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8005.name: left first costal cartilage
FMA8005.text: Left first costal cartilage is a first costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8012.text: Left second rib is a second rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8031.name: left second costal cartilage
FMA8031.text: Left second costal cartilage is a second costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8039.name: left third rib
FMA8039.text: Left third rib is a third rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8058.name: left third costal cartilage
FMA8058.text: Left third costal cartilage is a third costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8066.name: right fifth rib
FMA8066.text: Right fifth rib is a fifth rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8070.name: right fifth costal cartilage
FMA8070.text: Right fifth costal cartilage is a fifth costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8093.name: left fifth rib
FMA8093.text: Left fifth rib is a fifth rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8112.name: left fifth costal cartilage
FMA8112.text: Left fifth costal cartilage is a fifth costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8120.name: eighth rib
FMA8120.text: Eighth rib is a false rib.

FMA8147.name: sixth rib
FMA8147.text: Sixth rib is a typical rib.

FMA8148.name: left fourth rib
FMA8148.text: Left fourth rib is a fourth rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8167.name: left fourth costal cartilage
FMA8167.text: Left fourth costal cartilage is a fourth costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8175.name: right sixth rib
FMA8175.text: Right sixth rib is a sixth rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8194.name: right sixth costal cartilage
FMA8194.text: Right sixth costal cartilage is a sixth costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8202.name: left sixth rib
FMA8202.text: Left sixth rib is a sixth rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8221.name: left sixth costal cartilage
FMA8221.text: Left sixth costal cartilage is a sixth costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8229.name: right seventh rib
FMA8229.text: Right seventh rib is a seventh rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8248.name: right seventh costal cartilage
FMA8248.text: Right seventh costal cartilage is a seventh costal cartilage. It forms part of Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8256.name: left seventh rib
FMA8256.text: Left seventh rib is a seventh rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8275.name: left seventh costal cartilage
FMA8275.text: Left seventh costal cartilage is a seventh costal cartilage. It forms part of Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of costal cartilages.

FMA8283.name: right eighth rib
FMA8283.text: Right eighth rib is an eighth rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8310.name: left eighth rib
FMA8310.text: Left eighth rib is an eighth rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8337.name: ninth rib
FMA8337.text: Ninth rib is a false rib.

FMA8364.name: right ninth rib
FMA8364.text: Right ninth rib is a ninth rib. It forms part of Right side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8391.name: left ninth rib
FMA8391.text: Left ninth rib is a ninth rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8418.name: tenth rib
FMA8418.text: Tenth rib is a false rib.

FMA8445.name: right tenth rib
FMA8445.text: Right tenth rib is a tenth rib. It forms part of Right side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8472.name: left tenth rib
FMA8472.text: Left tenth rib is a tenth rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Left side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8499.name: eleventh rib
FMA8499.text: Eleventh rib is a floating rib.

FMA8515.name: twelfth rib
FMA8515.text: Twelfth rib is a floating rib.

FMA8531.name: right eleventh rib
FMA8531.text: Right eleventh rib is an eleventh rib. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall and Right side of rib cage. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8532.name: left eleventh rib
FMA8532.text: Left eleventh rib is an eleventh rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8533.name: right twelfth rib
FMA8533.text: Right twelfth rib is a twelfth rib. It forms part of Right side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8534.name: left twelfth rib
FMA8534.text: Left twelfth rib is a twelfth rib. It forms part of Left side of rib cage and Anterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of all ribs.

FMA8612.name: pulmonary trunk
FMA8612.text: Pulmonary arterial trunk which is continuous with the right ventricle. It is a regional part of Left pulmonary vascular system, Right pulmonary vascular system and Pulmonary arterial tree. It forms part of Content of middle mediastinum. It is continuous with Biventricular part of heart, Outflow part of right ventricle and Right ventricle.

FMA8615.name: pulmonary arterial trunk
FMA8615.text: Pulmonary arterial trunk is an arterial trunk. Anatomical type — Arterial trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the ventricles of the heart, directly or indirectly through branches of the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

FMA8620.name: right anterior segmental artery
FMA8620.text: Right anterior segmental artery is an anterior segmental artery. It branches from Right upper lobar artery. It is a regional part of Right upper lobar artery. It forms part of Right anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8634.name: left apical segmental artery
FMA8634.text: Left apical segmental artery is an apical segmental artery. It branches from Interlobar portion of left pulmonary artery and Left upper lobar artery. It is a regional part of Left upper lobar artery. It forms part of Left apical bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8635.name: left posterior segmental artery
FMA8635.text: Left posterior segmental artery is a posterior segmental artery. It branches from Left upper lobar artery and Interlobar portion of left pulmonary artery. It is a regional part of Left upper lobar artery. It forms part of Left posterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8639.name: superior lingular artery
FMA8639.text: Superior lingular artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It branches from Lingular artery. It is a regional part of Lingular artery. It forms part of Superior lingular bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8640.name: inferior lingular artery
FMA8640.text: Inferior lingular artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It branches from Lingular artery. It is a regional part of Lingular artery. It forms part of Inferior lingular bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8642.name: left superior segmental artery
FMA8642.text: Left superior segmental artery is a superior segmental artery. It branches from Basal portion of left pulmonary artery and Left lower lobar artery. It is a regional part of Left lower lobar artery. It forms part of Left superior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8644.name: left medial basal segmental artery
FMA8644.text: Left medial basal segmental artery is a medial basal segmental artery. It branches from Anteromedial basal branch of left pulmonary artery and Left lower lobar artery. It is a regional part of Antero-medial basal segmental artery. It forms part of Left medial basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8645.name: left anterior basal segmental artery
FMA8645.text: Left anterior basal segmental artery is an anterior basal segmental artery. It branches from Left lower lobar artery and Anteromedial basal branch of left pulmonary artery. It is a regional part of Antero-medial basal segmental artery. It forms part of Left anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8646.name: left lateral basal segmental artery
FMA8646.text: Left lateral basal segmental artery is a lateral basal segmental artery. It branches from Left lower lobar artery and Posterolateral basal branch of left pulmonary artery. It is a regional part of Left basal segmental artery. It forms part of Left lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8647.name: left posterior basal segmental artery
FMA8647.text: Left posterior basal segmental artery is a posterior basal segmental artery. It branches from Posterolateral basal branch of left pulmonary artery and Left lower lobar artery. It is a regional part of Left basal segmental artery. It forms part of Left posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8648.name: trunk of pulmonary vein
FMA8648.text: Trunk of pulmonary vein is a venous trunk. It forms part of Content of middle mediastinum.

FMA8662.name: right anterior segmental vein
FMA8662.text: Anterior segmental vein, each instance of which is vein draining the anterior segment of the superior lobe of some right lung and emptying into some right superior pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Right upper lobar vein. It is a regional part of Right upper lobar vein. It forms part of Right anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8663.name: right posterior segmental vein
FMA8663.text: Posterior segmental vein, each instance of which drains the posterior segment of the upper lobe (superior) lobe of some right lung. It is a tributary of Right upper lobar vein. It is a regional part of Right upper lobar vein. It forms part of Right posterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8667.name: left anterior segmental vein
FMA8667.text: Anterior segmental vein, each instance of which is vein draining the anterior segment of the superior lobe of some left lung and emptying into some left superior pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Left upper lobar vein. It is a regional part of Left upper lobar vein. It forms part of Left anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8668.name: superior lingular vein
FMA8668.text: Superior lingular vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Lingular vein. It is a regional part of Lingular vein. It forms part of Superior lingular bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8669.name: inferior lingular vein
FMA8669.text: Inferior lingular vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Lingular vein. It is a regional part of Lingular vein. It forms part of Inferior lingular bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8670.name: right superior segmental vein
FMA8670.text: Superior segmental vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some right inferior pulmonary vein that drains the superior segment of the inferior lobe of some right lung. It is a tributary of Right inferior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Right inferior pulmonary vein and Intrapulmonary part of right inferior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Right superior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8673.name: right anterior basal segmental vein
FMA8673.text: Right anterior basal segmental vein is an anterior basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Right superior basal vein. It is a regional part of Right superior basal vein. It forms part of Right anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8678.name: left anterior basal segmental vein
FMA8678.text: Left anterior basal segmental vein is an anterior basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Left superior basal vein. It is a regional part of Left superior basal vein. It forms part of Left anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8681.name: apical part of right apical segmental vein
FMA8681.text: Apical part of right apical segmental vein is an apical part of apical segmental vein. It is a tributary of Right apical segmental vein. It is a regional part of Right apical segmental vein.

FMA8683.name: superior part of anterior segmental vein
FMA8683.text: Superior part of anterior segmental vein is a subsegmental part of anterior segmental vein. It is a tributary of Right anterior segmental vein. It is a regional part of Anterior segmental vein.

FMA8693.name: inferior part of anterior segmental vein
FMA8693.text: Inferior part of anterior segmental vein is a subsegmental part of anterior segmental vein. It is a tributary of Left anterior segmental vein. It is a regional part of Anterior segmental vein.

FMA8702.name: upper lobar artery
FMA8702.text: Upper lobar artery is a lobar artery. Anatomical type — Pulmonary artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which directs unoxygenated blood to some lung.

FMA8707.name: apical segmental artery
FMA8707.text: Apical segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. Anatomical type — Pulmonary artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which directs unoxygenated blood to some lung.

FMA8714.name: superior segmental artery
FMA8714.text: Superior segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Superior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8716.name: medial basal segmental artery
FMA8716.text: Medial basal segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Medial basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8717.name: anterior basal segmental artery
FMA8717.text: Anterior basal segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8718.name: lateral basal segmental artery
FMA8718.text: Lateral basal segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8719.name: posterior basal segmental artery
FMA8719.text: Posterior basal segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8755.name: segmental pulmonary artery
FMA8755.text: Segmental pulmonary artery is a pulmonary artery. It branches from Lobar pulmonary artery. It forms part of Bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9139.name: thoracic vertebra
FMA9139.text: Thoracic vertebra is a vertebra. Anatomical type — Vertebra: Irregular bone that articulates with other vertebrae, or with one other vertebra and the skull or the sacrum.

FMA9165.name: first thoracic vertebra
FMA9165.text: First thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9187.name: second thoracic vertebra
FMA9187.text: Second thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9209.name: third thoracic vertebra
FMA9209.text: Third thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9248.name: fourth thoracic vertebra
FMA9248.text: Fourth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9291.name: cavity of right ventricle
FMA9291.text: Cavity of ventricle which is surrounded by the wall of right ventricle and is continuous with the lumen of the pulmonary trunk. It is a regional part of Cavity of right side of heart. It forms part of Biventricular part of heart, Heart and Right ventricle, among other structures. It is continuous with Cavity of right atrium and Lumen of pulmonary trunk.

FMA9311.name: subsegmental pulmonary artery
FMA9311.text: Subsegmental pulmonary artery is a pulmonary artery. It branches from Segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Bronchopulmonary subsegment.

FMA9337.name: organ cavity subdivision
FMA9337.text: Anatomical cavity, which is surrounded by a morphological subdivision of an organ; is continuous with other organ cavity subdivisions of the same organ; together with other organ cavity subdivisions, it constitutes the organ cavity. Anatomical type — Anatomical cavity: Anatomical space which contains portions of one or more body substances and is bounded by the internal surface of one maximally connected anatomical structure or two or more adjacent anatomical structures.

FMA9338.name: anatomical conduit space
FMA9338.text: Anatomical space which connects two or more compartment spaces or two or more anatomical cavities. Anatomical type — Anatomical space: Immaterial anatomical entity, each instance of which has three spatial dimensions.

FMA9411.name: segmental pulmonary vein
FMA9411.text: Segmental pulmonary vein is a pulmonary vein. It forms part of Bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9413.name: subsegmental pulmonary vein
FMA9413.text: Subsegmental pulmonary vein is a pulmonary vein. It forms part of Bronchopulmonary subsegment.

FMA9419.name: subsegmental part of lateral segmental vein
FMA9419.text: Subsegmental part of lateral segmental vein is a subsegmental pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Lateral segmental vein.

FMA9421.name: subsegmental part of medial segmental vein
FMA9421.text: Subsegmental part of medial segmental vein is a subsegmental pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Medial segmental vein.

FMA9422.name: right medial basal segmental vein
FMA9422.text: Right medial basal segmental vein is a medial basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Right superior basal vein. It is a regional part of Right inferior basal vein. It forms part of Right medial basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9425.name: right lateral basal segmental vein
FMA9425.text: Right lateral basal segmental vein is a lateral basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Right inferior basal vein. It is a regional part of Right superior basal vein. It forms part of Right lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9428.name: right posterior basal segmental vein
FMA9428.text: Right posterior basal segmental vein is a posterior basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Right inferior basal vein. It is a regional part of Right inferior basal vein. It forms part of Right posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9437.name: left apical segmental vein
FMA9437.text: Anterior segmental vein, each instance of which is a variant vein draining the apical segment of the superior lobe of some left lung and emptying into some left superior pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Apicoposterior segmental vein. It is a regional part of Apicoposterior segmental vein. It forms part of Left apical bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9438.name: left posterior segmental vein
FMA9438.text: Posterior segmental vein, each instance of which drains the posterior segment of the upper lobe (superior) lobe of some left lung. It is a tributary of Apicoposterior segmental vein. It is a regional part of Apicoposterior segmental vein. It forms part of Left posterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9450.name: left lateral basal segmental vein
FMA9450.text: Left lateral basal segmental vein is a lateral basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Left inferior basal vein. It is a regional part of Left superior basal vein. It forms part of Left lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9451.name: left posterior basal segmental vein
FMA9451.text: Left posterior basal segmental vein is a posterior basal segmental vein. It is a tributary of Left inferior basal vein. It is a regional part of Left inferior basal vein. It forms part of Left posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA9457.name: wall of right atrium
FMA9457.text: Wall of atrium which is continuous with the wall of superior vena cava an inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Wall of biatrial part of heart and Wall of right side of heart. It forms part of Right atrium. It is continuous with Wall of superior vena cava, Wall of inferior vena cava and Wall of left atrium, among other structures.

FMA9464.name: cavity of cardiac chamber
FMA9464.text: Cavity of cardiac chamber is a cavity of organ part. Anatomical type — Cavity of organ part: Anatomical cavity, which is surrounded by an organ part; is separated from the cavity or lumen of other organ parts of the same organ by anatomical structures.

FMA9465.name: cavity of left atrium
FMA9465.text: Cavity of atrium which is surrounded by the wall of left atrium and is continuous with the lumen of the pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Cavity of left side of heart. It forms part of Biatrial part of heart, Heart and Left atrium proper, among other structures. It is continuous with Cavity of left ventricle and Lumen of pulmonary vein.

FMA9466.name: cavity of left ventricle
FMA9466.text: Cavity of ventricle which is surrounded by the wall of left ventricle and is continuous with the lumen of the aorta. It is a regional part of Cavity of left side of heart. It forms part of Left ventricle, Heart and Left side of heart, among other structures. It is continuous with Lumen of ascending trunk of arch of aorta and Cavity of left atrium.

FMA9531.name: wall of left atrium
FMA9531.text: Wall of atrium which is continuous with the wall of pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Wall of biatrial part of heart and Wall of left side of heart. It forms part of Left atrium. It is continuous with Muscular part of interatrial septum, Wall of right atrium and Wall of pulmonary vein, among other structures.

FMA9597.name: salivary gland
FMA9597.text: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which consists of glandular acini which communicate with oral cavity. Anatomical type — Lobular organ: Parenchymatous organ the stroma of which subdivides the parenchyma into lobes, segments, lobules and acini.

FMA9600.name: prostate
FMA9600.text: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which has as its parts glandular acini which are continuous with the prostatic part of the urethra. It forms part of Content of male pelvis and Genital system. Its nerve supply includes Prostatic nerve plexus and Inferior hypogastric nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Prostatic part of right inferior vesical artery, Prostatic part of right middle rectal artery and Prostatic part of left inferior gluteal artery, among other structures.

FMA9604.name: adrenal gland
FMA9604.text: Adrenal gland is a corticomedullary organ. Anatomical type — Corticomedullary organ: Parenchymatous organ the stroma of which subdivides the parenchyma into cortex and medulla.

FMA9611.name: femur
FMA9611.text: Long bone, each instance of which articulates with some hip bone, patella and tibia. It forms part of Thigh and Skeletal system of thigh. It belongs to Skeleton of free lower limb.

FMA9612.name: metacarpal bone
FMA9612.text: Long bone, each instance of which articulates with some carpal bone and phalanx of finger. It forms part of Hand proper.

FMA9613.name: parietal bone
FMA9613.text: Parietal bone is a flat bone. It forms part of Parietal part of head.

FMA9615.name: cricoid cartilage
FMA9615.text: Cricoid cartilage is a laryngeal cartilage. It belongs to Set of cartilages of larynx.

FMA9616.name: muscle of head
FMA9616.text: Muscle organ which is a part of the head. Anatomical type — Muscle organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of skeletal muscle tissue aggregated into macroscopic fasciculi by connective tissue; together with other muscles, it constitutes the muscular system.

FMA9617.name: muscle of neck
FMA9617.text: Muscle organ which is a part of the neck. Anatomical type — Muscle organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of skeletal muscle tissue aggregated into macroscopic fasciculi by connective tissue; together with other muscles, it constitutes the muscular system.

FMA9619.name: muscle of thorax
FMA9619.text: Muscle organ which is a part of the thorax. Anatomical type — Muscle of trunk: Muscle organ which is a part of the trunk.

FMA9620.name: muscle of abdomen
FMA9620.text: Muscle (organ) which is a part of the abdomen. Anatomical type — Muscle of trunk: Muscle organ which is a part of the trunk.

FMA9621.name: muscle of upper limb
FMA9621.text: Muscle of upper limb is a muscle of limb. Anatomical type — Muscle organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of skeletal muscle tissue aggregated into macroscopic fasciculi by connective tissue; together with other muscles, it constitutes the muscular system.

FMA9622.name: muscle of lower limb
FMA9622.text: Muscle of lower limb is a muscle of limb. Anatomical type — Muscle organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of skeletal muscle tissue aggregated into macroscopic fasciculi by connective tissue; together with other muscles, it constitutes the muscular system.

FMA9623.name: perineal muscle
FMA9623.text: Perineal muscle is a muscle of trunk. Anatomical type — Muscle of trunk: Muscle organ which is a part of the trunk.

FMA9625.name: stylohyoid
FMA9625.text: Stylohyoid is a suprahyoid muscle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to stylohyoid. It belongs to Set of suprahyoid muscles.

FMA9629.name: supraspinatus
FMA9629.text: Supraspinatus is an intrinsic muscle of shoulder. It forms part of Scapular region of shoulder. Its origin is on Supraspinous fossa and Supraspinous part of spine of scapula. Its insertion is on Superior facet of greater tubercle of humerus.

FMA9637.name: portion of tissue
FMA9637.text: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its parts some cells of predominantly one type with or without intercellular matrix. Anatomical type — Postnatal anatomical structure: Anatomical structure present after birth.

FMA9640.name: portion of connective tissue
FMA9640.text: Tissue which consists of fibroblasts, osteocytes or chondrocytes and intercellular matrix produced by these cells. Anatomical type — Portion of tissue: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its parts some cells of predominantly one type with or without intercellular matrix.

FMA9649.name: decussation
FMA9649.text: Anatomical junction in which two or more anatomical structures intermingle segments of their component parts. Anatomical type — Anatomical junction: Anatomical cluster in which parts of two or more anatomical structures establish physical continuity with one another or intermingle their component parts.

FMA9657.name: anatomical line
FMA9657.text: Anatomical boundary entity, each instance of which has one spatial dimension. Anatomical type — Anatomical boundary entity: Immaterial anatomical entity of one less dimension than the anatomical entity it bounds or demarcates from another anatomical entity.

FMA9703.name: nasolacrimal duct
FMA9703.text: Nasolacrimal duct is a segment of lacrimal duct. It is a regional part of Lacrimal duct.

FMA9704.name: ureter
FMA9704.text: Organ with organ cavity, each instance of which connects some renal sinus to some urinary bladder. It is a regional part of Upper urinary tract. Its arterial supply includes Inferior vesical artery, Set of ureteric branches of testicular artery and Ureteral part of inferior vesical artery. It is continuous with Kidney and Urinary bladder.

FMA9706.name: bile duct
FMA9706.text: Bile duct is a duct. Anatomical type — Duct: Organ segment which consists of a wall lined with epithelial cells and which encloses a lumen.

FMA9708.name: talus
FMA9708.text: Talus is a tarsal bone. It belongs to Set of tarsal bones.

FMA9710.name: vomer
FMA9710.text: Vomer is an irregular bone. It forms part of Viscerocranium. It belongs to Skeleton of head, Osseous skeleton of internal nose and Osseous skeleton of nasal septum.

FMA9711.name: maxilla
FMA9711.text: Pneumatized bone, each instance of which is a bone of some upper jaw.

FMA9721.name: tendon
FMA9721.text: Organ component of muscle which consists of bundles of collagen fibrils (Type I collagen) bound by loose connective tissue. Anatomical type — Organ component: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.

FMA9756.name: external intercostal muscle
FMA9756.text: External intercostal muscle is an intercostal muscle. Anatomical type — Muscle of thorax: Muscle organ which is a part of the thorax.

FMA9757.name: internal intercostal muscle
FMA9757.text: Internal intercostal muscle is an intercostal muscle. Anatomical type — Muscle of thorax: Muscle organ which is a part of the thorax.

FMA9758.name: innermost intercostal muscle
FMA9758.text: Innermost intercostal muscle is an intercostal muscle. Anatomical type — Muscle of thorax: Muscle organ which is a part of the thorax.

FMA9760.name: transversus thoracis
FMA9760.text: Transversus thoracis is a muscle of thorax. Its nerve supply includes Branch of third intercostal nerve to transversus thoracis, Branch of fifth intercostal nerve to transversus thoracis and Branch of sixth intercostal nerve to transversus thoracis, among other structures.

FMA9761.name: right transversus thoracis
FMA9761.text: Right transversus thoracis is a transversus thoracis. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall. Its nerve supply includes Branch of right sixth intercostal nerve to right transversus thoracis, Branch of right third intercostal nerve to right transversus thoracis and Branch of right fourth intercostal nerve to right transversus thoracis, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of thorax.

FMA9762.name: left transversus thoracis
FMA9762.text: Left transversus thoracis is a transversus thoracis. It forms part of Anterior thoracic wall. Its nerve supply includes Branch of left sixth intercostal nerve to left transversus thoracis, Branch of left fifth intercostal nerve to left transversus thoracis and Branch of left third intercostal nerve to left transversus thoracis, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of thorax.

FMA9914.name: vertebra
FMA9914.text: Irregular bone that articulates with other vertebrae, or with one other vertebra and the skull or the sacrum.
