Anatomical type — Bone organ: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which has as its direct parts some maximal complement of compact (cortical) and cancellous bone, and some maximal complement of bone marrow cavities; together with instances of other bones, cartilages and joints, it constitutes some skeletal system.

FMA9915.name: cervical vertebra
FMA9915.text: Cervical vertebra is a vertebra. Anatomical type — Vertebra: Irregular bone that articulates with other vertebrae, or with one other vertebra and the skull or the sacrum.

FMA9921.name: lumbar vertebra
FMA9921.text: Lumbar vertebra is a vertebra. Anatomical type — Vertebra: Irregular bone that articulates with other vertebrae, or with one other vertebra and the skull or the sacrum.

FMA9922.name: fifth thoracic vertebra
FMA9922.text: Fifth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9945.name: sixth thoracic vertebra
FMA9945.text: Sixth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9968.name: seventh thoracic vertebra
FMA9968.text: Seventh thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA9991.name: eighth thoracic vertebra
FMA9991.text: Eighth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA10014.name: ninth thoracic vertebra
FMA10014.text: Ninth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA10037.name: tenth thoracic vertebra
FMA10037.text: Tenth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA10059.name: eleventh thoracic vertebra
FMA10059.text: Eleventh thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA10081.name: twelfth thoracic vertebra
FMA10081.text: Twelfth thoracic vertebra is a thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Posterior thoracic wall. It belongs to Set of thoracic vertebrae.

FMA10419.name: pancreatic duct
FMA10419.text: Pancreatic duct is a duct. It is a regional part of Pancreatic duct tree.

FMA10446.name: intervertebral disk
FMA10446.text: Intervertebral disk is an articular disk of symphysis. It forms part of Intervertebral symphysis.

FMA10455.name: intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra
FMA10455.text: Intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk.

FMA10458.name: intervertebral disk of first thoracic vertebra
FMA10458.text: Intervertebral disk of first thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of First thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA10474.name: zone of muscle organ
FMA10474.text: Zone of muscle organ is an organ zone. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA10483.name: zone of bone organ
FMA10483.text: Zone of bone organ is an organ zone. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA10552.name: left dorsal scapular artery
FMA10552.text: Left dorsal scapular artery is a dorsal scapular artery. It branches from Left subclavian artery, Third part of left subclavian artery proper and Left transverse cervical artery. It is a regional part of Left transverse cervical artery.

FMA10636.name: costocervical trunk
FMA10636.text: Trunk of branch of subclavian artery, each instance of which is an artery that arises from the posterior aspect of some subclavian artery, arches backward, and at the neck of some first rib bifurcates into the trunks of some deep cervical and highest intercostal arteries, thus supplying blood to the structures contained in some first two intercostal spaces, the vertebral column, the muscles of some back, and some deep neck muscles. It is a regional part of Costocervical artery.

FMA10645.name: musculophrenic artery
FMA10645.text: Musculophrenic artery is a branch of internal thoracic artery. It branches from Internal thoracic artery. It is a regional part of Internal thoracic artery.

FMA10646.name: superior epigastric artery
FMA10646.text: Superior epigastric artery is a branch of internal thoracic artery. It branches from Internal thoracic artery. It is a regional part of Internal thoracic artery.

FMA10659.name: deep cervical artery
FMA10659.text: Deep cervical artery is a subdivision of costocervical artery. It branches from Costocervical trunk and Costocervical artery. It is a regional part of Costocervical artery.

FMA10660.name: right deep cervical artery
FMA10660.text: Right deep cervical artery is a deep cervical artery. It branches from Right costocervical artery. It is a regional part of Right costocervical artery.

FMA10662.name: inferior thyroid artery
FMA10662.text: Inferior thyroid artery is a subdivision of thyrocervical artery. It branches from Thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Thyrocervical artery. It supplies blood to Inferior parathyroid gland and Parathyroid gland.

FMA10663.name: suprascapular artery
FMA10663.text: Suprascapular artery is a subdivision of thyrocervical artery. It branches from Thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Thyrocervical artery.

FMA10664.name: transverse cervical artery
FMA10664.text: Transverse cervical artery is a subdivision of thyrocervical artery. It branches from Thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Thyrocervical artery.

FMA10665.name: superficial cervical artery
FMA10665.text: Superficial cervical artery is a subdivision of transverse cervical artery. It branches from Transverse cervical artery. It is a regional part of Transverse cervical artery.

FMA10680.name: left inferior thyroid artery
FMA10680.text: Left inferior thyroid artery is an inferior thyroid artery. It branches from Left thyrocervical trunk and Left thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Left thyrocervical artery. It supplies blood to Thyroid gland.

FMA10681.name: left suprascapular artery
FMA10681.text: Left suprascapular artery is a suprascapular artery. It branches from Left thyrocervical trunk and Left thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Left thyrocervical artery.

FMA10682.name: left transverse cervical artery
FMA10682.text: Left transverse cervical artery is a transverse cervical artery. It branches from Left thyrocervical artery and Left thyrocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Left thyrocervical artery.

FMA10683.name: left superficial cervical artery
FMA10683.text: Left superficial cervical artery is a superficial cervical artery. It branches from Left transverse cervical artery and Left thyrocervical trunk. It is a regional part of Left transverse cervical artery.

FMA10692.name: right musculophrenic artery
FMA10692.text: Right musculophrenic artery is a musculophrenic artery. It branches from Right internal thoracic artery. It is a regional part of Right internal thoracic artery.

FMA10697.name: right inferior thyroid artery
FMA10697.text: Right inferior thyroid artery is an inferior thyroid artery. It branches from Right thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Right thyrocervical artery. It supplies blood to Thyroid gland.

FMA10698.name: right suprascapular artery
FMA10698.text: Right suprascapular artery is a suprascapular artery. It branches from Right thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Right thyrocervical artery.

FMA10699.name: right transverse cervical artery
FMA10699.text: Right transverse cervical artery is a transverse cervical artery. It branches from Right thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Right thyrocervical artery.

FMA10700.name: right superficial cervical artery
FMA10700.text: Right superficial cervical artery is a superficial cervical artery. It branches from Right transverse cervical artery and Right thyrocervical artery. It is a regional part of Right transverse cervical artery.

FMA10704.name: variant bronchial artery
FMA10704.text: Variant bronchial artery is a variant systemic artery. It branches from Third posterior intercostal artery.

FMA10951.name: inferior vena cava
FMA10951.text: Trunk of systemic vein which is formed by the union of the right common iliac vein and the left common iliac vein and terminates in the right atrium. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree. It is continuous with Biatrial part of heart, Inflow part of right atrium and Right atrium. It belongs to Set of vena cava trunks.

FMA11195.name: segment of neural tree organ
FMA11195.text: Cell part cluster which is regional part of neural tree organ. Anatomical type — Cell part cluster: Anatomical cluster which has as direct parts cell parts from two or more cells.

FMA11336.name: linea alba
FMA11336.text: Anatomical junction between aponeuroses of the anterior abdominal muscles. Anatomical type — Decussation: Anatomical junction in which two or more anatomical structures intermingle segments of their component parts.

FMA11337.name: zone of continuity
FMA11337.text: Zone of connectivity where there is no bona fide boundary between some parts of two contiguous structures. Anatomical type — Anatomical junction: Anatomical cluster in which parts of two or more anatomical structures establish physical continuity with one another or intermingle their component parts.

FMA11338.name: ileocecal junction
FMA11338.text: Ileocecal junction is a zone of continuity. It is a regional part of Wall of distal part of ileum, Ileum and Cecum.

FMA11359.name: cavity of right atrium
FMA11359.text: Cavity of atrium which is surrounded by the wall of right atrium and is continuous with the lumen of superior vena cava and inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Cavity of right side of heart. It forms part of Right side of heart, Biatrial part of heart and Right atrium, among other structures. It is continuous with Lumen of superior vena cava, Lumen of inferior vena cava and Cavity of right ventricle.

FMA12215.name: zone of sternum
FMA12215.text: Zone of sternum is a zone of bone organ. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA12224.name: segment of tracheobronchial tree
FMA12224.text: Organ segment which is regional part of tracheobronchial tree. Anatomical type — Organ segment: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA12516.name: tooth
FMA12516.text: Organ with cavity, each instance of which has as its parts some dentine, cementum, dental pulp, enamel and cavity. Anatomical type — Organ with organ cavity: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround one continuous anatomical space.

FMA12519.name: atlas
FMA12519.text: Atlas is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12520.name: axis
FMA12520.text: Axis is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12521.name: third cervical vertebra
FMA12521.text: Third cervical vertebra is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12522.name: fourth cervical vertebra
FMA12522.text: Fourth cervical vertebra is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12523.name: fifth cervical vertebra
FMA12523.text: Fifth cervical vertebra is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12524.name: sixth cervical vertebra
FMA12524.text: Sixth cervical vertebra is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12525.name: seventh cervical vertebra
FMA12525.text: Seventh cervical vertebra is a cervical vertebra. It forms part of Neck. It belongs to Set of cervical vertebrae.

FMA12823.name: incisor tooth
FMA12823.text: Incisor tooth is a tooth. Anatomical type — Tooth: Organ with cavity, each instance of which has as its parts some dentine, cementum, dental pulp, enamel and cavity.

FMA12845.name: subcostal vein
FMA12845.text: Venous tree, each instance of which is the vena comitans of some subcostal artery on the left or right side; it joins some ascending lumbar vein to form some azygos vein on the right or some hemiazygos vein on the left.

FMA12846.name: cardiac vein
FMA12846.text: Cardiac vein is a systemic vein. It forms part of Heart.

FMA12858.name: ascending lumbar vein
FMA12858.text: Ascending lumbar vein is a subdivision of superior systemic venous tree. Anatomical type — Systemic vein: Vein in the systemic venous system.

FMA13072.name: first lumbar vertebra
FMA13072.text: First lumbar vertebra is a lumbar vertebra. It belongs to Set of lumbar vertebrae.

FMA13073.name: second lumbar vertebra
FMA13073.text: Second lumbar vertebra is a lumbar vertebra. It belongs to Set of lumbar vertebrae.

FMA13074.name: third lumbar vertebra
FMA13074.text: Third lumbar vertebra is a lumbar vertebra. It belongs to Set of lumbar vertebrae.

FMA13075.name: fourth lumbar vertebra
FMA13075.text: Fourth lumbar vertebra is a lumbar vertebra. It belongs to Set of lumbar vertebrae.

FMA13076.name: fifth lumbar vertebra
FMA13076.text: Fifth lumbar vertebra is a lumbar vertebra. It belongs to Set of lumbar vertebrae.

FMA13087.name: segment of aorta
FMA13087.text: Segment of aorta is a segment of arterial trunk. Anatomical type — Blood vessel: Segment of blood vessel tree organ which is a tubular structure the lumen of which contains blood; together with other spatially associated blood vessels constitute blood vessel tree organ.

FMA13109.name: pectoralis minor
FMA13109.text: Pectoralis minor is a pectoral muscle. It forms part of Pectoral region of shoulder. Its insertion is on Coracoid process. Its nerve supply includes Pectoralis minor branch of lateral pectoral nerve.

FMA13237.name: cavity of atrium
FMA13237.text: Cavity of atrium is a cavity of cardiac chamber. It forms part of Cardiac atrium.

FMA13238.name: cavity of ventricle
FMA13238.text: Cavity of ventricle is a cavity of cardiac chamber. It forms part of Cardiac ventricle.

FMA13256.name: wall of cardiac chamber
FMA13256.text: Region of wall of heart which consists of endocardium, myocardium and epicardium that surrounds the cavity of a cardiac chamber. It is continuous with Muscular part of cardiac septum.

FMA13278.name: anterior segmental artery
FMA13278.text: Anterior segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. It forms part of Anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13279.name: left anterior segmental artery
FMA13279.text: Left anterior segmental artery is an anterior segmental artery. It branches from Left upper lobar artery. It is a regional part of Left upper lobar artery. It forms part of Left anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13280.name: posterior segmental artery
FMA13280.text: Posterior segmental artery is a segmental pulmonary artery. Anatomical type — Pulmonary artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which directs unoxygenated blood to some lung.

FMA13289.name: medial basal segmental vein
FMA13289.text: Medial basal segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Inferior basal vein. It forms part of Medial basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13290.name: anterior basal segmental vein
FMA13290.text: Segmental pulmonary vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some superior basal vein that drains the anterior basal segment of the inferior lobe of some lung. It is a regional part of Superior basal vein. It forms part of Anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13291.name: lateral basal segmental vein
FMA13291.text: Lateral basal segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Superior basal vein. It forms part of Lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13292.name: posterior basal segmental vein
FMA13292.text: Posterior basal segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Inferior basal vein. It forms part of Posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13295.name: diaphragm
FMA13295.text: A thin muscular partition between the thoracic and abdominal cavities. It is an important muscle of breathing.

FMA13303.name: humerus
FMA13303.text: Long bone, each instance of which that articulates proximally with the scapula atsome shoulder and distally with the radius and ulna at some elbow. It forms part of Arm and Skeletal system of arm. It belongs to Skeleton of free upper limb.

FMA13321.name: clavicle
FMA13321.text: Long bone, each instance of which articulates with some scapula and sternum. It forms part of Pectoral part of pectoral girdle. Its arterial supply includes Clavicular branch of thoraco-acromial artery, Clavicular branch of suprascapular artery and Clavicular branch of internal thoracic artery. It belongs to Skeleton of pectoral girdle.

FMA13322.name: right clavicle
FMA13322.text: Right clavicle is a clavicle. It forms part of Pectoral part of right pectoral girdle. Its arterial supply includes Clavicular branch of right internal thoracic artery, Clavicular branch of right suprascapular artery and Clavicular branch of right thoraco-acromial artery. It belongs to Skeleton of right pectoral girdle.

FMA13323.name: left clavicle
FMA13323.text: Left clavicle is a clavicle. It forms part of Pectoral part of left pectoral girdle. Its arterial supply includes Clavicular branch of left thoraco-acromial artery, Clavicular branch of left internal thoracic artery and Clavicular branch of left suprascapular artery. It belongs to Skeleton of left pectoral girdle.

FMA13324.name: cephalic vein
FMA13324.text: Tributary of axillary vein, each instance of which is a superficial tributary of vein that arises from the radial side of the dorsal rete of some hand, and winds anteriorly to pass along the anterior border of some brachioradialis muscle; above some elbow it ascends along the lateral border of some biceps muscle and the pectoral border of some deltoid muscle. It is a tributary of Axillary vein and Subclavian vein. It forms part of Cubital fossa. It drains into Axillary vein.

FMA13325.name: right cephalic vein
FMA13325.text: Right cephalic vein is a cephalic vein. It is a tributary of Right subclavian vein. It forms part of Right arm.

FMA13326.name: left cephalic vein
FMA13326.text: Left cephalic vein is a cephalic vein. It is a tributary of Left subclavian vein. It forms part of Left arm.

FMA13329.name: axillary vein
FMA13329.text: Axillary vein is a subdivision of subclavian vein. It is a tributary of Subclavian vein.

FMA13330.name: right axillary vein
FMA13330.text: Right axillary vein is an axillary vein. It is a tributary of Right subclavian vein.

FMA13331.name: left axillary vein
FMA13331.text: Left axillary vein is an axillary vein. It is a tributary of Left subclavian vein.

FMA13335.name: external oblique
FMA13335.text: External oblique is a muscle of anterior abdominal wall. Its nerve supply includes Branch of seventh intercostal nerve to external oblique, Branch of eleventh intercostal nerve to external oblique and Branch of subcostal nerve to external oblique, among other structures.

FMA13336.name: right external oblique
FMA13336.text: Right external oblique is an external oblique. Its nerve supply includes Branch of right eleventh intercostal nerve to right external oblique, Branch of right seventh intercostal nerve to right external oblique and Branch of right eighth intercostal nerve to right external oblique, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of anterior abdominal wall and Musculature of abdomen.

FMA13337.name: left external oblique
FMA13337.text: Left external oblique is an external oblique. Its nerve supply includes Branch of left ninth intercostal nerve to left external oblique, Branch of left eleventh intercostal nerve to left external oblique and Branch of left subcostal nerve to left external oblique, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of abdomen and Musculature of anterior abdominal wall.

FMA13338.name: infrahyoid muscle
FMA13338.text: Infrahyoid muscle is a muscle of neck. Anatomical type — Muscle of neck: Muscle organ which is a part of the neck.

FMA13341.name: sternohyoid
FMA13341.text: Sternohyoid is an infrahyoid muscle. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum. It is contained in Space of muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to sternohyoid.

FMA13342.name: omohyoid
FMA13342.text: Omohyoid is an infrahyoid muscle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to superior belly of omohyoid and Nerve to inferior belly of omohyoid. It belongs to Set of infrahyoid muscles.

FMA13343.name: sternothyroid
FMA13343.text: Sternothyroid is an infrahyoid muscle. It is contained in Space of muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to sternothyroid. It belongs to Set of infrahyoid muscles and Set of extrinsic muscles of larynx.

FMA13344.name: thyrohyoid
FMA13344.text: Thyrohyoid is an infrahyoid muscle. It is contained in Space of muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to thyrohyoid. It belongs to Set of infrahyoid muscles and Set of extrinsic muscles of larynx.

FMA13346.name: right sternohyoid
FMA13346.text: Right sternohyoid is a sternohyoid. It is contained in Space of right muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right sternohyoid. It belongs to Set of right infrahyoid muscles and Musculature of neck.

FMA13347.name: left sternohyoid
FMA13347.text: Left sternohyoid is a sternohyoid. It is contained in Space of left muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left sternohyoid. It belongs to Set of left infrahyoid muscles and Musculature of neck.

FMA13348.name: right omohyoid
FMA13348.text: Right omohyoid is an omohyoid. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to inferior belly of right omohyoid and Nerve to superior belly of right omohyoid. It belongs to Set of right infrahyoid muscles and Musculature of neck.

FMA13349.name: left omohyoid
FMA13349.text: Left omohyoid is an omohyoid. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to inferior belly of left omohyoid and Nerve to superior belly of left omohyoid. It belongs to Set of left infrahyoid muscles and Musculature of neck.

FMA13350.name: right sternothyroid
FMA13350.text: Right sternothyroid is a sternothyroid. It is contained in Space of right muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right sternothyroid. It belongs to Musculature of neck, Set of right extrinsic muscles of larynx and Set of right infrahyoid muscles.

FMA13351.name: left sternothyroid
FMA13351.text: Left sternothyroid is a sternothyroid. It is contained in Space of left muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left sternothyroid. It belongs to Set of left infrahyoid muscles, Set of left extrinsic muscles of larynx and Musculature of neck.

FMA13352.name: right thyrohyoid
FMA13352.text: Right thyrohyoid is a thyrohyoid. It is contained in Space of right muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right thyrohyoid. It belongs to Set of right extrinsic muscles of larynx, Musculature of neck and Set of right infrahyoid muscles.

FMA13353.name: left thyrohyoid
FMA13353.text: Left thyrohyoid is a thyrohyoid. It is contained in Space of left muscular triangle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left thyrohyoid. It belongs to Set of left extrinsic muscles of larynx, Musculature of neck and Set of left infrahyoid muscles.

FMA13354.name: intercostal muscle
FMA13354.text: Intercostal muscle is a muscle of thorax. Anatomical type — Muscle of thorax: Muscle organ which is a part of the thorax.

FMA13365.name: caudate lobe of liver
FMA13365.text: Caudate lobe of liver is a lobe of liver. It is a regional part of Dorsal sector of liver, Right lobe of liver (classical) and Liver.

FMA13375.name: right pectoralis minor
FMA13375.text: Right pectoralis minor is a pectoralis minor. It forms part of Female anterior superficial chest wall, Anterior superficial chest wall and Pectoral part of right shoulder, among other structures. Its insertion is on Right coracoid process. It belongs to Right pectoral musculature and Musculature of thorax.

FMA13376.name: left pectoralis minor
FMA13376.text: Left pectoralis minor is a pectoralis minor. It forms part of Female anterior superficial chest wall, Male anterior superficial chest wall and Anterior superficial chest wall, among other structures. Its insertion is on Left coracoid process. It belongs to Left pectoral musculature and Musculature of thorax.

FMA13379.name: rhomboid major
FMA13379.text: Rhomboid major is a deep extrinsic muscle of shoulder. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to rhomboid major. It belongs to Musculature of pectoral girdle, Scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of shoulder.

FMA13380.name: rhomboid minor
FMA13380.text: Rhomboid minor is a deep extrinsic muscle of shoulder. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to rhomboid minor. It belongs to Musculature of pectoral girdle, Scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of shoulder.

FMA13381.name: right rhomboid major
FMA13381.text: Right rhomboid major is a rhomboid major. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right rhomboid major. It belongs to Set of deep extrinsic muscles of right shoulder and Right scapular musculature.

FMA13382.name: left rhomboid major
FMA13382.text: Left rhomboid major is a rhomboid major. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left rhomboid major. It belongs to Left scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of left shoulder.

FMA13383.name: right rhomboid minor
FMA13383.text: Right rhomboid minor is a rhomboid minor. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right rhomboid minor. It belongs to Right scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of right shoulder.

FMA13384.name: left rhomboid minor
FMA13384.text: Left rhomboid minor is a rhomboid minor. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left rhomboid minor. It belongs to Set of deep extrinsic muscles of left shoulder and Left scapular musculature.

FMA13385.name: scalenus anterior
FMA13385.text: Scalenus anterior is a scalene muscle. Its origin is on Transverse process of fourth cervical vertebra, Transverse process of sixth cervical vertebra and Transverse process of third cervical vertebra, among other structures. Its insertion is on Scalene tubercle. Its nerve supply includes Scalenus anterior branch of fifth cervical nerve, C4 branch to scalenus anterior and C6 branch to scalenus anterior.

FMA13386.name: scalenus medius
FMA13386.text: Scalenus medius is a scalene muscle. Its origin is on Transverse process of fifth cervical vertebra, Transverse process of third cervical vertebra and Transverse process of sixth cervical vertebra, among other structures. Its insertion is on Superior surface of first rib. Its nerve supply includes C6 branch to scalenus medius, C3 branch to scalenus medius and C8 branch to scalenus medius, among other structures.

FMA13387.name: scalenus posterior
FMA13387.text: Scalenus posterior is a scalene muscle. Its origin is on Posterior tubercle of transverse process of sixth cervical vertebra, Posterior tubercle of transverse process of fourth cervical vertebra and Posterior tubercle of transverse process of fifth cervical vertebra. Its insertion is on Second rib. Its nerve supply includes C6 branch to scalenus posterior, C7 branch to scalenus posterior and C8 branch to scalenus posterior.

FMA13388.name: right scalenus posterior
FMA13388.text: Right scalenus posterior is a scalenus posterior. Its nerve supply includes C6 branch to right scalenus posterior, C8 branch to right scalenus medius and C7 branch to right scalenus posterior. It belongs to Musculature of neck.

FMA13389.name: left scalenus posterior
FMA13389.text: Left scalenus posterior is a scalenus posterior. Its nerve supply includes C8 branch to left scalenus medius, C6 branch to left scalenus posterior and C7 branch to left scalenus posterior. It belongs to Musculature of neck.

FMA13390.name: right scalenus medius
FMA13390.text: Right scalenus medius is a scalenus medius. Its nerve supply includes C8 branch to right scalenus medius, C7 branch to right scalenus medius and C6 branch to right scalenus medius, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of neck.

FMA13391.name: left scalenus medius
FMA13391.text: Left scalenus medius is a scalenus medius. Its nerve supply includes C6 branch to left scalenus medius, C4 branch to left scalenus medius and Scalenus medius branch of left fifth cervical nerve, among other structures.

FMA13392.name: right scalenus anterior
FMA13392.text: Right scalenus anterior is a scalenus anterior. Its insertion is on Right scalene tubercle. Its nerve supply includes C4 branch to right scalenus anterior, C6 branch to right scalenus anterior and Scalenus anterior branch of right fifth cervical nerve. It belongs to Musculature of neck.

FMA13393.name: left scalenus anterior
FMA13393.text: Left scalenus anterior is a scalenus anterior. Its insertion is on Left scalene tubercle. It belongs to Musculature of neck.

FMA13394.name: scapula
FMA13394.text: Scapula is a flat bone. It forms part of Scapular part of pectoral girdle and Shoulder. It belongs to Skeleton of pectoral girdle.

FMA13395.name: right scapula
FMA13395.text: Right scapula is a scapula. It forms part of Scapular part of right pectoral girdle, Right shoulder and Skeletal system of back of thorax. It belongs to Skeleton of right pectoral girdle.

FMA13396.name: left scapula
FMA13396.text: Left scapula is a scapula. It forms part of Skeletal system of back of thorax, Scapular part of left pectoral girdle and Left shoulder. It belongs to Skeleton of left pectoral girdle.

FMA13397.name: serratus anterior
FMA13397.text: Serratus anterior is a deep extrinsic muscle of shoulder. Its origin is on First rib, Seventh rib and Fifth rib, among other structures. Its insertion is on Medial zone of scapula. Its nerve supply includes Long thoracic nerve.

FMA13398.name: right serratus anterior
FMA13398.text: Right serratus anterior is a serratus anterior. It forms part of Right lateral superficial chest wall and Superficial chest wall. Its nerve supply includes Right long thoracic nerve. It belongs to Right scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of right shoulder.

FMA13399.name: left serratus anterior
FMA13399.text: Left serratus anterior is a serratus anterior. It forms part of Left lateral superficial chest wall and Superficial chest wall. Its nerve supply includes Left long thoracic nerve. It belongs to Left scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of left shoulder.

FMA13400.name: serratus posterior
FMA13400.text: Serratus posterior is a muscle of vertebral column. It belongs to Set of deep extrinsic muscles of shoulder.

FMA13401.name: serratus posterior superior
FMA13401.text: Serratus posterior superior is a serratus posterior. Its origin is on Spinous process of second thoracic vertebra, Spinous process of seventh cervical vertebra and Ligamentum nuchae, among other structures. Its insertion is on Second rib, Fifth rib and Fourth rib, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Third intercostal nerve, Second intercostal nerve and Fifth intercostal nerve, among other structures.

FMA13402.name: serratus posterior inferior
FMA13402.text: Serratus posterior inferior is a serratus posterior. Its origin is on Spinous process of third lumbar vertebra, Spinous process of first lumbar vertebra and Spinous process of eleventh thoracic vertebra, among other structures. Its insertion is on Inferior margin of twelfth rib, Inferior margin of eleventh rib and Inferior margin of tenth rib, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Ninth intercostal nerve, Eleventh intercostal nerve and Subcostal nerve, among other structures.

FMA13403.name: right serratus posterior superior
FMA13403.text: Right serratus posterior superior is a serratus posterior superior. Its nerve supply includes Right third intercostal nerve, Right fifth intercostal nerve and Right fourth intercostal nerve, among other structures. It belongs to Set of muscles of vertebral column.

FMA13404.name: left serratus posterior superior
FMA13404.text: Left serratus posterior superior is a serratus posterior superior. Its nerve supply includes Left fourth intercostal nerve, Left second intercostal nerve and Left third intercostal nerve, among other structures. It belongs to Set of muscles of vertebral column.

FMA13405.name: right serratus posterior inferior
FMA13405.text: Right serratus posterior inferior is a serratus posterior inferior. Its nerve supply includes Right subcostal nerve, Right ninth intercostal nerve and Right eleventh intercostal nerve, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of back of abdomen and Set of muscles of vertebral column.

FMA13406.name: left serratus posterior inferior
FMA13406.text: Left serratus posterior inferior is a serratus posterior inferior. Its nerve supply includes Left ninth intercostal nerve, Left subcostal nerve and Left tenth intercostal nerve, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of back of abdomen and Set of muscles of vertebral column.

FMA13407.name: sternocleidomastoid
FMA13407.text: Sternocleidomastoid is a superficial muscle of neck. It is contained in Space of sternocleidomastoid region. Its nerve supply includes Branch of spinal accessory nerve to sternocleidomastoid, C3 branch to sternocleidomastoid and C2 branch to sternocleidomastoid.

FMA13408.name: right sternocleidomastoid
FMA13408.text: Right sternocleidomastoid is a sternocleidomastoid. Its nerve supply includes C3 branch to right sternocleidomastoid, Branch of right spinal accessory nerve to right sternocleidomastoid and C2 branch to right sternocleidomastoid. It belongs to Set of anterolateral muscles of neck and Set of superficial muscles of neck.

FMA13409.name: left sternocleidomastoid
FMA13409.text: Left sternocleidomastoid is a sternocleidomastoid. Its nerve supply includes C2 branch to left sternocleidomastoid, C3 branch to left sternocleidomastoid and Branch of left spinal accessory nerve to left sternocleidomastoid. It belongs to Set of superficial muscles of neck and Set of anterolateral muscles of neck.

FMA13410.name: subclavius
FMA13410.text: Subclavius is a pectoral muscle. Its nerve supply includes Subclavian nerve. It belongs to Pectoral musculature and Musculature of pectoral girdle.

FMA13411.name: left subclavius
FMA13411.text: Left subclavius is a subclavius. It forms part of Superficial chest wall, Female anterior superficial chest wall and Male anterior superficial chest wall, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Left subclavian nerve. It belongs to Musculature of thorax and Left pectoral musculature.

FMA13412.name: right subclavius
FMA13412.text: Right subclavius is a subclavius. It forms part of Anterior superficial chest wall, Male anterior superficial chest wall and Superficial chest wall, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Right subclavian nerve. It belongs to Musculature of thorax and Right pectoral musculature.

FMA13413.name: subscapularis
FMA13413.text: Subscapularis is an intrinsic muscle of shoulder. Its nerve supply includes Subscapularis branch of superior subscapular nerve (1) and Subscapularis branch of superior subscapular nerve (2). It belongs to Set of intrinsic muscles of shoulder, Set of rotator cuff muscles and Musculature of pectoral girdle.

FMA13414.name: right subscapularis
FMA13414.text: Right subscapularis is a subscapularis. Its origin is on Right subscapular fossa. Its insertion is on Lesser tubercle of right humerus. Its nerve supply includes Subscapularis branch of right superior subscapular nerve (2) and Subscapularis branch of right superior subscapular nerve (1).

FMA13415.name: left subscapularis
FMA13415.text: Left subscapularis is a subscapularis. Its origin is on Left subscapular fossa. Its insertion is on Lesser tubercle of left humerus. Its nerve supply includes Subscapularis branch of left superior subscapular nerve (1) and Subscapularis branch of left superior subscapular nerve (2).

FMA13442.name: anterior segmental vein
FMA13442.text: Segmental pulmonary vein, each instance of which drains the anterior segment of the superior lobe of some lung. It forms part of Anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13443.name: posterior segmental vein
FMA13443.text: Posterior segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. Anatomical type — Pulmonary vein: Vein in the pulmonary vemnous system.

FMA13444.name: apical segmental vein
FMA13444.text: Segmental pulmonary vein, each instance of which drains the apical segment of the superior lobe of some lung. Anatomical type — Pulmonary vein: Vein in the pulmonary vemnous system.

FMA13445.name: superior segmental vein
FMA13445.text: Superior segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Inferior pulmonary venous tree and Intrapulmonary part of inferior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Superior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA13495.name: intervertebral disk of second thoracic vertebra
FMA13495.text: Intervertebral disk of second thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Second thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13500.name: intervertebral disk of third thoracic vertebra
FMA13500.text: Intervertebral disk of third thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Third thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13501.name: intervertebral disk of fourth thoracic vertebra
FMA13501.text: Intervertebral disk of fourth thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Fourth thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13502.name: intervertebral disk of fifth thoracic vertebra
FMA13502.text: Intervertebral disk of fifth thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Fifth thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13503.name: intervertebral disk of sixth thoracic vertebra
FMA13503.text: Intervertebral disk of sixth thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Sixth thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13504.name: intervertebral disk of seventh thoracic vertebra
FMA13504.text: Intervertebral disk of seventh thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Seventh thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13505.name: intervertebral disk of eighth thoracic vertebra
FMA13505.text: Intervertebral disk of eighth thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Eighth thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13506.name: intervertebral disk of ninth thoracic vertebra
FMA13506.text: Intervertebral disk of ninth thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Ninth thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13507.name: intervertebral disk of tenth thoracic vertebra
FMA13507.text: Intervertebral disk of tenth thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Tenth thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13508.name: intervertebral disk of eleventh thoracic vertebra
FMA13508.text: Intervertebral disk of eleventh thoracic vertebra is an intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra. It forms part of Eleventh thoracic intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13883.name: wall of atrium
FMA13883.text: Wall of cardiac chamber that surrounds the cavity of an atrium. It forms part of Cardiac atrium. It is continuous with Wall of ventricle.

FMA13884.name: wall of ventricle
FMA13884.text: Wall of cardiac chamber that surrounds the cavity of a ventricle. It forms part of Cardiac ventricle. It is continuous with Wall of atrium.

FMA13889.name: pituitary gland
FMA13889.text: Lobular organ, each instance of which is an epithelial body located at the base of some brain in the sella turcica, attached by a stalk to some hypothalamus, from which it receives an important neural and vascular outflow. It consists of two lobes of differing embryonic origin, the anterior lobe (adenohypophysis), which secretes most of the hormones, and the posterior lobe (neurohypophysis), which stores and releases neurohormones that it receives from the hypothalamus. It is contained in Hypophysial fossa. Its arterial supply includes Medial branch of right inferior hypophyseal artery, Lateral branch of left inferior hypophyseal artery and Left superior hypophyseal artery, among other structures. Its venous drainage includes Inferior hypophyseal vein and Dural venous sinus.

FMA13894.name: intervertebral disk of lumbar vertebra
FMA13894.text: Intervertebral disk of lumbar vertebra is an intervertebral disk.

FMA13895.name: intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra
FMA13895.text: Intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra is an intervertebral disk.

FMA13896.name: intervertebral disk of third cervical vertebra
FMA13896.text: Intervertebral disk of third cervical vertebra is an intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra. It forms part of Third cervical intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13897.name: intervertebral disk of fourth cervical vertebra
FMA13897.text: Intervertebral disk of fourth cervical vertebra is an intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra. It forms part of Fourth cervical intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13898.name: intervertebral disk of fifth cervical vertebra
FMA13898.text: Intervertebral disk of fifth cervical vertebra is an intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra. It forms part of Fifth cervical intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13899.name: intervertebral disk of sixth cervical vertebra
FMA13899.text: Intervertebral disk of sixth cervical vertebra is an intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra. It forms part of Sixth cervical intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13900.name: intervertebral disk of seventh cervical vertebra
FMA13900.text: Intervertebral disk of seventh cervical vertebra is an intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra. It forms part of Seventh cervical intervertebral symphysis.

FMA13912.name: ventricular branch of right coronary artery
FMA13912.text: Ventricular branch of right coronary artery is a branch of right coronary artery. It supplies blood to Myocardium of right ventricle and Right ventricle.

FMA13914.name: anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA13914.text: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which supplies both the cardiac ventricles and the interventricular septum. It branches from Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Left ventricle, Interventricular septum and Right ventricle.

FMA13921.name: branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA13921.text: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery is a branch of left coronary artery. Anatomical type — Coronary artery: Systemic artery which supplies the heart.

FMA14065.name: organ component
FMA14065.text: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries. Anatomical type — Cardinal organ part: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts some instance of portions of two or more types of tissue and is continuous with some instance of one or more anatomical structures, likewise constituted by some portions of two or more tissues distinct from those of their complement.

FMA14092.name: zone of small intestine
FMA14092.text: Segment of small intestine is an organ segment. Anatomical type — Organ segment: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA14177.name: bronchial branch of arch of aorta
FMA14177.text: Bronchial branch of arch of aorta is a variant bronchial artery.

FMA14284.name: venous tree organ
FMA14284.text: Blood vessel tree organ, the organ parts of which are veins. Anatomical type — Blood vessel tree organ: Vascular tree organ the entire lumen of which contains blood.

FMA14293.name: tributary of internal thoracic vein
FMA14293.text: Tributary of internal thoracic vein is a subdivision of brachiocephalic vein.

FMA14294.name: tributary of azygos vein
FMA14294.text: Tributary of azygos vein is a subdivision of superior systemic venous tree. Anatomical type — Systemic vein: Vein in the systemic venous system.

FMA14309.name: subsegmental part of apical segmental vein
FMA14309.text: Subsegmental part of apical segmental vein is a subsegmental pulmonary vein. Anatomical type — Pulmonary vein: Vein in the pulmonary vemnous system.

FMA14310.name: subsegmental part of anterior segmental vein
FMA14310.text: Subsegmental part of anterior segmental vein is a subsegmental pulmonary vein. Anatomical type — Pulmonary vein: Vein in the pulmonary vemnous system.

FMA14317.name: tributary of external jugular vein
FMA14317.text: Tributary of external jugular vein is a tributary of subclavian vein.

FMA14319.name: suprascapular vein
FMA14319.text: Suprascapular vein is a tributary of external jugular vein. It is a tributary of External jugular vein. It drains into External jugular vein.

FMA14329.name: trunk of portal vein
FMA14329.text: Trunk of portal vein is a venous trunk. Anatomical type — Venous trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the atria of the heart, directly or indirectly through tributaries of the venae cavae, pulmonary veins and the hepatic and portal veins.

FMA14331.name: splenic vein
FMA14331.text: Splenic vein is a tributary of pre-hepatic portal vein. It is a tributary of Pre-hepatic portal vein.

FMA14332.name: superior mesenteric vein
FMA14332.text: Superior mesenteric vein is a tributary of pre-hepatic portal vein. It is a tributary of Pre-hepatic portal vein.

FMA14333.name: common iliac vein
FMA14333.text: Common iliac vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava.

FMA14334.name: renal vein
FMA14334.text: Renal vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA14335.name: right renal vein
FMA14335.text: Right renal vein is a renal vein. It is a tributary of Inferior systemic venous tree and Inferior vena cava.

FMA14336.name: left renal vein
FMA14336.text: Left renal vein is a renal vein. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava and Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA14337.name: hepatic vein
FMA14337.text: Hepatic vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA14338.name: right hepatic vein
FMA14338.text: Right hepatic vein is a hepatic vein. It is a tributary of Inferior systemic venous tree and Inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Vasculature of liver.

FMA14339.name: left hepatic vein
FMA14339.text: Left hepatic vein is a hepatic vein. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava and Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA14340.name: middle hepatic vein
FMA14340.text: Middle hepatic vein is a hepatic vein. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava and Inferior systemic venous tree. It is a regional part of Vasculature of liver.

FMA14341.name: right testicular vein
FMA14341.text: Testicular vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some inferior vena cava that drains some right pampiniform plexus. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava and Inferior systemic venous tree. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree. It drains into Inferior vena cava.

FMA14343.name: right suprarenal vein
FMA14343.text: Suprarenal vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some inferior vena cava that drains some right suprarenal gland. It is a tributary of Inferior systemic venous tree and Inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree. It drains into Inferior vena cava.

FMA14344.name: testicular vein
FMA14344.text: Testicular vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava.

FMA14345.name: left testicular vein
FMA14345.text: Testicular vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some left renal vein that drains some left pampiniform plexus. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree. It drains into Left renal vein.

FMA14348.name: suprarenal vein
FMA14348.text: Suprarenal vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. Anatomical type — Systemic vein: Vein in the systemic venous system.

FMA14349.name: left suprarenal vein
FMA14349.text: Suprarenal vein, each instance of which is a tributary of some left renal vein that drains some left suprarenal gland; it usually receives some left inferior phrenic vein. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree. It drains into Left renal vein.

FMA14495.name: segment of liver
FMA14495.text: Lobular segment in liver demarcated by the internal distribution pattern of the portal triad and/or the hepatic veins. It is a regional part of Lobe of liver.

FMA14539.name: cystic duct
FMA14539.text: Cystic duct is an extrahepatic bile duct. It is a regional part of Biliary tree. It is continuous with Gallbladder.

FMA14540.name: segment of large intestine
FMA14540.text: Organ segment which is regional part of large intestine. Anatomical type — Organ segment: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA14542.name: appendix
FMA14542.text: Organ with organ cavity, each instance of which is continuous proximally with some cecum and distally terminates at its tip. It is a regional part of Lower gastrointestinal tract. It is contained in Abdominal cavity. Its nerve supply includes Celiac ganglion and Superior mesenteric ganglion.

FMA14544.name: rectum
FMA14544.text: Rectum is a segment of large intestine. It is a regional part of Lower gastrointestinal tract and Large intestine. It forms part of Content of male pelvis. It is continuous with Sigmoid colon and Anal canal.

FMA14545.name: ascending colon
FMA14545.text: Organ part which is continuous with the cecum proximally and the transverse colon distally. It is a regional part of Right colon, Lower gastrointestinal tract and Colon. It is continuous with Cecum and Transverse colon. It belongs to Set of viscera of abdomen proper.

FMA14546.name: transverse colon
FMA14546.text: Transverse colon is a segment of colon. It is a regional part of Colon and Lower gastrointestinal tract. It is continuous with Wall of ascending colon, Descending colon and Ascending colon.

FMA14547.name: descending colon
FMA14547.text: Descending colon is a segment of colon. It is a regional part of Colon, Lower gastrointestinal tract and Left colon. It is continuous with Transverse colon and Sigmoid colon.

FMA14643.name: mesentery of small intestine

FMA14645.name: mesentery of large intestine

FMA14647.name: transverse mesocolon

FMA14755.name: right middle suprarenal artery
FMA14755.text: Right middle suprarenal artery is a middle suprarenal artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It supplies blood to Right adrenal gland.

FMA14756.name: left middle suprarenal artery
FMA14756.text: Left middle suprarenal artery is a middle suprarenal artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It supplies blood to Left adrenal gland.

FMA14758.name: testicular artery

FMA14759.text: Right testicular artery is a testicular artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It supplies blood to Right ureter and Right testis.

FMA14760.name: left testicular artery
FMA14760.text: Left testicular artery is a testicular artery. It branches from Systemic arterial tree. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It supplies blood to Left ureter and Left testis.

FMA14766.name: left common iliac artery

FMA14767.text: Trunk of branch of coeliac artery is a systemic arterial trunk. Anatomical type — Arterial trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the ventricles of the heart, directly or indirectly through branches of the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

FMA14768.name: left gastric artery
FMA14768.text: Left gastric artery is a branch of celiac artery. It branches from Celiac artery. It is a regional part of Celiac artery. It supplies blood to Stomach.

FMA14769.name: hepatic artery
FMA14769.text: Hepatic artery is a branch of hepatic artery proper.

FMA14771.text: Common hepatic artery is a branch of celiac artery. It branches from Celiac artery. It is a regional part of Celiac artery.

FMA14772.name: hepatic artery proper
FMA14772.text: Hepatic artery proper is a branch of common hepatic artery. It branches from Common hepatic artery. It is a regional part of Common hepatic artery. It supplies blood to Liver.

FMA14773.name: splenic artery
FMA14773.text: Splenic artery is a branch of celiac artery. It branches from Celiac artery. It is a regional part of Celiac artery.

FMA14776.name: right gastric artery

FMA14781.name: right gastro-epiploic artery
FMA14781.text: Right gastro-epiploic artery is a branch of gastroduodenal artery. It branches from Gastroduodenal artery. It supplies blood to Small intestine.

FMA14782.name: anterior superior pancreaticoduodenal artery

FMA14784.text: Posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal artery is a superior pancreaticoduodenal artery. It branches from Gastroduodenal artery. It supplies blood to Gallbladder.

FMA14792.text: Great pancreatic artery is a pancreatic artery. It branches from Splenic artery. It supplies blood to Pancreas.

FMA14805.name: inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery

FMA14812.name: celiac trunk
FMA14812.text: Systemic arterial trunk, each instance of which is the arterial trunk that arises from some abdominal aorta, gives off trunks of some left gastric, common hepatic, and splenic arteries, and supplies the abdominal segment of some esophagus, stomach, duodenum, spleen, pancreas, liver, and gallbladder. It is a regional part of Celiac artery. It is continuous with Aorta.

FMA14815.name: ileocolic artery
FMA14815.text: Ileocolic artery is a branch of superior mesenteric artery. It branches from Superior mesenteric artery. It is a regional part of Superior mesenteric artery.

FMA14816.name: anterior cecal artery
FMA14816.text: Anterior cecal artery is a branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Inferior branch of ileocolic artery.

FMA14817.name: posterior cecal artery
FMA14817.text: Posterior cecal artery is a branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Inferior branch of ileocolic artery.

FMA14818.name: appendicular artery
FMA14818.text: Appendicular artery is a branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It supplies blood to Appendix.

FMA14819.name: ileal branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery
FMA14819.text: Ileal branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery is a branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Inferior branch of ileocolic artery.

FMA14820.name: ascending branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery
FMA14820.text: Ascending branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery is a branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Inferior branch of ileocolic artery.

FMA14821.name: branch of ileocolic artery
FMA14821.text: Branch of ileocolic artery is a branch of superior mesenteric artery. Anatomical type — Systemic artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which carries oxygenated blood from some heart.

FMA14824.text: Marginal colic artery is a branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Inferior branch of ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Inferior branch of ileocolic artery.

FMA14826.name: left colic artery

FMA14829.name: descending branch of left colic artery

FMA14831.name: marginal artery of colon
FMA14831.text: Marginal artery of colon is a branch of inferior mesenteric artery. It branches from Inferior mesenteric artery. It is a regional part of Inferior mesenteric artery.

FMA14832.name: superior rectal artery
FMA14832.text: Superior rectal artery is a branch of inferior mesenteric artery. It branches from Inferior mesenteric artery. It is a regional part of Inferior mesenteric artery.

FMA14837.text: Branch of hepatic artery proper is a branch of common hepatic artery.

FMA14963.text: Zone of ileum is a zone of small intestine. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA14964.name: proximal part of ileum

FMA15042.name: taenia mesocolica
FMA15042.text: Taenia mesocolica is a taenia coli. It is a regional part of Muscle layer of large intestine.

FMA15043.name: taenia omentalis
FMA15043.text: Taenia omentalis is a taenia coli. It is a regional part of Muscle layer of large intestine.

FMA15044.name: taenia libera
FMA15044.text: Taenia libera is a taenia coli. It is a regional part of Muscle layer of large intestine.

FMA15387.text: Tributary of splenic vein is a tributary of pre-hepatic portal vein.

FMA15392.text: Tributary of inferior mesenteric vein is a tributary of splenic vein.

FMA15394.name: left colic vein
FMA15394.text: Left colic vein is a tributary of inferior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Inferior mesenteric vein.

FMA15395.name: sigmoid vein
FMA15395.text: Sigmoid vein is a tributary of inferior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Inferior mesenteric vein.

FMA15396.name: tributary of superior mesenteric vein
FMA15396.text: Tributary of superior mesenteric vein is a tributary of pre-hepatic portal vein.

FMA15397.name: right gastroepiploic vein
FMA15397.text: Right gastroepiploic vein is a tributary of superior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Superior mesenteric vein.

FMA15398.name: pancreaticoduodenal vein
FMA15398.text: Tributary of superior mesenteric vein, each instance of which drains blood from some duodenum and pancreas. It is a tributary of Trunk of portal vein and Superior mesenteric vein.

FMA15399.name: left gastric vein
FMA15399.text: Left gastric vein is a tributary of superior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Trunk of portal vein and Superior mesenteric vein.

FMA15400.name: right gastric vein
FMA15400.text: Right gastric vein is a tributary of superior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Trunk of portal vein and Superior mesenteric vein.

FMA15405.text: Ileal vein is a tributary of superior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Superior mesenteric vein.

FMA15406.text: Middle colic vein is a tributary of superior mesenteric vein. It is a tributary of Superior mesenteric vein.

FMA15571.name: right ureter
FMA15571.text: Right ureter is an ureter. It is a regional part of Right upper urinary tract. Its nerve supply includes Right ureteric nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Ureteral part of right uterine artery, Right inferior vesical artery and Right testicular artery, among other structures.

FMA15572.name: left ureter
FMA15572.text: Left ureter is an ureter. It is a regional part of Left upper urinary tract. Its nerve supply includes Left ureteric nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Ureteral part of left uterine artery, Ureteric segment of left renal artery and Ureteral part of left inferior vesical artery, among other structures.

FMA15629.name: right adrenal gland
FMA15629.text: Right adrenal gland is an adrenal gland. It is contained in Space of right side of retroperitoneal compartment. Its nerve supply includes Right suprarenal nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Right superior suprarenal artery, Subcapsular arterial plexus of right adrenal gland and Right inferior suprarenal artery, among other structures.

FMA15630.name: left adrenal gland
FMA15630.text: Left adrenal gland is an adrenal gland. It is contained in Space of left side of retroperitoneal compartment. Its nerve supply includes Left suprarenal nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Left superior suprarenal artery, Left inferior suprarenal artery and Subcapsular arterial plexus of left adrenal gland, among other structures.

FMA15800.text: Anterior inferior segmental tributary of middle hepatic vein is a tributary of middle hepatic vein. It is a tributary of Middle hepatic vein. It is a regional part of Middle hepatic vein.

FMA15900.name: urinary bladder
FMA15900.text: A distensible muscular organ in the pelvis that collects and stores urine before it is expelled through the urethra.

FMA16033.name: intervertebral disk of first lumbar vertebra
FMA16033.text: Intervertebral disk of first lumbar vertebra is an intervertebral disk of lumbar vertebra. It forms part of First lumbar intervertebral symphysis.

FMA16034.name: intervertebral disk of second lumbar vertebra
FMA16034.text: Intervertebral disk of second lumbar vertebra is an intervertebral disk of lumbar vertebra. It forms part of Second lumbar intervertebral symphysis.

FMA16202.name: sacrum
FMA16202.text: Bone complex which has as its direct parts five sacral vertebrae. It is a regional part of Lumbosacral vertebral column, Bony pelvis and Vertebral column. It forms part of Wall of male pelvis, Skeletal system of back of abdomen and Posterior part of pelvis, among other structures. It belongs to Pelvic skeleton.

FMA16549.name: mesoappendix
FMA16549.text: Mesoappendix is a mesentery of zone of large intestine. It is a regional part of Visceral peritoneum.

FMA16585.name: hip bone
FMA16585.text: Bone complex which has as its direct parts ilium, ischium and pubis. It forms part of Subdivision of pelvic girdle and Hip.

FMA16586.name: right hip bone
FMA16586.text: Hip bone in right lower limb. It forms part of Right side of pelvic girdle, Right hip and Right side of bony pelvis. It belongs to Skeleton of right lower limb and Pelvic skeleton.

FMA16587.name: left hip bone
FMA16587.text: Hip bone in left lower limb. It forms part of Left hip, Left side of pelvic girdle and Left side of bony pelvis. It belongs to Skeleton of left lower limb and Pelvic skeleton.

FMA16980.name: zone of jejunum
FMA16980.text: Zone of jejunum is a zone of small intestine. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA16981.name: proximal part of jejunum

FMA18060.name: psoas major
FMA18060.text: Psoas major is a psoas muscle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to psoas major. It belongs to Set of prevertebral muscles and Musculature of back of body proper.

FMA18247.name: glans penis
FMA18247.text: Glans penis is a zone of corpus spongiosum of penis. It is a regional part of Corpus spongiosum of penis and Penis.

FMA18255.name: epididymis
FMA18255.text: Convoluted duct structure posterior to the testis where one end (head of epidydimis) receives multiple efferent ductules from the testis and then drains to a single, larger caliber duct (body and tail of epidydimis) that continuous into the ductus deferens. It is a regional part of Male genital duct. It is continuous with Deferent duct.

FMA18256.name: right epididymis
FMA18256.text: Right epididymis is an epididymis. It is a regional part of Right male genital duct. It is continuous with Right deferent duct.

FMA18257.name: left epididymis
FMA18257.text: Left epididymis is an epididymis. It is a regional part of Left male genital duct. It is continuous with Left deferent duct.

FMA18805.name: external iliac artery
FMA18805.text: External iliac artery is a systemic artery. It branches from Common iliac artery. It is a regional part of Common iliac artery.

FMA18806.name: right external iliac artery
FMA18806.text: Right external iliac artery is an external iliac artery. It branches from Right common iliac artery. It is a regional part of Right common iliac artery.

FMA18807.name: left external iliac artery
FMA18807.text: Left external iliac artery is an external iliac artery. It branches from Left common iliac artery. It is a regional part of Left common iliac artery.

FMA18808.name: internal iliac artery
FMA18808.text: Internal iliac artery is a systemic artery. It branches from Common iliac artery. It is a regional part of Common iliac artery.

FMA18809.name: right internal iliac artery
FMA18809.text: Right internal iliac artery is an internal iliac artery. It branches from Right common iliac artery. It is a regional part of Right common iliac artery.

FMA18810.name: left internal iliac artery
FMA18810.text: Left internal iliac artery is an internal iliac artery. It branches from Left common iliac artery. It is a regional part of Left common iliac artery.

FMA18883.text: External iliac vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a tributary of Common iliac vein.

FMA18884.name: internal iliac vein
FMA18884.text: Internal iliac vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a tributary of Common iliac vein. It is continuous with Lateral sacral vein and Vesical venous plexus.

FMA18885.name: right external iliac vein
FMA18885.text: Right external iliac vein is an external iliac vein. It is a tributary of Right common iliac vein. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA18886.name: left external iliac vein
FMA18886.text: Left external iliac vein is an external iliac vein. It is a tributary of Left common iliac vein. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA18887.name: right internal iliac vein
FMA18887.text: Right internal iliac vein is an internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Right common iliac vein. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA18888.name: left internal iliac vein
FMA18888.text: Left internal iliac vein is an internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Left common iliac vein. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA18889.name: tributary of internal iliac vein
FMA18889.text: Tributary of internal iliac vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. Anatomical type — Systemic vein: Vein in the systemic venous system.

FMA18902.name: iliolumbar vein
FMA18902.text: Iliolumbar vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Internal iliac vein. It drains into Internal iliac vein.

FMA18903.name: right iliolumbar vein
FMA18903.text: Right iliolumbar vein is an iliolumbar vein. It is a tributary of Right internal iliac vein.

FMA18904.name: left iliolumbar vein
FMA18904.text: Left iliolumbar vein is an iliolumbar vein. It is a tributary of Left internal iliac vein.

FMA18905.name: lateral sacral vein
FMA18905.text: Lateral sacral vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Internal iliac vein. It drains into Internal iliac vein. It is continuous with Internal iliac vein and Sacral intervertebral vein.

FMA18906.name: right lateral sacral vein
FMA18906.text: Right lateral sacral vein is a lateral sacral vein. It is a tributary of Right internal iliac vein.

FMA18907.name: left lateral sacral vein
FMA18907.text: Left lateral sacral vein is a lateral sacral vein. It is a tributary of Left internal iliac vein.

FMA18908.name: superior gluteal vein
FMA18908.text: Superior gluteal vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Internal iliac vein. It is contained in Greater sciatic foramen. It drains into Internal iliac vein.

FMA18909.name: right superior gluteal vein
FMA18909.text: Right superior gluteal vein is a superior gluteal vein. It is a tributary of Right internal iliac vein. It is contained in Right greater sciatic foramen.

FMA18910.name: left superior gluteal vein
FMA18910.text: Left superior gluteal vein is a superior gluteal vein. It is a tributary of Left internal iliac vein. It is contained in Left greater sciatic foramen.

FMA18911.name: inferior gluteal vein
FMA18911.text: Inferior gluteal vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Internal iliac vein. It is contained in Greater sciatic foramen. It drains into Internal iliac vein.

FMA18912.name: right inferior gluteal vein
FMA18912.text: Right inferior gluteal vein is an inferior gluteal vein. It is a tributary of Right internal iliac vein. It is contained in Right greater sciatic foramen.

FMA18913.name: left inferior gluteal vein
FMA18913.text: Left inferior gluteal vein is an inferior gluteal vein. It is a tributary of Left internal iliac vein. It is contained in Left greater sciatic foramen.

FMA18914.name: obturator vein
FMA18914.text: Obturator vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Internal iliac vein. It drains into Internal iliac vein.

FMA18915.name: right obturator vein
FMA18915.text: Right obturator vein is an obturator vein. It is a tributary of Right internal iliac vein.

FMA18916.name: left obturator vein
FMA18916.text: Left obturator vein is an obturator vein. It is a tributary of Left internal iliac vein.

FMA18917.name: internal pudendal vein
FMA18917.text: Internal pudendal vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein. It is a tributary of Internal iliac vein. It is contained in Greater sciatic foramen. It drains into Internal iliac vein.

FMA18918.name: right internal pudendal vein
FMA18918.text: Right internal pudendal vein is an internal pudendal vein. It is a tributary of Right internal iliac vein. It is contained in Right greater sciatic foramen.

FMA18919.name: left internal pudendal vein
FMA18919.text: Left internal pudendal vein is an internal pudendal vein. It is a tributary of Left internal iliac vein. It is contained in Left greater sciatic foramen.

FMA19082.name: piriformis
FMA19082.text: Piriformis is a gluteal muscle. It is contained in Greater sciatic foramen. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to piriformis. It belongs to Musculature of hip.

FMA19083.name: obturator muscle
FMA19083.text: Obturator muscle is a gluteal muscle.

FMA19086.name: muscle of pelvis
FMA19086.text: Muscle (organ) which is a part of the pelvis. Anatomical type — Muscle of trunk: Muscle organ which is a part of the trunk.

FMA19088.name: coccygeus
FMA19088.text: Coccygeus is a muscle of pelvis. Its nerve supply includes Branch of sacral nerve plexus to coccygeus.

FMA19089.name: zone of levator ani
FMA19089.text: Zone of levator ani is a zone of muscle organ. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA19092.name: iliococcygeus
FMA19092.text: Iliococcygeus is a zone of levator ani. It forms part of Levator ani.

FMA19234.name: deferent duct
FMA19234.text: Deferent duct is a duct. It is a regional part of Male genital duct. Its arterial supply includes Inferior vesical artery and Ductus deferens part of inferior vesical artery. It is continuous with Ejaculatory duct and Epididymis.

FMA19235.name: right deferent duct
FMA19235.text: Right deferent duct is a deferent duct. It is a regional part of Right male genital duct. It forms part of Content of male pelvis. Its arterial supply includes Right inferior vesical artery and Ductus deferens part of right inferior vesical artery.

FMA19236.name: left deferent duct
FMA19236.text: Left deferent duct is a deferent duct. It is a regional part of Left male genital duct. It forms part of Content of male pelvis. Its arterial supply includes Ductus deferens part of left inferior vesical artery and Left inferior vesical artery.

FMA19386.name: seminal vesicle
FMA19386.text: Seminal vesicle is an organ component gland. It is a regional part of Male genital duct. Its arterial supply includes Seminal vesicle part of inferior vesical artery and Inferior vesical artery.

FMA19387.name: right seminal vesicle
FMA19387.text: Right seminal vesicle is a seminal vesicle. It is a regional part of Right male genital duct. It forms part of Content of male pelvis. Its arterial supply includes Seminal vesicle part of right inferior vesical artery and Right inferior vesical artery.

FMA19388.name: left seminal vesicle
FMA19388.text: Left seminal vesicle is a seminal vesicle. It is a regional part of Left male genital duct. It forms part of Content of male pelvis. Its arterial supply includes Left inferior vesical artery and Seminal vesicle part of left inferior vesical artery.

FMA19617.name: corpus spongiosum of penis
FMA19617.text: Cavernous organ, located on the ventral aspect of the penis. It forms part of Body of penis.

FMA19618.name: corpus cavernosum of penis
FMA19618.text: Corpus cavernosum of penis is a corpus cavernosum. It forms part of Body of penis.

FMA19667.name: urethra
FMA19667.text: Organ with organ cavity, each intance of which connects some cavity of the urinary bladder to the exterior. It is a regional part of Lower urinary tract. It is continuous with Urinary bladder.

FMA19728.name: superficial perineal muscle
FMA19728.text: Superficial perineal muscle is a perineal muscle. Anatomical type — Muscle of trunk: Muscle organ which is a part of the trunk.

FMA19754.name: region of peritoneum
FMA19754.text: Region of peritoneum is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA19783.name: loose connective tissue
FMA19783.text: Irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a sparse irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Anatomical type — Irregular connective tissue: Connective tissue, which consists of a population of connective tissue cells, the intercellular matrix of which contains an irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles.

FMA19795.name: dorsal artery of penis
FMA19795.text: Dorsal artery of penis is a subdivision of internal pudendal artery. It branches from Internal pudendal artery. It forms part of Penis.

FMA20107.name: irregular connective tissue
FMA20107.text: Connective tissue, which consists of a population of connective tissue cells, the intercellular matrix of which contains an irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Anatomical type — Portion of connective tissue: Tissue which consists of fibroblasts, osteocytes or chondrocytes and intercellular matrix produced by these cells.

FMA20111.name: mucoid tissue
FMA20111.text: Loose connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which consists predominantly of mucoid ground substance. Anatomical type — Loose connective tissue: Irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a sparse irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles.

FMA20194.name: cavernous organ
FMA20194.text: Organ with cavitated organ parts, each instance of which consist of some fibrous trabeculae and endothelial wall that surround some cavernous (vascular) spaces. Anatomical type — Organ with cavitated organ parts: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround two or more macroscopic anatomical spaces.

FMA20221.name: zone of cavernous organ
FMA20221.text: Zone of cavernous organ is an organ zone. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA20247.name: zone of corpus spongiosum of penis
FMA20247.text: Zone of corpus spongiosum of penis is a zone of cavernous organ. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA20278.name: muscle of anterior abdominal wall
FMA20278.text: Muscle of anterior abdominal wall is a muscle of abdomen. Anatomical type — Muscle of abdomen: Muscle (organ) which is a part of the abdomen.

FMA20289.name: lacrimal sac
FMA20289.text: Lacrimal sac is a segment of lacrimal duct. It is a regional part of Lacrimal duct.

FMA20570.name: peritoneal mesentery
FMA20570.text: Peritoneal mesentery is a region of visceral peritoneum. It is a regional part of Visceral peritoneum.

FMA20593.name: region of visceral peritoneum
FMA20593.text: Region of visceral peritoneum is a region of peritoneum. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA20684.name: trunk of branch of external iliac artery
FMA20684.text: Trunk of branch of external iliac artery is a trunk of branch of common iliac artery.

FMA20688.name: right inferior epigastric artery
FMA20688.text: Right inferior epigastric artery is an inferior epigastric artery. It branches from Right external iliac artery. It is a regional part of Right external iliac artery.

FMA20689.name: left inferior epigastric artery
FMA20689.text: Left inferior epigastric artery is an inferior epigastric artery. It branches from Left external iliac artery. It is a regional part of Left external iliac artery.

FMA20734.name: superficial epigastric artery
FMA20734.text: Superficial epigastric artery is a branch of femoral artery. It branches from Femoral artery. It is a regional part of Femoral artery and External iliac artery.

FMA20735.name: right superficial epigastric artery
FMA20735.text: Right superficial epigastric artery is a superficial epigastric artery. It branches from Right femoral artery. It is a regional part of Right femoral artery.

FMA20736.name: left superficial epigastric artery
FMA20736.text: Left superficial epigastric artery is a superficial epigastric artery. It branches from Left femoral artery. It is a regional part of Left femoral artery.

FMA20798.name: lateral circumflex femoral artery

FMA20801.name: right lateral circumflex femoral artery
FMA20801.text: Right lateral circumflex femoral artery is a lateral circumflex femoral artery. It branches from Right deep femoral artery. It is a regional part of Right deep femoral artery.

FMA20802.name: left lateral circumflex femoral artery
FMA20802.text: Left lateral circumflex femoral artery is a lateral circumflex femoral artery. It branches from Left deep femoral artery. It is a regional part of Left deep femoral artery.

FMA20803.name: branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
FMA20803.text: Branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery is a subdivision of deep femoral artery.

FMA20805.name: descending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
FMA20805.text: Descending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery is a branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery. It branches from Lateral circumflex femoral artery.

FMA20818.name: right dorsal artery of penis
FMA20818.text: Right dorsal artery of penis is a dorsal artery of penis. It branches from Right internal pudendal artery.

FMA20819.name: left dorsal artery of penis
FMA20819.text: Left dorsal artery of penis is a dorsal artery of penis. It branches from Left internal pudendal artery.
