FMA21163.name: right inferior epigastric vein
FMA21163.text: Right inferior epigastric vein is an inferior epigastric vein. It is a tributary of Right external iliac vein.

FMA21164.name: left inferior epigastric vein
FMA21164.text: Left inferior epigastric vein is an inferior epigastric vein. It is a tributary of Left external iliac vein.

FMA21185.name: femoral vein
FMA21185.text: Femoral vein is a subdivision of external iliac vein. It is a tributary of External iliac vein.

FMA21188.name: right femoral vein
FMA21188.text: Right femoral vein is a femoral vein. It is a tributary of Right external iliac vein. It is contained in Space of right adductor canal.

FMA21189.name: left femoral vein
FMA21189.text: Left femoral vein is a femoral vein. It is a tributary of Left external iliac vein. It is contained in Space of left adductor canal.

FMA21240.name: tributary of internal pudendal vein
FMA21240.text: Tributary of internal pudendal vein is a tributary of internal iliac vein.

FMA21376.name: great saphenous vein
FMA21376.text: Tributary of femoral vein, each instance of which extends from the dorsum of some foot to just below some inguinal ligament and drains the superficial structures of some lower limb, perineum, and lower abdominal wall through many tributaries, including the medial end of the dorsal venous arch of some foot, and the accessory saphenous, superficial external pudendal, superficial circumflex iliac, superficial epigastric, and numerous cutaneous veins. It is a tributary of Femoral vein. It drains into Femoral vein.

FMA21378.name: tributary of great saphenous vein
FMA21378.text: Tributary of great saphenous vein is a tributary of femoral vein.

FMA21379.name: right great saphenous vein
FMA21379.text: Right great saphenous vein is a great saphenous vein. It is a tributary of Right femoral vein.

FMA21380.name: left great saphenous vein
FMA21380.text: Left great saphenous vein is a great saphenous vein. It is a tributary of Left femoral vein.

FMA21383.name: tributary of superficial external pudendal vein
FMA21383.text: Tributary of superficial external pudendal vein is a tributary of great saphenous vein.

FMA21384.name: superficial dorsal vein of penis
FMA21384.text: Superficial dorsal vein of penis is a tributary of superficial external pudendal vein. It is a tributary of Superficial external pudendal vein. It forms part of Penis. It drains into Superficial external pudendal vein.

FMA21385.name: right superficial dorsal vein of penis
FMA21385.text: Right superficial dorsal vein of penis is a superficial dorsal vein of penis. It is a tributary of Right superficial external pudendal vein.

FMA21386.name: left superficial dorsal vein of penis
FMA21386.text: Left superficial dorsal vein of penis is a superficial dorsal vein of penis. It is a tributary of Left superficial external pudendal vein.

FMA21387.name: right common iliac vein
FMA21387.text: Right common iliac vein is a common iliac vein. It is a tributary of Inferior systemic venous tree and Inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA21388.name: left common iliac vein
FMA21388.text: Left common iliac vein is a common iliac vein. It is a tributary of Inferior vena cava and Inferior systemic venous tree. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA21422.name: descending branch of right lateral circumflex femoral artery
FMA21422.text: Descending branch of right lateral circumflex femoral artery is a descending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery. It branches from Right lateral circumflex femoral artery.

FMA21423.name: descending branch of left lateral circumflex femoral artery
FMA21423.text: Descending branch of left lateral circumflex femoral artery is a descending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery. It branches from Left lateral circumflex femoral artery.

FMA21496.name: ligament organ
FMA21496.text: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi by connective tissue. Anatomical type — Nonparenchymatous organ: Solid organ which consists of organ parts that are arranged as fascicles or sheets.

FMA21520.name: branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery
FMA21520.text: Branch of inferior branch of ileocolic artery is a branch of ileocolic artery.

FMA21521.name: trunk of branch of left colic artery
FMA21521.text: Trunk of branch of left colic artery is a trunk of branch of inferior mesenteric artery.

FMA24551.name: trunk of intrapulmonary vein
FMA24551.text: Trunk of intrapulmonary vein is a trunk of pulmonary vein. Anatomical type — Venous trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the atria of the heart, directly or indirectly through tributaries of the venae cavae, pulmonary veins and the hepatic and portal veins.

FMA25058.name: intervertebral disk of axis
FMA25058.text: Intervertebral disk of axis is an intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra. It forms part of Intervertebral symphysis of axis.

FMA25624.name: skeletal ligament
FMA25624.text: Ligament organ that primarily consists of regular dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi; connects bone and cartilage organs. Anatomical type — Ligament organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi by connective tissue.

FMA25625.name: nonskeletal ligament
FMA25625.text: Ligament organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi which may be admixed with smooth muscle. Anatomical type — Ligament organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi by connective tissue.

FMA30313.name: arterial trunk
FMA30313.text: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the ventricles of the heart, directly or indirectly through branches of the aorta and pulmonary trunk. Anatomical type — Blood vessel: Segment of blood vessel tree organ which is a tubular structure the lumen of which contains blood; together with other spatially associated blood vessels constitute blood vessel tree organ.

FMA30314.name: venous trunk
FMA30314.text: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the atria of the heart, directly or indirectly through tributaries of the venae cavae, pulmonary veins and the hepatic and portal veins. Anatomical type — Blood vessel: Segment of blood vessel tree organ which is a tubular structure the lumen of which contains blood; together with other spatially associated blood vessels constitute blood vessel tree organ.

FMA30320.name: duct
FMA30320.text: Organ segment which consists of a wall lined with epithelial cells and which encloses a lumen. Anatomical type — Organ segment: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA31739.name: segment of bronchial tree
FMA31739.text: Segment of bronchial tree is a segment of tracheobronchial tree. Anatomical type — Segment of tracheobronchial tree: Organ segment which is regional part of tracheobronchial tree.

FMA32514.name: prevertebral muscle

FMA32515.name: postvertebral muscle
FMA32515.text: Postvertebral muscle is a muscle of vertebral column.

FMA32516.name: extrinsic muscle of shoulder
FMA32516.text: Extrinsic muscle of shoulder is a muscle of shoulder.

FMA32518.text: Deep extrinsic muscle of shoulder is an extrinsic muscle of shoulder.

FMA32519.name: levator scapulae
FMA32519.text: Levator scapulae is a deep extrinsic muscle of shoulder. Its origin is on Transverse process of third cervical vertebra, Transverse process of fourth cervical vertebra and Transverse process of axis, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Levator scapulae branch of dorsal scapular nerve, C4 branch to levator scapulae and C3 branch to levator scapulae. It belongs to Musculature of pectoral girdle, Scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of shoulder.

FMA32520.name: intrinsic muscle of shoulder
FMA32520.text: Intrinsic muscle of shoulder is a muscle of shoulder.

FMA32525.name: rectus capitis posterior major
FMA32525.text: Rectus capitis posterior major is a posterior rectus capitis. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to rectus capitis posterior major. It belongs to Musculature of back of body proper.

FMA32526.name: rectus capitis posterior minor
FMA32526.text: Rectus capitis posterior minor is a posterior rectus capitis. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to rectus capitis posterior minor. It belongs to Musculature of back of body proper.

FMA32527.name: obliquus capitis superior
FMA32527.text: Obliquus capitis superior is a posterior suboccipital muscle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to obliquus capitis superior. It belongs to Musculature of back of body proper.

FMA32528.name: obliquus capitis inferior
FMA32528.text: Obliquus capitis inferior is a posterior suboccipital muscle. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to obliquus capitis inferior. It belongs to Musculature of back of body proper.

FMA32529.name: zone of trapezius
FMA32529.text: Zone of trapezius is a zone of muscle organ. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA32530.text: Right rectus capitis posterior major is a rectus capitis posterior major. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right rectus capitis posterior major. It belongs to Set of posterior suboccipital muscles.

FMA32531.name: left rectus capitis posterior major

FMA32532.name: right rectus capitis posterior minor

FMA32533.name: left rectus capitis posterior minor

FMA32534.name: right obliquus capitis superior

FMA32535.name: left obliquus capitis superior
FMA32535.text: Left obliquus capitis superior is an obliquus capitis superior. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left obliquus capitis superior. It belongs to Set of posterior suboccipital muscles.

FMA32536.name: right obliquus capitis inferior
FMA32536.text: Right obliquus capitis inferior is an obliquus capitis inferior. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right obliquus capitis inferior. It belongs to Set of posterior suboccipital muscles.

FMA32537.name: left obliquus capitis inferior
FMA32537.text: Left obliquus capitis inferior is an obliquus capitis inferior. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left obliquus capitis inferior. It belongs to Set of posterior suboccipital muscles.

FMA32540.name: right levator scapulae
FMA32540.text: Right levator scapulae is a levator scapulae. Its origin is on Right transverse process of axis, Right transverse process of fourth cervical vertebra and Right transverse process of atlas, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Levator scapulae branch of right dorsal scapular nerve, C3 branch to right levator scapulae and C4 branch to right levator scapulae. It belongs to Right scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of right shoulder.

FMA32541.name: left levator scapulae
FMA32541.text: Left levator scapulae is a levator scapulae. Its origin is on Left transverse process of third cervical vertebra, Left transverse process of fourth cervical vertebra and Left transverse process of axis, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes C4 branch to left levator scapulae, C3 branch to left levator scapulae and Levator scapulae branch of left dorsal scapular nerve. It belongs to Left scapular musculature and Set of deep extrinsic muscles of left shoulder.

FMA32544.name: right supraspinatus
FMA32544.text: Right supraspinatus is a supraspinatus. It forms part of Scapular part of right shoulder. Its origin is on Right supraspinous fossa. Its insertion is on Superior facet of greater tubercle of right humerus.

FMA32545.name: left supraspinatus
FMA32545.text: Left supraspinatus is a supraspinatus. It forms part of Scapular part of left shoulder. Its origin is on Left supraspinous fossa. Its insertion is on Superior facet of greater tubercle of left humerus.

FMA32546.name: infraspinatus
FMA32546.text: Infraspinatus is an intrinsic muscle of shoulder. It forms part of Scapular region of shoulder. Its origin is on Infraspinous part of spine of scapula. Its insertion is on Greater tubercle of humerus.

FMA32547.name: right infraspinatus muscle
FMA32547.text: Right infraspinatus is an infraspinatus. It forms part of Scapular part of right shoulder. Its origin is on Area of origin of right infraspinatus. Its insertion is on Middle facet of greater tubercle of right humerus.

FMA32548.name: left infraspinatus muscle
FMA32548.text: Left infraspinatus is an infraspinatus. It forms part of Scapular part of left shoulder. Its origin is on Area of origin of left infraspinatus. Its insertion is on Middle facet of greater tubercle of left humerus.

FMA32549.name: teres major
FMA32549.text: Teres major is an intrinsic muscle of shoulder. It forms part of Scapular region of shoulder. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to teres major. It belongs to Musculature of pectoral girdle, Set of intrinsic muscles of shoulder and Scapular musculature.

FMA32550.name: teres minor
FMA32550.text: Teres minor is an intrinsic muscle of shoulder. It forms part of Scapular region of shoulder. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to teres minor. It belongs to Scapular musculature, Set of rotator cuff muscles and Set of intrinsic muscles of shoulder, among other structures.

FMA32551.name: right teres major

FMA32552.name: left teres major

FMA32553.name: right teres minor
FMA32553.text: Right teres minor is a teres minor. It forms part of Scapular part of left shoulder and Scapular part of right shoulder. Its origin is on Area of origin of right teres minor. Its insertion is on Inferior facet of greater tubercle of right humerus.

FMA32554.name: left teres minor

FMA52746.name: palatine bone

FMA52749.name: hyoid bone

FMA52781.name: external ear

FMA52893.name: left zygomatic bone

FMA53650.name: left maxilla

FMA53655.name: right palatine bone

FMA53656.name: left palatine bone

FMA53667.name: hair

FMA54158.name: tendon of levator palpebrae superioris

FMA54241.name: hair of head

FMA54393.name: subdivision of face
FMA54393.text: Subdivision of face is a subdivision of head. Anatomical type — Subdivision of head: subdivision of cardinal body part, each instance of which is a regional part of some head.

FMA54640.name: tongue
FMA54640.text: Tongue is a heterogeneous anatomical cluster. It forms part of Floor of mouth. Its nerve supply includes Left hypoglossal nerve, Right lingual nerve and Left lingual nerve, among other structures. Its arterial supply includes Right ascending palatine artery, Right tonsillar artery and Right lingual artery, among other structures.

FMA54736.name: inferior nasal concha
FMA54736.text: Inferior nasal concha is an irregular bone. FMA54737.name: right inferior nasal concha

FMA54738.name: left inferior nasal concha

FMA54839.name: interosseous membrane
FMA54839.text: Interosseous membrane is a skeletal membrane organ. Anatomical type — Membrane organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue organized into a sheet which interconnects two or more organs, separates two or more body spaces from one another, or surrounds an organ or body part.

FMA54877.name: subdivision of pharynx
FMA54877.text: Subdivision of pharynx is a heterogeneous anatomical cluster. Anatomical type — Heterogeneous anatomical cluster: Anatomical cluster which has as its direct parts all or some members of two or more organ subclasses and one or more organ part subclasses which are grouped together according to some shared attributes.

FMA54921.name: extrinsic ligament of larynx
FMA54921.text: Extrinsic ligament of larynx is a ligament of larynx. Anatomical type — Nonskeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi which may be admixed with smooth muscle.

FMA55053.name: subdivision of laryngopharynx
FMA55053.text: Subdivision of laryngopharynx is a subdivision of pharynx. Anatomical type — Heterogeneous anatomical cluster: Anatomical cluster which has as its direct parts all or some members of two or more organ subclasses and one or more organ part subclasses which are grouped together according to some shared attributes.

FMA55077.name: pharyngeal raphe
FMA55077.text: Pharyngeal raphe is a decussation. Anatomical type — Decussation: Anatomical junction in which two or more anatomical structures intermingle segments of their component parts.

FMA55093.name: submandibular gland

FMA55131.name: ligament of larynx
FMA55131.text: Ligament of larynx is a nonskeletal ligament. Anatomical type — Nonskeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi which may be admixed with smooth muscle.

FMA55132.name: thyrohyoid membrane
FMA55132.text: Thyrohyoid membrane is a membrane organ. Anatomical type — Membrane organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue organized into a sheet which interconnects two or more organs, separates two or more body spaces from one another, or surrounds an organ or body part.

FMA55133.name: right thyrohyoid membrane
FMA55133.text: Right thyrohyoid membrane is a thyrohyoid membrane. Anatomical type — Membrane organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue organized into a sheet which interconnects two or more organs, separates two or more body spaces from one another, or surrounds an organ or body part.

FMA55134.name: left thyrohyoid membrane

FMA55135.name: thyrohyoid ligament
FMA55135.text: Thyrohyoid ligament is a nonskeletal ligament. Anatomical type — Nonskeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi which may be admixed with smooth muscle.

FMA55138.name: median thyrohyoid ligament
FMA55138.text: Thyrohyoid ligament, each instance of which is a central, thicker part of some thyrohyoid membrane; its broader upper part is attached to the body of some hyoid bone and its narrow lower end to the superior incisure of some thyroid cartilage. Anatomical type — Nonskeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi which may be admixed with smooth muscle.

FMA55139.name: lateral thyrohyoid ligament
FMA55139.text: Thyrohyoid ligament, each instance of which is a round elastic cord that forms the posterior margin of some thyrohyoid membrane; it extends from the tip of the superior horn of some thyroid cartilage upward to the tip of the greater horn of some hyoid bone. Anatomical type — Nonskeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi which may be admixed with smooth muscle.

FMA55140.name: right lateral thyrohyoid ligament
FMA55140.text: Right lateral thyrohyoid ligament is a lateral thyrohyoid ligament. Anatomical type — Lateral thyrohyoid ligament: Thyrohyoid ligament, each instance of which is a round elastic cord that forms the posterior margin of some thyrohyoid membrane; it extends from the tip of the superior horn of some thyroid cartilage upward to the tip of the greater horn of some hyoid bone.

FMA55141.name: left lateral thyrohyoid ligament
FMA55141.text: Left lateral thyrohyoid ligament is a lateral thyrohyoid ligament. Anatomical type — Lateral thyrohyoid ligament: Thyrohyoid ligament, each instance of which is a round elastic cord that forms the posterior margin of some thyrohyoid membrane; it extends from the tip of the superior horn of some thyroid cartilage upward to the tip of the greater horn of some hyoid bone.

FMA55226.name: intrinsic muscle of larynx
FMA55226.text: Intrinsic muscle of larynx is a muscle of larynx. Anatomical type — Muscle of neck: Muscle organ which is a part of the neck.

FMA55227.name: hyo-epiglottic ligament

FMA55230.name: thyro-epiglottic ligament

It is a regional part of Cricothyroid membrane complex.

FMA55245.name: right vocal ligament

FMA55246.name: left vocal ligament

FMA55618.name: pterygomandibular raphe

FMA55619.name: right pterygomandibular raphe

FMA55620.name: left pterygomandibular raphe
FMA55620.text: Left pterygomandibular raphe is a pterygomandibular raphe. Anatomical type — Decussation: Anatomical junction in which two or more anatomical structures intermingle segments of their component parts.

FMA55636.name: canine tooth
FMA55636.text: Canine tooth is a tooth. Anatomical type — Tooth: Organ with cavity, each instance of which has as its parts some dentine, cementum, dental pulp, enamel and cavity.

FMA55637.name: premolar tooth
FMA55637.text: Premolar tooth is a tooth. Anatomical type — Tooth: Organ with cavity, each instance of which has as its parts some dentine, cementum, dental pulp, enamel and cavity.

FMA55638.name: molar tooth

FMA55652.name: anatomical set
FMA55652.text: Material anatomical entity which consists of a maximum number of some instances of discontinuous members of the same class. Anatomical type — Material anatomical entity: Physical anatomical entity, each instance of which has mass.

FMA55661.name: parenchymatous organ
FMA55661.text: Solid organ, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of some parenchyma and connective tissue stroma. Anatomical type — Solid organ: Organ the direct parts of which consist of either fascicles or sheets or parenchyma and connective tissue stroma.

FMA55662.name: lobular organ

FMA55663.name: corticomedullary organ
FMA55663.text: Parenchymatous organ the stroma of which subdivides the parenchyma into cortex and medulla. Anatomical type — Parenchymatous organ: Solid organ, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of some parenchyma and connective tissue stroma.

FMA55665.name: nonparenchymatous organ
FMA55665.text: Solid organ which consists of organ parts that are arranged as fascicles or sheets. Anatomical type — Solid organ: Organ the direct parts of which consist of either fascicles or sheets or parenchyma and connective tissue stroma.

FMA55670.name: solid organ
FMA55670.text: Organ the direct parts of which consist of either fascicles or sheets or parenchyma and connective tissue stroma. Anatomical type — Organ: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has a maximal complement of instances of two or more types of tissue or one or more types of essential morphologic unit, a predominantly bona fide boundary and intrinsic vasculature and neural network.

FMA55671.name: cavitated organ
FMA55671.text: Organ, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of some organ cavity and organ wall. Anatomical type — Organ: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has a maximal complement of instances of two or more types of tissue or one or more types of essential morphologic unit, a predominantly bona fide boundary and intrinsic vasculature and neural network.

FMA55672.name: organ with organ cavity
FMA55672.text: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround one continuous anatomical space. Anatomical type — Cavitated organ: Organ, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of some organ cavity and organ wall.

FMA55673.name: organ with cavitated organ parts
FMA55673.text: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround two or more macroscopic anatomical spaces. Anatomical type — Cavitated organ: Organ, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of some organ cavity and organ wall.

FMA55676.name: segment of brain
FMA55676.text: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries. Anatomical type — Segment of neuraxis: Organ segment which is a regional part of neuraxis.

FMA55677.name: hollow tree organ
FMA55677.text: Organ with organ cavity, which consists of an arborizing set of tubular organ parts, the walls of which are continuous and surround a continuous lumen. Anatomical type — Organ with organ cavity: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround one continuous anatomical space.

FMA55690.name: left upper first secondary premolar tooth

FMA55693.name: left lower first secondary premolar tooth

FMA55694.name: right lower first secondary premolar tooth
