FMA55695.text: Right second lower premolar tooth is a second mandibular premolar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 29. It is contained in Right second lower premolar tooth socket space. It belongs to Mandibular dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55697.name: right upper second secondary molar tooth
FMA55697.text: Right second upper molar tooth is a secondary second upper molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 2. It is contained in Right second upper molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Right maxillary dentition.

FMA55698.name: right upper first secondary molar tooth
FMA55698.text: Right first upper molar tooth is a secondary first upper molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 3. It is contained in Right first upper molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Right maxillary dentition.

FMA55699.name: left upper first secondary molar tooth
FMA55699.text: Left first upper molar tooth is a secondary first upper molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 14. It is contained in Left first upper molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Left maxillary dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55700.name: left upper second secondary molar tooth
FMA55700.text: Left second upper molar tooth is a secondary second upper molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 15. It is contained in Left second upper molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Left maxillary dentition.

FMA55703.name: left lower second secondary molar tooth
FMA55703.text: Left second lower molar tooth is a secondary second mandibular molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 18. It is contained in Left second lower molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Mandibular dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55704.name: left lower first secondary molar tooth
FMA55704.text: Left first lower molar tooth is a secondary first mandibular molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 19. It is contained in Left first lower molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Mandibular dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55705.name: right lower first secondary molar tooth
FMA55705.text: Right first lower molar tooth is a secondary first mandibular molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 30. It is contained in Right first lower molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Mandibular dentition.

FMA55706.name: right lower second secondary molar tooth
FMA55706.text: Right second lower molar tooth is a secondary second mandibular molar tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 31. It is contained in Right second lower molar tooth socket space. It belongs to Mandibular dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55712.name: upper secondary incisor tooth
FMA55712.text: Secondary upper incisor tooth is a secondary incisor tooth.

FMA55713.name: lower secondary incisor tooth
FMA55713.text: Secondary lower incisor tooth is a secondary incisor tooth.

FMA55714.name: upper secondary canine tooth
FMA55714.text: Secondary upper canine tooth is a mandibular canine tooth.

FMA55715.name: lower secondary canine tooth
FMA55715.text: Secondary lower canine tooth is a maxillary canine tooth.

FMA55716.name: upper secondary premolar tooth
FMA55716.text: Maxillary premolar tooth is a premolar tooth. Anatomical type — Tooth: Organ with cavity, each instance of which has as its parts some dentine, cementum, dental pulp, enamel and cavity.

FMA55717.name: lower secondary premolar tooth
FMA55717.text: Mandibular premolar tooth is a premolar tooth. Anatomical type — Tooth: Organ with cavity, each instance of which has as its parts some dentine, cementum, dental pulp, enamel and cavity.

FMA55720.name: upper secondary molar tooth
FMA55720.text: Maxillary secondary molar tooth is a secondary molar tooth.

FMA55721.name: lower secondary molar tooth
FMA55721.text: Mandibular secondary molar tooth is a secondary molar tooth.

FMA55722.name: upper central secondary incisor tooth
FMA55722.text: Secondary upper central incisor tooth is an upper central incisor tooth.

FMA55723.name: lower central secondary incisor tooth
FMA55723.text: Secondary lower central incisor tooth is a lower central incisor tooth.

FMA55724.name: upper lateral secondary incisor tooth
FMA55724.text: Secondary upper lateral incisor tooth is an upper lateral incisor tooth.

FMA55725.name: lower lateral secondary incisor tooth
FMA55725.text: Secondary lower lateral incisor tooth is a lower lateral incisor tooth.

FMA55798.name: right upper secondary canine tooth
FMA55798.text: Right upper canine tooth is a secondary upper canine tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 6. It is contained in Right upper canine tooth socket space. It belongs to Right maxillary dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55799.name: left upper secondary canine tooth
FMA55799.text: Left upper canine tooth is a secondary upper canine tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 11. It is contained in Left upper canine tooth socket space. It belongs to Left maxillary dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA55801.name: upper first secondary premolar tooth
FMA55801.text: First maxillary premolar tooth is a maxillary premolar tooth.

FMA55802.name: upper second secondary premolar tooth
FMA55802.text: Second maxillary premolar tooth is a maxillary premolar tooth.

FMA55803.name: lower first secondary premolar tooth
FMA55803.text: First mandibular premolar tooth is a mandibular premolar tooth.

FMA55804.name: lower second secondary premolar tooth
FMA55804.text: Second mandibular premolar tooth is a mandibular premolar tooth.

FMA55811.name: upper first secondary molar tooth
FMA55811.text: Secondary first upper molar tooth is a first maxillary molar tooth.

FMA55812.name: upper second secondary molar tooth
FMA55812.text: Secondary second upper molar tooth is a second maxillary molar tooth.

FMA55814.name: lower first secondary molar tooth
FMA55814.text: Secondary first mandibular molar tooth is a first mandibular molar tooth.

FMA55815.name: lower second secondary molar tooth
FMA55815.text: Secondary second mandibular molar tooth is a second mandibular molar tooth.

FMA57140.name: right lower lateral secondary incisor tooth
FMA57140.text: Right lower lateral incisor tooth is a secondary lower lateral incisor tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 26. It is contained in Right lower lateral incisor tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Mandibular dentition.

FMA57141.name: left lower lateral secondary incisor tooth
FMA57141.text: Left lower lateral incisor tooth is a secondary lower lateral incisor tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 23. It is contained in Left lower lateral incisor tooth socket space. It belongs to Mandibular dentition, Left maxillary dentition and Secondary dentition.

FMA57142.name: right lower central secondary incisor tooth
FMA57142.text: Right lower central incisor tooth is a secondary lower central incisor tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 25. It is contained in Right lower central incisor tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Mandibular dentition.

FMA57143.name: left lower central secondary incisor tooth
FMA57143.text: Left lower central incisor tooth is a secondary lower central incisor tooth. It forms part of Alveolodental segment 24. It is contained in Left lower central incisor tooth socket space. It belongs to Secondary dentition and Mandibular dentition.

FMA57965.name: zone of investing fascia
FMA57965.text: Zone of investing fascia is an organ zone. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA58071.name: chamber of eyeball
FMA58071.text: Chamber of eyeball. Anatomical type — Organ component: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.

FMA58078.name: anterior chamber of eyeball
FMA58078.text: Anterior chamber of eyeball is a chamber of eyeball. It is a regional part of Aqueous chamber of eyeball.

FMA58081.name: anterior chamber of right eyeball
FMA58081.text: Anterior chamber of right eyeball is an anterior chamber of eyeball. It is a regional part of Aqueous chamber of right eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58082.name: anterior chamber of left eyeball
FMA58082.text: Anterior chamber of left eyeball is an anterior chamber of eyeball. It is a regional part of Aqueous chamber of left eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58101.name: layer of wall of eyeball
FMA58101.text: Layer of wall of eyeball is an organ component layer. Anatomical type — Organ component layer: Organ component which is a part of a wall of an organ or a membranous layer of an organ.

FMA58102.name: fibrous layer of eyeball
FMA58102.text: Fibrous layer of eyeball is a layer of wall of eyeball. It forms part of Wall of eyeball.

FMA58235.name: iris
FMA58235.text: Iris is a region of vascular layer of eyeball. It is a regional part of Eyeball, Vascular layer of eyeball and Wall of eyeball.

FMA58236.name: right iris
FMA58236.text: Right iris is an iris. It is a regional part of Vascular layer of right eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58237.name: left iris
FMA58237.text: Left iris is an iris. It is a regional part of Vascular layer of left eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58238.name: cornea
FMA58238.text: Cornea is a fibrous layer of eyeball. It is a regional part of Wall of eyeball.

FMA58239.name: right cornea
FMA58239.text: Right cornea is a cornea. It is a regional part of Fibrous layer of right eyeball.

FMA58240.name: left cornea
FMA58240.text: Left cornea is a cornea. It is a regional part of Fibrous layer of left eyeball. It forms part of Wall of anterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58241.name: lens
FMA58241.text: Lens is an organ component of eyeball. It forms part of Eyeball.

FMA58242.name: right lens
FMA58242.text: Right lens is a lens. It is a regional part of Right eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58243.name: left lens
FMA58243.text: Left lens is a lens. It is a regional part of Left eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58245.name: lacrimal canaliculus
FMA58245.text: Lacrimal canaliculus is a segment of lacrimal duct. It is a regional part of Lacrimal duct.

FMA58269.name: sclera
FMA58269.text: Sclera is a fibrous layer of eyeball. It is a regional part of Wall of eyeball.

FMA58271.name: right sclera
FMA58271.text: Right sclera is a sclera. It is a regional part of Fibrous layer of right eyeball. It forms part of Wall of posterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58272.name: left sclera
FMA58272.text: Left sclera is a sclera. It is a regional part of Fibrous layer of left eyeball. It forms part of Wall of posterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58274.name: muscle of trunk
FMA58274.text: Muscle organ which is a part of the trunk. Anatomical type — Muscle organ: Nonparenchymatous organ that primarily consists of skeletal muscle tissue aggregated into macroscopic fasciculi by connective tissue; together with other muscles, it constitutes the muscular system.

FMA58298.name: choroid
FMA58298.text: Choroid is a region of vascular layer of eyeball. It is a regional part of Vascular layer of eyeball and Wall of eyeball. It forms part of Vascular layer of eyeball.

FMA58299.name: right choroid
FMA58299.text: Right choroid is a choroid. It is a regional part of Vascular layer of right eyeball and Wall of right eyeball. It forms part of Wall of posterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58300.name: left choroid
FMA58300.text: Left choroid is a choroid. It is a regional part of Wall of left eyeball and Vascular layer of left eyeball. It forms part of Wall of posterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58420.name: zone of investing fascia of free lower limb
FMA58420.text: Zone of investing fascia of free lower limb is a zone of investing fascia of lower limb.

FMA58421.name: zone of investing fascia of lower limb
FMA58421.text: Zone of investing fascia of lower limb is a zone of investing fascia. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA58431.name: corona ciliaris
FMA58431.text: Corona ciliaris is a region of ciliary body. It forms part of Ciliary body.

FMA58479.name: region of ciliary body
FMA58479.text: Region of ciliary body is a region of layer of wall of eyeball. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA58483.name: right corona ciliaris
FMA58483.text: Right corona ciliaris is a corona ciliaris.

FMA58484.name: left corona ciliaris
FMA58484.text: Left corona ciliaris is a corona ciliaris.

FMA58599.name: region of retina
FMA58599.text: Region of retina is a region of layer of wall of eyeball. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA58604.name: optic part of retina
FMA58604.text: Optic part of retina is a region of retina. It is a regional part of Retina.

FMA58607.name: optic part of right retina
FMA58607.text: Optic part of right retina is an optic part of retina.

FMA58608.name: optic part of left retina
FMA58608.text: Optic part of left retina is an optic part of retina.

FMA58741.name: zone of investing fascia of thigh
FMA58741.text: Zone of investing fascia of thigh is a zone of investing fascia of free lower limb.

FMA58775.name: zone of fascia lata
FMA58775.text: Zone of fascia lata is a zone of investing fascia of thigh.

FMA58776.name: right iliotibial tract
FMA58776.text: This is the right-sided structure. A thickened band of deep fascia along the outer thigh, continuous with fascia lata. It has connections to the femur as well as an attachment to the upper outer tibia.

FMA58777.name: left iliotibial tract
FMA58777.text: This is the left-sided structure. A thickened band of deep fascia along the outer thigh, continuous with fascia lata. It has connections to the femur as well as an attachment to the upper outer tibia.

FMA58817.name: subdivision of head proper
FMA58817.text: Subdivision of head proper is a subdivision of head. Anatomical type — Subdivision of head: subdivision of cardinal body part, each instance of which is a regional part of some head.

FMA58827.name: vitreous body
FMA58827.text: Mucoid tissue in the vitreous chamber of the eyeball. It forms part of Eyeball.

FMA58828.name: right vitreous body
FMA58828.text: Right vitreous body is a vitreous body. It is a regional part of Right eyeball. It forms part of Posterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58829.name: left vitreous body
FMA58829.text: Left vitreous body is a vitreous body. It is a regional part of Left eyeball. It forms part of Posterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA58838.name: suspensory ligament of lens
FMA58838.text: Suspensory ligament of lens is an organ component of eyeball. It is a regional part of Eyeball. It forms part of Eyeball.

FMA58839.name: suspensory ligament of right lens
FMA58839.text: Suspensory ligament of right lens is a suspensory ligament of lens. It is a regional part of Right eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of right eyeball.

FMA58840.name: suspensory ligament of left lens
FMA58840.text: Suspensory ligament of left lens is a suspensory ligament of lens. It is a regional part of Left eyeball. It forms part of Anterior segment of left eyeball.

FMA59086.name: tarsal plate of eyelid
FMA59086.text: Tarsal plate of eyelid is a membrane organ. It forms part of Eyelid.

FMA59087.name: tarsal plate of upper eyelid
FMA59087.text: Tarsal plate of upper eyelid is a tarsal plate of eyelid. It forms part of Upper eyelid.

FMA59088.name: tarsal plate of lower eyelid
FMA59088.text: Tarsal plate of lower eyelid is a tarsal plate of eyelid. It forms part of Lower eyelid.

FMA59089.name: tarsal plate of right lower eyelid
FMA59089.text: Tarsal plate of right lower eyelid is a tarsal plate of lower eyelid. It forms part of Right lower eyelid.

FMA59090.name: tarsal plate of left lower eyelid
FMA59090.text: Tarsal plate of left lower eyelid is a tarsal plate of lower eyelid. It forms part of Left lower eyelid.

FMA59091.name: tarsal plate of right upper eyelid
FMA59091.text: Tarsal plate of right upper eyelid is a tarsal plate of upper eyelid. It forms part of Right upper eyelid.

FMA59092.name: tarsal plate of left upper eyelid
FMA59092.text: Tarsal plate of left upper eyelid is a tarsal plate of upper eyelid. It forms part of Left upper eyelid.

FMA59101.name: lacrimal gland
FMA59101.text: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which consists of glandular acini which communicate the lacrimal sac. It is a regional part of Lacrimal apparatus. It forms part of Orbital content.

FMA59102.name: right lacrimal gland
FMA59102.text: Right lacrimal gland is a lacrimal gland. It is a regional part of Right lacrimal apparatus. It forms part of Right orbital content. It is contained in Right orbital cavity.

FMA59103.name: left lacrimal gland
FMA59103.text: Left lacrimal gland is a lacrimal gland. It is a regional part of Left lacrimal apparatus. It forms part of Left orbital content. It is contained in Left orbital cavity.

FMA59402.name: lacrimal lake
FMA59402.text: Organ cavity subdivision, each instance of which is the triangular space at the medial angle of some eye, where the tears collect. Anatomical type — Anatomical compartment space: Anatomical space which contains two or more anatomical structures demarcated by bona fide boundaries and is bounded by the surface of one or more anatomical structures.

FMA59502.name: nasal cartilage
FMA59502.text: Nasal cartilage is a skeletal cartilage organ. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA59503.name: septal nasal cartilage
FMA59503.text: Septal nasal cartilage is a nasal cartilage. It is a regional part of Cartilaginous skeleton of nasal septum and Cartilaginous skeleton of nose. It forms part of Wall of internal nose.

FMA59504.name: major alar cartilage
FMA59504.text: Major alar cartilage is an alar cartilage.

FMA59505.name: right major alar cartilage
FMA59505.text: Right major alar cartilage is a major alar cartilage. It belongs to Cartilaginous skeleton of external nose.

FMA59506.name: left major alar cartilage
FMA59506.text: Left major alar cartilage is a major alar cartilage. It belongs to Cartilaginous skeleton of external nose.

FMA59511.name: lateral nasal cartilage
FMA59511.text: Lateral nasal cartilage is a nasal cartilage. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA59512.name: right lateral nasal cartilage
FMA59512.text: Right lateral nasal cartilage is a lateral nasal cartilage. It forms part of Dorsum of nose. It belongs to Cartilaginous skeleton of external nose.

FMA59513.name: left lateral nasal cartilage
FMA59513.text: Left lateral nasal cartilage is a lateral nasal cartilage. It forms part of Dorsum of nose. It belongs to Cartilaginous skeleton of external nose.

FMA59541.name: right lacrimal lake
FMA59541.text: Right lacrimal lake is a lacrimal lake. It is a regional part of Right lacrimal duct.

FMA59542.name: left lacrimal lake
FMA59542.text: Left lacrimal lake is a lacrimal lake. It is a regional part of Left lacrimal duct.

FMA59545.name: right lacrimal sac
FMA59545.text: Right lacrimal sac is a lacrimal sac. It is a regional part of Right lacrimal duct.

FMA59546.name: left lacrimal sac
FMA59546.text: Left lacrimal sac is a lacrimal sac. It is a regional part of Left lacrimal duct.

FMA59555.name: right nasolacrimal duct
FMA59555.text: Right nasolacrimal duct is a nasolacrimal duct. It is a regional part of Right lacrimal duct.

FMA59556.name: left nasolacrimal duct
FMA59556.text: Left nasolacrimal duct is a nasolacrimal duct. It is a regional part of Left lacrimal duct.

FMA59582.name: right lacrimal canaliculus
FMA59582.text: Right lacrimal canaliculus is a lacrimal canaliculus. It is a regional part of Right lacrimal duct.

FMA59583.name: left lacrimal canaliculus
FMA59583.text: Left lacrimal canaliculus is a lacrimal canaliculus. It is a regional part of Left lacrimal duct.

FMA59763.name: gingiva of upper jaw
FMA59763.text: The gum tissue around the upper teeth. This oral tissue helps protect and maintain the tissues supporting the teeth.

FMA59764.name: gingiva of lower jaw
FMA59764.text: The gum tissue around the lower teeth. This oral tissue helps protect and maintain the tissues supporting the teeth.

FMA59788.name: major salivary gland
FMA59788.text: Major salivary gland is a salivary gland. Anatomical type — Salivary gland: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which consists of glandular acini which communicate with oral cavity.

FMA59791.name: sublingual gland
FMA59791.text: Sublingual gland is a major salivary gland. Anatomical type — Salivary gland: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which consists of glandular acini which communicate with oral cavity.

FMA59802.name: right submandibular gland
FMA59802.text: Right submandibular gland is a submandibular gland. It forms part of Mandibular part of mouth and Floor of mouth. It is contained in Space of right submandibular triangle. It belongs to Set of submandibular glands.

FMA59803.name: left submandibular gland
FMA59803.text: Left submandibular gland is a submandibular gland. It forms part of Mandibular part of mouth and Floor of mouth. It is contained in Space of left submandibular triangle. It belongs to Set of submandibular glands.

FMA59804.name: right sublingual gland
FMA59804.text: Right sublingual gland is a sublingual gland. It forms part of Floor of mouth. It belongs to Set of sublingual glands.

FMA59805.name: left sublingual gland
FMA59805.text: Left sublingual gland is a sublingual gland. It forms part of Floor of mouth. It belongs to Set of sublingual glands.

FMA59816.name: lip
FMA59816.text: Region of labial part of mouth sharing upper or lower boundary of oral orifice.

FMA61284.name: neural tree organ
FMA61284.text: Nonparenchymatous organ which has as its direct parts an aggregate of neurons, the somas of which are located in the neuraxis and their network of neurites (axons) predominantly located outside the neuraxis. Anatomical type — Nonparenchymatous organ: Solid organ which consists of organ parts that are arranged as fascicles or sheets.

FMA61708.name: subdivision of auriculotemporal part of head
FMA61708.text: Subdivision of auriculotemporal part of head is a subdivision of head proper. Anatomical type — Subdivision of head: subdivision of cardinal body part, each instance of which is a regional part of some head.

FMA61775.name: physical anatomical entity
FMA61775.text: Anatomical entity, each instance of which has three or fewer spatial dimensions. Anatomical type — Anatomical entity: Organismal continuant entity which is enclosed by the bona fide boundary of an organism or is an attribute of its structural organization.

FMA61815.name: cardinal segment of brain
FMA61815.text: Segment of brain with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries. Anatomical type — Segment of brain: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA61820.name: segment of cerebral hemisphere
FMA61820.text: Segment of cerebral hemisphere is a segment of telencephalon.

FMA61823.name: lobe of cerebral hemisphere
FMA61823.text: Segment of cerebral hemisphere demarcated by both bonafide landmarks (sulci and fissures) and fiat boundaries.

FMA61833.name: caudate nucleus
FMA61833.text: Nucleus of brain which is an elongated crescent-shaped mass lying parallel and adjacent to the lateral ventricle throughout its extent. It is a regional part of Subcortical gray matter structure and Striatum. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to tail of caudate nucleus and Proximal medial striate artery. It belongs to Corpus striatum.

FMA61834.name: putamen
FMA61834.text: Nucleus of brain which lies ventral to the caudate nucleus and internal capsule and medial to the external capsule. It is a regional part of Lentiform nucleus, Subcortical gray matter structure and Striatum. Its arterial supply includes Distal lateral striate branch of middle cerebral artery, Proximal medial striate artery and Proximal lateral striate branch of middle cerebral artery, among other structures.

FMA61835.name: globus pallidus
FMA61835.text: Nucleus of brain which is located medially to the putamen and laterally to the internal capsule. It is a regional part of Lentiform nucleus and Subcortical gray matter structure. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to globus pallidus and Anterolateral central branch of middle cerebral artery.

FMA61841.name: amygdala
FMA61841.text: Basal ganglion of telencephalon which is an almond-shaped gray mass in the dorsomedial part of the temporal lobe. It is a regional part of Limbic system and Subcortical gray matter structure. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to amygdala. It belongs to Set of basal ganglia.

FMA61842.name: septum of telencephalon
FMA61842.text: Subdivision of the telencephalon on the midline between the lateral ventricles which contains the septum pellucidum and the septal nuclei. It is a regional part of Subcortical gray matter structure.

FMA61857.name: superior frontal gyrus
FMA61857.text: Superior frontal gyrus is a gyrus of frontal lobe. It is a regional part of Frontal lobe, Superolateral segment of frontal lobe and Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Artery of precentral sulcus, Polar frontal artery and Callosomarginal artery. It is continuous with Anterior cingulate gyrus, Middle frontal gyrus and Precentral gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61859.name: middle frontal gyrus
FMA61859.text: Middle frontal gyrus is a gyrus of frontal lobe. It is a regional part of Superolateral segment of frontal lobe, Frontal lobe and Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Artery of precentral sulcus. It is continuous with Lateral orbital gyrus, Inferior frontal gyrus and Superior frontal gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61860.name: inferior frontal gyrus
FMA61860.text: Inferior frontal gyrus is a gyrus of frontal lobe. It is a regional part of Superolateral segment of frontal lobe, Neocortex and Frontal lobe. Its arterial supply includes Artery of precentral sulcus. It is continuous with Superior temporal gyrus, Middle frontal gyrus and Lateral orbital gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61894.name: precentral gyrus
FMA61894.text: Precentral gyrus is a gyrus of frontal lobe. It is a regional part of Superolateral segment of frontal lobe, Neocortex and Frontal lobe. Its arterial supply includes Callosomarginal artery and Artery of central sulcus. It is continuous with Inferior frontal gyrus, Postcentral gyrus and Superior frontal gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61896.name: postcentral gyrus
FMA61896.text: Postcentral gyrus is a gyrus of parietal lobe. It is a regional part of Parietal lobe and Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Callosomarginal artery, Artery of central sulcus and Artery of postcentral sulcus. It is continuous with Superior parietal lobule, Supramarginal gyrus and Precentral gyrus.

FMA61897.name: supramarginal gyrus
FMA61897.text: Supramarginal gyrus is a segment of inferior parietal lobule. It is a regional part of Neocortex and Inferior parietal lobule. Its arterial supply includes Artery of postcentral sulcus and Anterior parietal artery. It is continuous with Angular gyrus, Superior parietal lobule and Superior temporal gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61898.name: angular gyrus
FMA61898.text: Angular gyrus is a segment of inferior parietal lobule. It is a regional part of Neocortex and Inferior parietal lobule. Its arterial supply includes Posterior parietal artery and Branch of middle cerebral artery to angular gyrus. It is continuous with Posterior part of middle temporal gyrus, Posterior part of superior temporal gyrus and Superior occipital gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61899.name: superior parietal lobule
FMA61899.text: Superior parietal lobule is a gyrus of parietal lobe. It is a regional part of Parietal lobe and Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Parietal occipital artery, Artery of postcentral sulcus and Anterior parietal artery. It is continuous with Supramarginal gyrus, Angular gyrus and Postcentral gyrus, among other structures.

FMA61906.name: middle temporal gyrus
FMA61906.text: Middle temporal gyrus is a gyrus of temporal lobe. It is a regional part of Temporal lobe and Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Posterior temporal artery, Polar temporal artery and Anterior temporal artery. It is continuous with Lateral occipital gyrus, Inferior temporal gyrus and Superior temporal gyrus.

FMA61907.name: inferior temporal gyrus
FMA61907.text: Inferior temporal gyrus is a gyrus of temporal lobe. It is a regional part of Temporal lobe and Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Anterior temporal artery, Posterior temporal artery and Polar temporal artery. It is continuous with Lateral occipital gyrus, Middle temporal gyrus and Fusiform gyrus.

FMA61908.name: fusiform gyrus
FMA61908.text: Fusiform gyrus is a gyrus of temporal lobe. It is a regional part of Neocortex. Its arterial supply includes Polar temporal artery, Posterior temporal artery and Anterior temporal artery. It is continuous with Parahippocampal gyrus, Inferior temporal gyrus and Lingual gyrus.

FMA61918.name: parahippocampal gyrus
FMA61918.text: Parahippocampal gyrus is a gyrus of limbic lobe. It is a regional part of Medial segment of cerebral hemisphere, Medial occipitotemporal gyrus and Limbic system, among other structures. Its arterial supply includes Posterior temporal artery, Anterior temporal artery and Polar temporal artery. It is continuous with Fusiform gyrus and Lingual gyrus.

FMA61934.name: choroid plexus of cerebral hemisphere
FMA61934.text: Specialized vascular and epithelial tissue within a lateral ventricle of the brain that produces cerebrospinal fluid.

FMA61950.name: internal capsule
FMA61950.text: Internal capsule is an organ subdivision of the telencephalon which is made up primarily of myelinated axonal neural tissue (white matter). The internal capsule is a major set of fiber bundles lateral to the thalamus and caudate nucleus and medial to the putamen and globus pallidus. It projects dorsally to the white matter underlying the cerebral cortex. It is a regional part of Dorsal column-medial lemniscal pathway structure and White matter structure of cerebral hemisphere. It forms part of Cerebral white matter. Its arterial supply includes Distal lateral striate branch of middle cerebral artery, Proximal lateral striate branch of middle cerebral artery and Distal medial striate artery.

FMA61961.name: anterior commissure
FMA61961.text: Anterior commissure is a white matter of telencephalon. It is a regional part of White matter structure of cerebral hemisphere and Intercerebral commissure. Its arterial supply includes Proximal lateral striate branch of middle cerebral artery, Median commissural artery and Distal lateral striate branch of middle cerebral artery.

FMA61965.name: fornix of forebrain
FMA61965.text: Fornix of neuraxis which connects Ammon's horn of the hippocampus with the mammillary nuclei of the hypothalamus and anterior nuclei of the thalamus. It is a regional part of White matter structure of cerebral hemisphere.

FMA61970.name: commissure of fornix of forebrain
FMA61970.text: Commissure of fornix of forebrain is a commissure of neuraxis. It is a regional part of Fornix of forebrain.

FMA61974.name: stria terminalis
FMA61974.text: Stria terminalis is a stria of telencephalon. It is a regional part of White matter structure of cerebral hemisphere.

FMA61975.name: lamina terminalis
FMA61975.text: Lamina terminalis is a lamina of cerebral hemisphere. It is a regional part of White matter structure of cerebral hemisphere.

FMA61993.name: midbrain
FMA61993.text: Organ component of neuraxis that has as its parts the tectum, cerebral peduncle, midbrain tegmentum and cerebral aqueduct. It is a regional part of Brain and Brainstem. Its arterial supply includes Mesencephalic artery.

FMA61996.name: segment of forebrain
FMA61996.text: Segment of forebrain is a segment of brain. Anatomical type — Segment of brain: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA61997.name: segment of midbrain
FMA61997.text: Segment of midbrain is a segment of brain. Anatomical type — Segment of brain: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA61998.name: segment of hindbrain
FMA61998.text: Segment of hindbrain is a segment of brain. Anatomical type — Segment of brain: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA62004.name: medulla oblongata
FMA62004.text: Organ component of neuraxis that has as its parts the medullary reticular formation, inferior olivary complex and cochlear nuclear complex, among other structures. It is a regional part of Hindbrain and Brainstem. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior inferior cerebellar artery to medulla oblongata.

FMA62007.name: thalamus
FMA62007.text: Organ component of neuraxis, each instance of which is a large oval mass in the posterior part of some diencephalon adjacent to the lateral wall of some thrid ventricle, containing groups of some nuclei serving as relay centers for sensory impulses and cerebellar and basal nuclear rpojections to some cerebral cortex. Its arterial supply includes Thalamoperforating artery, Posterior medial choroidal artery and Posterior lateral choroidal artery, among other structures.

FMA62008.name: hypothalamus
FMA62008.text: Organ component of neuraxis, each instance of which is the ventral part of some diencephalon, forming the floor and part of the lateral wall of some third ventricle. Anatomically, it includes some preoptic area, optic tract, optic chiasm, mammillary bodies, tuber cinereum, infundibulum, and neurohypophysis, but for physiological purposes the neurohypophysis is considered a distinct structure. It is a regional part of Diencephalon and Limbic system. Its arterial supply includes Hypothalamic branch of posterior communicating artery, Thalamoperforating artery and Branch of anterior choroidal artery to hypothalamus.

FMA62032.name: habenula
FMA62032.text: Habenula is a segment of the epithalamus that has as its parts the lateral and medial habenular nuclei and the habenular commissure. It is a regional part of Epithalamus.

FMA62033.name: pineal body
FMA62033.text: Circumventricular organ of neuraxis which is shaped like a pine cone and attached on the midline near the posterior and habenular commissures of the epithalamus. It is a regional part of Epithalamus. Its arterial supply includes Posterior medial choroidal artery.

FMA62045.name: optic chiasm
FMA62045.text: Nerve trunk which is continuous with right and left optic nerves and right and left optic tracts. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to optic chiasm.

FMA62046.name: optic tract
FMA62046.text: Nerve trunk which is continuous with the optic chiasm and the lateral geniculate nucleus. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to optic tract.

FMA62072.name: posterior commissure
FMA62072.text: Posterior commissure is a commissure of diencephalon. It is a regional part of Epithalamus.

FMA62080.name: stria medullaris of thalamus
FMA62080.text: Stria medullaris of thalamus is a slender fiber bundle on the dorsal surface of the diencephalon which terminates posteriorly in the habenular nuclei.

FMA62209.name: lateral geniculate body
FMA62209.text: Lateral geniculate body is a geniculate body. It is a regional part of Metathalamus. Its arterial supply includes Posterior lateral choroidal artery, Thalamogeniculate artery and Branch of anterior choroidal artery to lateral geniculate body.

FMA62211.name: medial geniculate body
FMA62211.text: Medial geniculate body is a geniculate body. It is a regional part of Metathalamus. Its arterial supply includes Thalamogeniculate artery.

FMA62327.name: tuber cinereum
FMA62327.text: Tuber cinereum is a zone of diencephalon. It is a regional part of Intermediate hypothalamic region. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to tuber cinereum and Artery of tuber cinereum.

FMA62374.name: segment of telencephalon
FMA62374.text: Segment of telencephalon is a segment of forebrain. Anatomical type — Segment of brain: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA62382.name: right optic tract
FMA62382.text: Optic tract which is continuous with the optic chiasm and the right lateral geniculate nucleus. It is a regional part of Optic nerve-tract complex.

FMA62394.name: peduncle of midbrain
FMA62394.text: Cerebral peduncle is a peduncle of neuraxis. Its arterial supply includes Peduncular branch of posterior cerebral artery.

FMA62398.name: segment of midbrain tectum
FMA62398.text: Segment of midbrain tectum is a segment of midbrain. Anatomical type — Segment of brain: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA62403.name: superior colliculus
FMA62403.text: Superior colliculus is a segment of midbrain tectum. Its arterial supply includes Collicular artery.

FMA62404.name: inferior colliculus
FMA62404.text: Inferior colliculus is a segment of midbrain tectum. Its arterial supply includes Collicular artery.

FMA62434.name: cingulate gyrus
FMA62434.text: Cingulate gyrus is a gyrus of limbic lobe. It is a regional part of Limbic lobe, Limbic gyrus and Limbic system, among other structures. It is continuous with Paracentral lobule, Precuneus and Lingual gyrus, among other structures. It belongs to Set of cerebral gyri.

FMA62445.name: commissure of diencephalon
FMA62445.text: Commissure of diencephalon is a commissure of neuraxis.

FMA62466.name: capsule of cerebral hemisphere
FMA62466.text: Capsule of cerebral hemisphere is a segment of cerebral white matter.

FMA62493.name: hippocampus
FMA62493.text: Hippocampus proper is a gyrus of limbic lobe. It is a regional part of Retrocommissural hippocampus. It forms part of Hippocampus and Body of hippocampus. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior choroidal artery to hippocampus and Hippocampal artery.

FMA62504.name: tributary of deep palmar venous arch
FMA62504.text: Tributary of deep palmar venous arch is a tributary of venous anastomosis. Anatomical type — Venous trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the atria of the heart, directly or indirectly through tributaries of the venae cavae, pulmonary veins and the hepatic and portal veins.

FMA62506.name: dorsal venous network of right hand
FMA62506.text: Dorsal venous network of right hand is a dorsal venous network of hand.

FMA62507.name: dorsal venous network of left hand
FMA62507.text: Dorsal venous network of left hand is a dorsal venous network of hand.

FMA62512.name: trunk of systemic vein
FMA62512.text: Trunk of systemic vein is a venous trunk. Anatomical type — Venous trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the atria of the heart, directly or indirectly through tributaries of the venae cavae, pulmonary veins and the hepatic and portal veins.

FMA62514.name: basal ganglion of telencephalon
FMA62514.text: Basal ganglion of telencephalon is a ganglion of neuraxis. Anatomical type — Subcortical gray matter: Gray matter component of neuraxis which is located in the interior of the neuraxis.

FMA62955.name: anatomical entity
FMA62955.text: Organismal continuant entity which is enclosed by the bona fide boundary of an organism or is an attribute of its structural organization.

FMA63103.name: pancreatic duct tree
FMA63103.text: Pancreatic duct tree is an organ component. It forms part of Pancreas.

FMA63120.name: parenchyma of pancreas
FMA63120.text: Parenchyma of pancreas is a parenchyma. It forms part of Pancreas.

FMA63812.name: set of arteries
FMA63812.text: Set of arteries is a set of organ regions. Anatomical type — Set of organ parts: Anatomical set which has as its direct members organ parts of same type.

FMA63814.name: set of veins
FMA63814.text: Set of systemic veins is a set of veins.

FMA63822.name: posterior intercostal arteries
FMA63822.text: Set of posterior intercostal arteries is a set of arteries.

FMA64796.name: region of serous membrane
FMA64796.text: Region of serous membrane is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA64822.name: superficial muscle of neck
FMA64822.text: Superficial muscle of neck is a muscle of neck. Anatomical type — Muscle of neck: Muscle organ which is a part of the neck.

FMA64829.name: scalene muscle
FMA64829.text: Scalene muscle is a muscle of neck. Anatomical type — Muscle of neck: Muscle organ which is a part of the neck.

FMA64875.name: anterior suboccipital muscle
FMA64875.text: Anterior suboccipital muscle is a prevertebral muscle. It belongs to Musculature of back of body proper.

FMA64916.name: thenar muscle
FMA64916.text: Thenar muscle is an intrinsic muscle of hand.

FMA64917.name: hypothenar muscle
FMA64917.text: Hypothenar muscle is an intrinsic muscle of hand.

FMA64922.name: gluteal muscle
FMA64922.text: Gluteal muscle is a muscle of pelvic girdle.

FMA64989.name: heterogeneous cluster
FMA64989.text: Anatomical cluster which has as its direct parts all or some members of two or more organ subclasses and one or more organ part subclasses which are grouped together according to some shared attributes. Anatomical type — Anatomical cluster: Postnatal anatomical structure, each instance of which has as it direct parts a heterogeneous collection of some instances of two or more subclasses of anatomcial structure, which are spatially related to one another; the collections as a whole does not satisfy the definition of any other subclass of anatomical structure. Eaxmples: root of lung, back, anatomical snuffbox, motor unit, juxtaglomerular complex.

FMA64990.name: organ part cluster
FMA64990.text: Anatomical cluster which has as its direct parts all or some members of one or more organ part types which are grouped together according to some shared attributes. Anatomical type — Anatomical cluster: Postnatal anatomical structure, each instance of which has as it direct parts a heterogeneous collection of some instances of two or more subclasses of anatomcial structure, which are spatially related to one another; the collections as a whole does not satisfy the definition of any other subclass of anatomical structure. Eaxmples: root of lung, back, anatomical snuffbox, motor unit, juxtaglomerular complex.

FMA65004.name: superficial muscle of posterior compartment of leg
FMA65004.text: Superficial muscle of posterior compartment of leg is a muscle of posterior compartment of leg.

FMA65008.name: deep muscle of posterior compartment of leg
FMA65008.text: Deep muscle of posterior compartment of leg is a muscle of posterior compartment of leg.

FMA65014.name: right flexor hallucis longus
FMA65014.text: Right flexor hallucis longus is a flexor hallucis longus. It is contained in Space of deep part of posterior compartment of right leg. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right flexor hallucis longus. It belongs to Set of deep muscles of posterior compartment of right leg and Musculature of right leg.

FMA65015.name: left flexor hallucis longus
FMA65015.text: Left flexor hallucis longus is a flexor hallucis longus. It is contained in Space of deep part of posterior compartment of left leg. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left flexor hallucis longus. It belongs to Musculature of left leg and Set of deep muscles of posterior compartment of left leg.

FMA65016.name: right flexor digitorum longus
FMA65016.text: Right flexor digitorum longus is a flexor digitorum longus. It is contained in Space of deep part of posterior compartment of right leg. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right flexor digitorum longus. It belongs to Set of deep muscles of posterior compartment of right leg, Musculature of right leg and Set of extrinsic muscles of right foot.

FMA65017.name: left flexor digitorum longus
FMA65017.text: Left flexor digitorum longus is a flexor digitorum longus. It is contained in Space of deep part of posterior compartment of left leg. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left flexor digitorum longus. It belongs to Set of deep muscles of posterior compartment of left leg, Set of extrinsic muscles of left foot and Musculature of left leg.

FMA65018.name: right tibialis posterior
FMA65018.text: Right tibialis posterior is a tibialis posterior. It is contained in Space of deep part of posterior compartment of right leg. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to right tibialis posterior. It belongs to Musculature of right leg, Set of deep muscles of posterior compartment of right leg and Set of extrinsic muscles of right foot.

FMA65019.name: left tibialis posterior
FMA65019.text: Left tibialis posterior is a tibialis posterior. It is contained in Space of deep part of posterior compartment of left leg. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to left tibialis posterior. It belongs to Set of deep muscles of posterior compartment of left leg, Musculature of left leg and Set of extrinsic muscles of left foot.

FMA65020.name: intrinsic muscle of foot
FMA65020.text: Intrinsic muscle of foot is a muscle of foot.

FMA65045.name: intrinsic muscle of dorsum of foot
FMA65045.text: Intrinsic muscle of dorsum of foot is an intrinsic muscle of foot.

FMA65046.name: intrinsic muscle of plantar part of foot
FMA65046.text: Intrinsic muscle of plantar part of foot is an intrinsic muscle of foot.

FMA65132.name: nerve
FMA65132.text: Segment of neural tree organ which has as its parts a nerve trunk and its branches; together with other nerves of the same tree it constitutes a neural tree. It is a regional part of Neural tree organ.

FMA65198.name: superficial head of right flexor pollicis brevis
FMA65198.text: Superficial head of right flexor pollicis brevis is a superficial head of flexor pollicis brevis. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to superficial head of right flexor pollicis brevis.

FMA65199.name: superficial head of left flexor pollicis brevis
FMA65199.text: Superficial head of left flexor pollicis brevis is a superficial head of flexor pollicis brevis. Its nerve supply includes Nerve to superficial head of left flexor pollicis brevis.

FMA65410.name: intermediate tendon
FMA65410.text: Intermediate tendon is a tendon. Anatomical type — Tendon: Organ component of muscle which consists of bundles of collagen fibrils (Type I collagen) bound by loose connective tissue.

FMA65470.name: proximal phalanx of left thumb
FMA65470.text: Proximal phalanx of left thumb is a proximal phalanx of thumb. It forms part of Left thumb. It belongs to Set of phalanges of left thumb.

FMA65539.name: subdivision of parasympathetic nervous system
FMA65539.text: Subdivision of parasympathetic nervous system is a subdivision of autonomic nervous system.

FMA65551.name: subdivisionof autonomic nervous system
FMA65551.text: Subdivision of autonomic nervous system is a subdivision of nervous system. Anatomical type — Set of heterogeneous anatomical structures: Anatomical set which has as its direct members, organs, organ parts and tissues of same or different types.

FMA66241.name: first posterior intercostal artery
FMA66241.text: First posterior intercostal artery is a posterior intercostal artery. Anatomical type — Systemic artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which carries oxygenated blood from some heart.

FMA66242.name: right first posterior intercostal artery
FMA66242.text: Right first posterior intercostal artery is a first posterior intercostal artery. It branches from Right superior intercostal artery.

FMA66243.name: left first posterior intercostal artery
FMA66243.text: Left first posterior intercostal artery is a first posterior intercostal artery. It branches from Left superior intercostal artery.

FMA66267.name: variant systemic artery
FMA66267.text: Variant systemic artery is a variant artery.

FMA66320.name: thoracodorsal artery
FMA66320.text: Thoracodorsal artery is a subdivision of subscapular artery. It branches from Subscapular artery. It is a regional part of Subscapular artery.

FMA66321.name: right thoracodorsal artery
FMA66321.text: Right thoracodorsal artery is a thoracodorsal artery. It branches from Right subscapular artery.

FMA66322.name: left thoracodorsal artery
FMA66322.text: Left thoracodorsal artery is a thoracodorsal artery. It branches from Left subscapular artery. It is a regional part of Left subscapular artery.

FMA66326.name: pulmonary artery
FMA66326.text: Arterial tree, each instance of which directs unoxygenated blood to some lung.

FMA66327.name: branch of right coronary artery
FMA66327.text: Branch of right coronary artery is a coronary artery. Anatomical type — Coronary artery: Systemic artery which supplies the heart.

FMA66328.name: branch of left coronary artery
FMA66328.text: Branch of left coronary artery is a coronary artery. Anatomical type — Coronary artery: Systemic artery which supplies the heart.

FMA66332.name: zone of artery
FMA66332.text: Zone of artery is an organ zone. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA66358.name: trunk of superior mesenteric artery
FMA66358.text: Trunk of superior mesenteric artery is a systemic arterial trunk. It is a regional part of Superior mesenteric artery. It is continuous with Aorta.

FMA66362.name: trunk of renal artery
FMA66362.text: Trunk of renal artery is a systemic arterial trunk. It is a regional part of Renal artery.

FMA66363.name: trunk of right renal artery
FMA66363.text: Trunk of right renal artery is a trunk of renal artery. It is a regional part of Right renal artery. It is continuous with Aorta.

FMA66364.name: trunk of left renal artery
FMA66364.text: Trunk of left renal artery is a trunk of renal artery. It is a regional part of Left renal artery. It is continuous with Aorta.

FMA66403.name: anterior interventricular vein
FMA66403.text: Anterior interventricular vein is a cardiac vein. It belongs to Set of veins of heart.

FMA66464.name: systemic artery
FMA66464.text: Arterial tree, each instance of which carries oxygenated blood from some heart.

FMA66562.name: trunk of thoraco-acromial artery
FMA66562.text: Trunk of thoraco-acromial artery is a trunk of region of axillary artery. It is a regional part of Thoraco-acromial artery. It forms part of Shoulder and Pectoral region of shoulder.

FMA66563.name: trunk of right thoraco-acromial artery
FMA66563.text: Trunk of right thoraco-acromial artery is a trunk of thoraco-acromial artery. It is a regional part of Right thoraco-acromial artery. It forms part of Pectoral part of right shoulder and Right shoulder.

FMA66564.name: trunk of left thoraco-acromial artery
FMA66564.text: Trunk of left thoraco-acromial artery is a trunk of thoraco-acromial artery. It is a regional part of Left thoraco-acromial artery. It forms part of Pectoral part of left shoulder and Left shoulder.

FMA66643.name: pulmonary vein
FMA66643.text: Vein in the pulmonary vemnous system.

FMA66644.name: systemic vein
FMA66644.text: Vein in the systemic venous system.

FMA66645.name: portal vein
FMA66645.text: Portal vein is a venous tree.

FMA66791.name: proximal phalanx of left little finger
FMA66791.text: Proximal phalanx of left little finger is a proximal phalanx of little finger. It forms part of Left little finger. It belongs to Set of phalanges of left little finger.

FMA67112.name: immaterial anatomical entity
FMA67112.text: Physical anatomical entity, each instance of which is a three-dimensional space, surface, line or point associated with some material anatomical entity. Anatomical type — Physical anatomical entity: Anatomical entity, each instance of which has three or fewer spatial dimensions.

FMA67135.name: anatomical structure
FMA67135.text: Anatomical structure present after birth. Anatomical type — Anatomical structure: Material anatomical entity which is generated by coordinated expression of the organism's own genes that guide its morphogenesis; has inherent 3D shape; its parts are connected and spatially related to one another in patterns determined by coordinated gene expression.

FMA67165.name: material anatomical entity
FMA67165.text: Physical anatomical entity, each instance of which has mass. Anatomical type — Physical anatomical entity: Anatomical entity, each instance of which has three or fewer spatial dimensions.

FMA67242.name: gray matter of neuraxis
FMA67242.text: Cell part cluster consisting predominantly of somas of neurons in the brain and the spinal cord. Anatomical type — Cell part cluster: Anatomical cluster which has as direct parts cell parts from two or more cells.

FMA67325.name: occipital lobe
FMA67325.text: Occipital lobe is the one of five lobes of the cerebral hemisphere which occupies the posterior-most portion of the hemisphere. Anteriorly, it shares an arbitrary border with the parietal lobe and temporal lobe. Medially, it is bounded by the longitudinal cerebral fissure. It is a regional part of Cerebral hemisphere. It forms part of Occipital part of head.

FMA67329.name: insula
FMA67329.text: Lobe of cerebral hemispheere located in the depths of the lateral fissure and is covered by portions of the frontal, parietal and temporal lobes. It is a regional part of Cerebral hemisphere.

FMA67396.name: articular disk of symphysis
FMA67396.text: Articular disk of symphysis is a skeletal cartilage organ. Anatomical type — Skeletal cartilage organ: Cartilage organ of the skeletal system.

FMA67498.name: organ
FMA67498.text: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has a maximal complement of instances of two or more types of tissue or one or more types of essential morphologic unit, a predominantly bona fide boundary and intrinsic vasculature and neural network. Anatomical type — Postnatal anatomical structure: Anatomical structure present after birth.

FMA67504.name: subdivision of cardinal body part
FMA67504.text: anatomical structure, each instance of which is a regional part of some cardinal body part; it has as its constitutional part some subdivision of the integument, such that for each instance of cardinal body part the meronymic sum of its cardinal subdivisions constitutes the instance of cardinal body part. Anatomical type — Postnatal anatomical structure: Anatomical structure present after birth.

FMA67536.name: cardinal tissue part
FMA67536.text: Anatomical structure, each instance of which is a subdivision of some tissue demarcated by bonafide or fiat boundaries. Anatomical type — Postnatal anatomical structure: Anatomical structure present after birth.

FMA67538.name: subdivision of epithelium
FMA67538.text: Tissue component of epithelium is a cardinal tissue part. Anatomical type — Cardinal tissue part: Anatomical structure, each instance of which is a subdivision of some tissue demarcated by bonafide or fiat boundaries.

FMA67552.name: anatomical cavity
FMA67552.text: Anatomical space which contains portions of one or more body substances and is bounded by the internal surface of one maximally connected anatomical structure or two or more adjacent anatomical structures. Anatomical type — Anatomical space: Immaterial anatomical entity, each instance of which has three spatial dimensions.

FMA67598.name: leaf of cardiac valve
FMA67598.text: Organ component which is attached to the chorda tendinea and the fibrous rings of tricuspid and mitral valves. It is continuous with Endocardium.

FMA67601.name: process of organ
FMA67601.text: Bone process is a zone of bone organ. Anatomical type — Organ zone: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more floating fiat boundaries.

FMA67619.name: organ region
FMA67619.text: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ. Anatomical type — Cardinal organ part: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts some instance of portions of two or more types of tissue and is continuous with some instance of one or more anatomical structures, likewise constituted by some portions of two or more tissues distinct from those of their complement.

FMA67936.name: left optic tract
FMA67936.text: Optic tract which is continuous with the optic chiasm and the left lateral geniculate nucleus. It is a regional part of Optic nerve-tract complex.

FMA67942.name: segment of metencephalon
FMA67942.text: Segment of metencephalon is a segment of cell part cluster of neuraxis.

FMA67943.name: pons
FMA67943.text: Organ component of neuraxis that has as its parts the pontine tegmentum and basal part of pons. It is a regional part of Brainstem. It forms part of Metencephalon. Its arterial supply includes Branch of anterior inferior cerebellar artery to pons and Pontine artery.

FMA67944.name: cerebellum
FMA67944.text: Segment of neuraxis that has as its parts the cerebellar cortex, cerebellar nuclear complex and cerebellar white matter. It forms part of Basicranial part of head proper and Metencephalon. Its arterial supply includes Anterior inferior cerebellar artery, Posterior inferior cerebellar artery and Superior cerebellar artery.

FMA67950.name: stria of telencephalon
FMA67950.text: Stria of telencephalon is a stria of neuraxis.

FMA67951.name: lamina of cerebral hemisphere
FMA67951.text: Lamina of cerebral hemisphere is a lamina of neuraxis.

FMA67957.name: segment of gyrus of cerebral hemisphere
FMA67957.text: Segment of gyrus of brain is a segment of cerebral hemisphere.

FMA67977.name: dorsal venous network of hand
FMA67977.text: Dorsal venous network of hand is a set of systemic veins.

FMA68045.name: segment of thoracic aorta
FMA68045.text: Segment of thoracic aorta is a segment of aorta.

FMA68068.name: inferior phrenic vein
FMA68068.text: Inferior phrenic vein is a subdivision of inferior systemic venous tree. It is a regional part of Inferior systemic venous tree.

FMA68109.name: bronchial artery
FMA68109.text: Bronchial artery is a systemic artery. It supplies blood to Lung.

FMA68192.name: lobar artery
FMA68192.text: Lobar artery is a pulmonary artery. Anatomical type — Pulmonary artery: Arterial tree, each instance of which directs unoxygenated blood to some lung.

FMA68197.name: right upper lobar artery
FMA68197.text: Right upper lobar artery is an upper lobar artery. It branches from Right pulmonary artery. It is a regional part of Intrapulmonary part of right pulmonary artery and Right pulmonary artery. It forms part of Upper lobe of right lung.

FMA68208.name: pulmonary segment of bronchial tree
FMA68208.text: Pulmonary segment of bronchial tree is a segment of bronchial tree. It is a regional part of Lobar bronchial tree. It forms part of Bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA68211.name: right apical segmental bronchial tree
FMA68211.text: Right apical segmental bronchial tree is an apical segmental bronchial tree. It is a regional part of Upper lobe part of right bronchial tree. It forms part of Right apical bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA68212.name: right anterior segmental bronchial tree
FMA68212.text: Right anterior segmental bronchial tree is an anterior segmental bronchial tree. It is a regional part of Upper lobe part of right bronchial tree. It forms part of Right anterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA68213.name: right posterior segmental bronchial tree
FMA68213.text: Right posterior segmental bronchial tree is a posterior segmental bronchial tree. It is a regional part of Upper lobe part of right bronchial tree. It forms part of Right posterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA68214.name: medial segmental bronchial tree
FMA68214.text: Medial segmental bronchial tree is a pulmonary segment of bronchial tree. It is a regional part of Middle lobe part of right bronchial tree. It forms part of Medial bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA68215.name: lateral segmental bronchial tree
