Anatomical type — Cardinal organ part: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts some instance of portions of two or more types of tissue and is continuous with some instance of one or more anatomical structures, likewise constituted by some portions of two or more tissues distinct from those of their complement.

FMA86127.name: branch of posterior choroidal artery
FMA86127.text: Branch of posterior choroidal artery is a branch of posterior cerebral artery.

FMA86140.name: organ segment
FMA86140.text: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries. Anatomical type — Organ region: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ.

FMA86187.name: segment of arterial tree organ
FMA86187.text: Arborial segment of arterial tree organ is a segment of blood vessel tree organ. Anatomical type — Segment of blood vessel tree organ: Organ segment which is regional part of blood vessel tree organ.

FMA86188.name: segment of venous tree organ
FMA86188.text: Arborial segment of venous tree organ is a segment of blood vessel tree organ. Anatomical type — Segment of blood vessel tree organ: Organ segment which is regional part of blood vessel tree organ.

FMA86195.name: segment of lacrimal duct
FMA86195.text: Organ segment which is regional part of lacrimal duct. Anatomical type — Organ segment: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA86212.name: region of wall of heart
FMA86212.text: Region of wall of heart is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA86254.name: segment of systemic artery
FMA86254.text: Segment of systemic arterial tree is a regional segment of arterial tree.

FMA86256.name: segment of arterial trunk
FMA86256.text: Segment of arterial trunk is a blood vessel. Anatomical type — Blood vessel: Segment of blood vessel tree organ which is a tubular structure the lumen of which contains blood; together with other spatially associated blood vessels constitute blood vessel tree organ.

FMA86340.name: superior segmental branch of right renal artery
FMA86340.text: Superior segmental branch of right renal artery is a superior segmental renal artery. It supplies blood to Superior segment of right kidney.

FMA86341.name: superior segmental branch of left renal artery
FMA86341.text: Superior segmental branch of left renal artery is a superior segmental renal artery. It supplies blood to Superior segment of left kidney.

FMA86346.name: inferior segmental branch of right renal artery
FMA86346.text: Inferior segmental branch of right renal artery is an inferior segmental renal artery. It supplies blood to Inferior renal segment of right kidney.

FMA86347.name: inferior segmental branch of left renal artery
FMA86347.text: Inferior segmental branch of left renal artery is an inferior segmental renal artery. It supplies blood to Inferior renal segment of left kidney.

FMA86348.name: posterior segmental branch of right renal artery
FMA86348.text: Posterior segmental branch of right renal artery is a posterior segmental renal artery. It supplies blood to Posterior renal segment of right kidney.

FMA86349.name: posterior segmental branch of left renal artery
FMA86349.text: Posterior segmental branch of left renal artery is a posterior segmental renal artery. It supplies blood to Posterior renal segment of left kidney.

FMA86375.name: ligament organ component
FMA86375.text: Ligament organ component is an organ component. Anatomical type — Organ component: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.

FMA86464.name: corpus callosum
FMA86464.text: Corpus callosum is a white matter of telencephalon. It is a regional part of Intercerebral commissure and White matter structure of cerebral hemisphere. Its arterial supply includes Median callosal artery.

FMA86565.name: region of papillary muscle of left ventricle
FMA86565.text: Region of papillary muscle of left ventricle is a region of papillary muscle. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA86566.name: region of lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle
FMA86566.text: Region of lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle is a region of papillary muscle of left ventricle.

FMA87217.name: descending thoracic aorta
FMA87217.text: Descending thoracic aorta is a segment of thoracic aorta. It is a regional part of Descending aorta.

FMA87218.name: trunk of coronary artery
FMA87218.text: Trunk of coronary artery is a systemic arterial trunk. Anatomical type — Arterial trunk: Tubular organ part, the wall and lumen of which are continuous with those of the ventricles of the heart, directly or indirectly through branches of the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

FMA222905.name: segment of colon
FMA222905.text: Segment of colon is a segment of large intestine. Anatomical type — Segment of large intestine: Organ segment which is regional part of large intestine.

FMA223151.name: internal gray matter component
FMA223151.text: Gray matter component of neuraxis which is located in the interior of the neuraxis. Anatomical type — Gray matter of neuraxis: Cell part cluster consisting predominantly of somas of neurons in the brain and the spinal cord.

FMA225818.name: region of layer of wall of eyeball
FMA225818.text: Region of layer of wall of eyeball is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA228667.name: set of organ parts
FMA228667.text: Anatomical set which has as its direct members organ parts of same type. Anatomical type — Anatomical set: Material anatomical entity which consists of a maximum number of some instances of discontinuous members of the same class.

FMA230984.name: middle phalanx of little toe
FMA230984.text: Middle phalanx of little toe is a phalanx of little toe. It forms part of Little toe. It belongs to Set of phalanges of little toe.

FMA230986.name: middle phalanx of right little toe
FMA230986.text: Middle phalanx of right little toe is a middle phalanx of little toe. It forms part of Right little toe. It belongs to Set of phalanges of right little toe.

FMA230988.name: middle phalanx of left little toe
FMA230988.text: Middle phalanx of left little toe is a middle phalanx of little toe. It forms part of Left little toe. It belongs to Set of phalanges of left little toe.

FMA241998.name: cerebral white matter
FMA241998.text: Cerebral white matter is a white matter of telencephalon. It forms part of Subcortex of cerebral hemisphere.

FMA242193.name: region of cerebral cortex
FMA242193.text: Region of cerebral cortex is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA242770.name: region of wall of ventricular system of neuraxis
FMA242770.text: Region of wall of ventricular system of neuraxis is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA242789.name: region of ventricular system of neuraxis
FMA242789.text: Region of ventricular system of neuraxis is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA256174.name: region of cerebral white matter
FMA256174.text: Segment of cerebral white matter is a white matter of telencephalon. Anatomical type — White matter of neuraxis: Cell part cluster consisting predominantly of neurites in the brain and the spinal cord.

FMA256194.name: orbital gyrus
FMA256194.text: Orbital gyrus is a gyrus of frontal lobe. Anatomical type — Gyrus of brain: Segment of cerebral hemisphere which has as its direct proper parts cortical gray matter bounded by sulcal and surface fiat anatomical boundaries.

FMA256237.name: segment of neuraxis
FMA256237.text: Organ segment which is a regional part of neuraxis. Anatomical type — Organ segment: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries.

FMA256693.name: nucleus of thalamus
FMA256693.text: Nucleus of thalamus is a nucleus of brain. Anatomical type — Nucleus of brain: Nucleus of neuraxis which is located within the brain.

FMA258714.name: right thalamus
FMA258714.text: Right thalamus is a thalamus. It is a regional part of Thalamic complex.

FMA258716.name: left thalamus
FMA258716.text: Left thalamus is a thalamus. It is a regional part of Thalamic complex.

FMA258847.name: right calcaneal tendon
FMA258847.text: Right calcaneal tendon is a calcaneal tendon. Anatomical type — Calcaneal tendon: Skeletal ligament, each instance of which is a fibrous cord of connective tissue that attaches some triceps sura and plantaris muscles to the tuberosity of some calcaneus.

FMA258850.name: right intermediate tendon
FMA258850.text: Right intermediate tendon is an intermediate tendon. Anatomical type — Tendon: Organ component of muscle which consists of bundles of collagen fibrils (Type I collagen) bound by loose connective tissue.

FMA260791.name: white matter of right cerebral hemisphere
FMA260791.text: White matter of right cerebral hemisphere is a cerebral white matter. It forms part of Subcortex of right cerebral hemisphere.

FMA260794.name: white matter of left cerebral hemisphere
FMA260794.text: White matter of left cerebral hemisphere is a cerebral white matter. It forms part of Subcortex of left cerebral hemisphere.

FMA264844.name: left calcaneal tendon
FMA264844.text: Left calcaneal tendon is a calcaneal tendon. Anatomical type — Calcaneal tendon: Skeletal ligament, each instance of which is a fibrous cord of connective tissue that attaches some triceps sura and plantaris muscles to the tuberosity of some calcaneus.

FMA265178.name: ligament of lower limb
FMA265178.text: Ligament of lower limb is a ligament of limb. Anatomical type — Skeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of regular dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi; connects bone and cartilage organs.

FMA265180.name: ligament of limb
FMA265180.text: Ligament of limb is a skeletal ligament. Anatomical type — Skeletal ligament: Ligament organ that primarily consists of regular dense connective tissue aggregated into fasciculi; connects bone and cartilage organs.

FMA265400.name: region of vascular layer of eyeball
FMA265400.text: Region of vascular layer of eyeball is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA266054.name: subdivision of cranial dura mater
FMA266054.text: Subdivision of cranial dura mater is a region of dura mater. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA268667.name: right recurrent interosseous artery
FMA268667.text: Right recurrent interosseous artery is a recurrent interosseous artery.

FMA268669.name: left recurrent interosseous artery
FMA268669.text: Left recurrent interosseous artery is a recurrent interosseous artery.

FMA268712.name: segment of anterior tibial artery
FMA268712.text: Segment of anterior tibial artery is a segment of systemic arterial tree.

FMA268955.name: region of papillary muscle
FMA268955.text: Region of papillary muscle is a region of organ component. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA3734.name: aorta
FMA3734.text: Aorta is a systemic arterial trunk. It is a regional part of Systemic arterial tree. It is continuous with Trunk of left subclavian artery, Trunk of right eleventh posterior intercostal artery and Trunk of left renal artery, among other structures.

FMA3862.name: anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
FMA3862.text: Branch of left coronary artery which is the direct continuation of the left coronary artery along the anterior interventricular sulcus, consisting of the conus branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary, the anterior ventricular branch of anterior interventricular artery, the left diagonal artery and the septal branch of anterior interventricular artery that supplies both the cardiac ventricles and the anterior two thirds of the interventricular septum. It branches from Left coronary artery. It is a regional part of Left coronary artery. It supplies blood to Atrioventricular bundle, Anterior interventricular septum and Left ventricle, among other structures.

FMA4717.name: anterior cardiac venous tree
FMA4717.text: Anterior cardiac venous tree is a cardiac venous tree. It is a regional part of Vasculature of female body, Vasculature of male body and Vasculature of body.

FMA7088.name: heart
FMA7088.text: A muscular organ that pumps blood through the pulmonary and systemic circulations. Its chambers, valves and associated vessels coordinate blood flow through the lungs and the rest of the body.

FMA7096.name: right atrium
FMA7096.text: Right cardiac chamber which is continuous with the superior vena cava and inferior vena cava. It is a regional part of Biatrial part of heart and Right side of heart. Its nerve supply includes Deep cardiac nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Anterior atrial branch of right coronary artery, Recurrent atrioventricular branch of right coronary artery and Posterior atrial branch of right coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA7097.name: left atrium
FMA7097.text: Left cardiac chamber which is continuous with the pulmonary venous trunk. It is a regional part of Left side of heart, Basal zone of heart and Biatrial part of heart. Its arterial supply includes Atrial branch of circumflex coronary artery, Recurrent atrioventricular branch of right coronary artery and Posterior atrial branch of right coronary artery, among other structures. Its venous drainage includes Great cardiac vein and Oblique vein of left atrium.

FMA7098.name: right ventricle
FMA7098.text: Right cardiac chamber which is continuous with the pulmonary arterial trunk. It is a regional part of Mid zone of heart, Right side of heart and Biventricular part of heart. Its nerve supply includes Deep cardiac nerve plexus and Right coronary nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery, Absent left coronary artery and Ventricular branch of right coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA7101.name: left ventricle
FMA7101.text: Left cardiac chamber which is continuous with the aorta. It is a regional part of Left side of heart and Biventricular part of heart. Its nerve supply includes Superficial cardiac nerve plexus and Deep cardiac nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Posterior ventricular branch of circumflex coronary artery, Absent right coronary artery and Left anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA7152.name: alimentary system
FMA7152.text: Alimentary system is an organ system. Anatomical type — Organ system: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of one or more organ types which are interconnected with one another by zones of continuity.

FMA7154.name: head
FMA7154.text: cardinal body part, each instance of which has as its constitutional part some skull. It is a regional part of Adult human body, Craniocervical region and Male adult human body, among other structures.

FMA7155.name: neck
FMA7155.text: Subdivision of body proper, which consists of a maximal set of diverse subclasses of organ and organ part spatially associated with the cervical vertebral coumn, it is partially surrounded by skin of neck. It is a regional part of Male body proper, Body proper and Female body proper, among other structures.

FMA7157.name: nervous system
FMA7157.text: Nervous system is an organ system. It forms part of Female adult human body, Adult human body and Male adult human body.

FMA7158.name: respiratory system
FMA7158.text: Anatomical context: Organ system, each instance of which consists of tubular and cavernous structures related to airflow from some mouth and nose to some lungs and vice-versa. Functional system which consists of structures involved in respiration (gas exchange). Anatomical type — Organ system: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of one or more organ types which are interconnected with one another by zones of continuity.

FMA7159.name: urinary system
FMA7159.text: Urinary system is an organ system. It is a regional part of Genitourinary system.

FMA7160.name: genital system
FMA7160.text: Genital system is an organ system. It is a regional part of Genitourinary system.

FMA7161.name: cardiovascular system
FMA7161.text: Organ system which consists of heart, systemic and pulmonary arterial and trees, and lymphatic and portal venous trees and body substance contained within. Anatomical type — Organ system: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of one or more organ types which are interconnected with one another by zones of continuity.

FMA7165.name: right side of heart
FMA7165.text: Region of heart which has as its parts the right atrium and right ventricle. It is a regional part of Heart and Systemic venous system. Its arterial supply includes Right coronary artery. It is continuous with Superior systemic venous tree, Left side of heart and Inferior systemic venous tree, among other structures.

FMA7166.name: left side of heart
FMA7166.text: Region of heart which has as its parts the left atrium and left ventricle. It is a regional part of Heart and Systemic arterial system. Its arterial supply includes Left coronary artery. Its venous drainage includes Coronary sinus.

FMA7181.name: trunk
FMA7181.text: subdivision of cardinal body part, each instance of which has as its constitutional part the thoracic, lumbar and sacral parts (T1-S5) of some vertebral column. It is a regional part of Body proper.

FMA7184.name: lower limb
FMA7184.text: limb,each instance of which has as its regional part some pelvic girdle region and some free lower limb.. Examples" There are two lower limbs, right lower limb and left lower limb. Anatomical type — Limb: cardinal body part, each instance of which has as its constitutional part some appendicular skeleton.

FMA7185.name: right upper limb
FMA7185.text: Right upper limb is an upper limb. It is a regional part of Female adult human body, Male adult human body and Adult human body. It belongs to Set of all limbs.

FMA7186.name: left upper limb
FMA7186.text: Left upper limb is an upper limb. It is a regional part of Adult human body, Male adult human body and Female adult human body. It belongs to Set of all limbs.

FMA7187.name: right lower limb
FMA7187.text: Right lower limb is a lower limb. It is a regional part of Female adult human body, Male adult human body and Adult human body. It belongs to Set of all limbs.

FMA7188.name: left lower limb
FMA7188.text: Left lower limb is a lower limb. It is a regional part of Female adult human body, Male adult human body and Adult human body. It belongs to Set of all limbs.

FMA7197.name: liver
FMA7197.text: An abdominal organ that produces bile and processes nutrients. It contributes to carbohydrate, fat and protein metabolism, stores glycogen, and makes proteins involved in blood clotting.

FMA7200.name: small intestine
FMA7200.text: Organ with organ cavity, each instance of which is proximally continuous_with some stomach; distally continuous_with some large intestine. It is a regional part of Gastrointestinal tract and Intestine. It is contained in Abdominal cavity. Its nerve supply includes Celiac nerve plexus.

FMA7201.name: large intestine
FMA7201.text: Organ with organ cavity, each instance of which is proximally continuous_with some small intestine; distally continuous_with some anal canal. It is a regional part of Gastrointestinal tract and Intestine. It is contained in Abdominal cavity. Its nerve supply includes Inferior rectal nerve plexus, Inferior hypogastric nerve plexus and Superior hypogastric nerve plexus, among other structures.

FMA7207.name: jejunum
FMA7207.text: Jejunum is a segment of small intestine. It is a regional part of Small intestine and Lower gastrointestinal tract. It is continuous with Duodenum and Ileum.

FMA7208.name: ileum
FMA7208.text: Ileum is a segment of small intestine. It is a regional part of Lower gastrointestinal tract and Small intestine. It is continuous with Jejunum and Cecum.

FMA7216.name: outflow part of right ventricle
FMA7216.text: Outflow part of ventricle which is continuous with the pulmonary trunk. It is a regional part of Right ventricle. Its arterial supply includes Conus branch of right coronary artery and Conus branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is continuous with Pulmonary trunk.

FMA7234.name: tricuspid valve
FMA7234.text: Atrioventricular valve which has as its parts the anterior, posterior and septal leaflets, attached to the fibrous ring of tricuspid valve. It forms part of Right side of heart, Right atrium and Heart, among other structures. It is continuous with Endocardium of right atrium and Endocardium of right ventricle.

FMA7235.name: mitral valve
FMA7235.text: Atrioventricular valve which has as its parts the anterior and posterior leaflets, attached to the fibrous ring of mitral valve. It forms part of Left side of heart, Outflow part of left atrium and Left atrium, among other structures. It is continuous with Endocardium of left ventricle and Endocardium of left atrium.

FMA7236.name: aortic valve
FMA7236.text: Cardiac valve which has as its parts the anterior, right posterior and left posterior cusps, attached to the fibrous ring of aortic valve. It forms part of Left side of heart, Heart and Left ventricle, among other structures. It is continuous with Endocardium of left ventricle.

FMA7246.name: pulmonary valve
FMA7246.text: Cardiac valve which has as its parts the right anterior, left anterior and posterior cusps, attached to the fibrous ring of pulmonary valve. It forms part of Right side of heart, Outflow part of right ventricle and Heart, among other structures. It is continuous with Endocardium of right ventricle.

FMA7259.name: papillary muscle of right ventricle
FMA7259.text: Papillary muscle which consists of the anteiror, posterior and septal papillary muscles of right ventricle and is continuous with the chorda tendinea of the right ventricle. It is a regional part of Wall of right ventricle. It forms part of Wall of inflow part of right ventricle and Subendocardial layer of myocardium of right ventricle. It is continuous with Chorda tendinea of right ventricle, Septomarginal trabecula and Trabecula carnea of right ventricle, among other structures.

FMA7309.name: right lung
FMA7309.text: Lung located right of sagittal midplane of body and which consists of the right upper lobe, middle lobe and right lower lobe. It is a regional part of Lower respiratory tract. It forms part of Right pulmopleural compartment, Right hemithorax and Intrathoracic part of chest. It is contained in Right half of thoracic cavity and Thoracic cavity.

FMA7310.name: left lung
FMA7310.text: Lung located left of sagittal midplane of body and which consists of the left upper lobe and left lower lobe. It is a regional part of Lower respiratory tract. It forms part of Intrathoracic part of chest, Left hemithorax and Left pulmopleural compartment. It is contained in Left half of thoracic cavity and Thoracic cavity.

FMA7333.name: upper lobe of right lung
FMA7333.text: Upper lobe of right lung is an upper lobe of lung. It is a regional part of Right lung. It is contained in Right half of thoracic cavity. Its arterial supply includes Right bronchial artery.

FMA7337.name: lower lobe of right lung
FMA7337.text: Lower lobe of right lung is a lower lobe of lung. It is a regional part of Right lung.

FMA7338.name: right apical bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7338.text: Right apical bronchopulmonary segment is an apical bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of right lung.

FMA7339.name: right posterior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7339.text: Right posterior bronchopulmonary segment is a posterior bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of right lung.

FMA7359.name: right anterior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7359.text: Right anterior bronchopulmonary segment is an anterior bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of right lung.

FMA7360.name: medial bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7360.text: Medial bronchopulmonary segment is a bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Middle lobe of right lung.

FMA7361.name: lateral bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7361.text: Lateral bronchopulmonary segment is a bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Middle lobe of right lung.

FMA7362.name: right posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7362.text: Right posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment is a posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of right lung.

FMA7363.name: right lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7363.text: Right lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment is a lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of right lung.

FMA7364.name: right anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7364.text: Right anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment is an anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of right lung.

FMA7365.name: right medial basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7365.text: Right medial basal bronchopulmonary segment is a medial basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of right lung.

FMA7366.name: right superior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7366.text: Right superior bronchopulmonary segment is a superior bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of right lung.

FMA7370.name: upper lobe of left lung
FMA7370.text: Upper lobe of left lung is an upper lobe of lung. It is a regional part of Left lung. It is contained in Left half of thoracic cavity. Its arterial supply includes Left first bronchial artery.

FMA7371.name: lower lobe of left lung
FMA7371.text: Lower lobe of left lung is a lower lobe of lung. It is a regional part of Left lung.

FMA7372.name: apicoposterior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7372.text: Apicoposterior bronchopulmonary segment is a bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA7373.name: left anterior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7373.text: Left anterior bronchopulmonary segment is an anterior bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA7374.name: superior lingular bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7374.text: Superior lingular bronchopulmonary segment is a bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA7375.name: inferior lingular bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7375.text: Inferior lingular bronchopulmonary segment is a bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA7376.name: left superior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7376.text: Left superior bronchopulmonary segment is a superior bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of left lung.

FMA7377.name: left medial basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7377.text: Left medial basal bronchopulmonary segment is a medial basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of left lung.

FMA7378.name: left anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7378.text: Left anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment is an anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of left lung.

FMA7379.name: left lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7379.text: Left lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment is a lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of left lung.

FMA7380.name: left posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7380.text: Left posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment is a posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Lower lobe of left lung.

FMA7383.name: middle lobe of lung
FMA7383.text: Middle lobe of right lung is a lobe of lung. It is a regional part of Right lung.

FMA7385.name: left apical bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7385.text: Left apical bronchopulmonary segment is an apical bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA7386.name: left posterior bronchopulmonary segment
FMA7386.text: Left posterior bronchopulmonary segment is a posterior bronchopulmonary segment. It is a regional part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA7393.name: tracheobronchial tree
FMA7393.text: Hollow tree organ which is connected to larynx and maximal set of alveolar ducts. It is a regional part of Lower respiratory tract. It is continuous with Lung, Left lung and Right lung.

FMA7395.name: right main bronchus
FMA7395.text: Right main bronchus is a main bronchus. It is a regional part of Right bronchial tree. It forms part of Root of right lung, Content of posterior mediastinum and Content of mediastinum. It is continuous with Right superior lobar bronchus and Trachea.

FMA7480.name: rib cage
FMA7480.text: Rib cage is a subdivision of postcranial axial skeletal system. It is a regional part of Postcranial axial skeletal system and Skeletal system of thoracic segment of trunk. It forms part of Wall of thorax and Musculoskeletal system of thorax.

FMA7481.name: skeletal system of thorax
FMA7481.text: Skeletal system of thoracic segment of trunk is a subdivision of skeletal system. It is a regional part of Skeletal system of trunk. It forms part of Musculoskeletal system of thoracic segment of trunk.

FMA7482.name: musculoskeletal system
FMA7482.text: Musculoskeletal system is an organ system. It forms part of Male adult human body, Adult human body and Female adult human body.

FMA7483.name: axial skeletal system
FMA7483.text: *Subdivision of the skeletal system which has as its direct parts skull, rib cage, the vertebral column and the bony pelvis. It is a regional part of Skeletal system.

FMA7485.name: sternum
FMA7485.text: Flat bone, each instance of which is some flat bone forming the middle of the anterior part of some rib cage. It forms part of Rib cage and Sternal part of chest. It belongs to Skeleton of thoracic segment of trunk and Postcranial axial skeleton.

FMA7563.name: body compartment
FMA7563.text: Compartment of trunk, which is embryologically derived from the intraembryonic celom; is located in the trunk, is enclosed by the body wall; contains serous sacs, viscera and other organs. It forms part of Body proper and Trunk.

FMA7647.name: spinal cord
FMA7647.text: Segment of neuraxis which consists of portion of neural tissue continuous with and caudal to brain, surround central canal and contained in space of vertebral canal. It is a regional part of Neuraxis. Its arterial supply includes Anterior spinal artery, Vertebral artery and Posterior spinal artery. Its venous drainage includes Intervertebral vein.

FMA8617.name: right apical segmental artery
FMA8617.text: Right apical segmental artery is an apical segmental artery. It branches from Apicoposterior division of right upper lobar artery. It is a regional part of Apicoposterior division of right upper lobar artery. It forms part of Right apical bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8619.name: right posterior segmental artery
FMA8619.text: Right posterior segmental artery is a posterior segmental artery. It branches from Apicoposterior division of right upper lobar artery. It is a regional part of Apicoposterior division of right upper lobar artery. It forms part of Right posterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8627.name: right superior segmental artery
FMA8627.text: Right superior segmental artery is a superior segmental artery. It branches from Basal portion of right pulmonary artery, Right lower lobar artery and Interlobar portion of right pulmonary artery. It is a regional part of Right lower lobar artery. It forms part of Right superior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8630.name: right anterior basal segmental artery
FMA8630.text: Right anterior basal segmental artery is an anterior basal segmental artery. It branches from Right anteromedial basal pulmonary artery and Right lower lobar artery. It is a regional part of Right basal segmental artery. It forms part of Right anterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8631.name: right lateral basal segmental artery
FMA8631.text: Right lateral basal segmental artery is a lateral basal segmental artery. It branches from Right posterolateral basal pulmonary artery and Right lower lobar artery. It is a regional part of Right basal segmental artery. It forms part of Right lateral basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8632.name: right posterior basal segmental artery
FMA8632.text: Right posterior basal segmental artery is a posterior basal segmental artery. It branches from Right lower lobar artery and Right posterolateral basal pulmonary artery. It is a regional part of Right basal segmental artery. It forms part of Right posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8655.name: right upper lobar vein
FMA8655.text: Right upper lobar vein is an upper lobar vein. It is a tributary of Right superior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Right superior pulmonary vein and Intrapulmonary part of right superior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Upper lobe of right lung.

FMA8656.name: middle lobar vein
FMA8656.text: Middle lobar vein is a lobar vein. It is a tributary of Right superior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Intrapulmonary part of right superior pulmonary vein and Right superior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Middle lobe of right lung.

FMA8657.name: left upper lobar vein
FMA8657.text: Left upper lobar vein is an upper lobar vein. It is a tributary of Left superior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Intrapulmonary part of left superior pulmonary vein and Left superior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Upper lobe of left lung.

FMA8658.name: lingular vein
FMA8658.text: Lingular vein is a pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Left superior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Left superior pulmonary vein and Intrapulmonary part of left superior pulmonary vein.

FMA8661.name: right apical segmental vein
FMA8661.text: Anterior segmental vein, each instance of which is vein draining the apical segment of the superior lobe of some right lung and emptying into some right superior pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Right upper lobar vein. It is a regional part of Right upper lobar vein. It forms part of Right apical bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8664.name: lateral segmental vein
FMA8664.text: Lateral segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Middle lobar vein. It is a regional part of Middle lobar vein. It forms part of Lateral bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8665.name: medial segmental vein
FMA8665.text: Medial segmental vein is a segmental pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Middle lobar vein. It is a regional part of Middle lobar vein. It forms part of Medial bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8666.name: apicoposterior segmental vein
FMA8666.text: Anterior segmental vein, each instance of which is vein draining the apicoposterior segment of the superior lobe of some left lung and emptying into some left superior pulmonary vein. It is a tributary of Left upper lobar vein. It is a regional part of Left upper lobar vein. It forms part of Apicoposterior bronchopulmonary segment.

FMA8671.name: right common basal vein
FMA8671.text: Right common basal vein is a common basal vein. It is a tributary of Right inferior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Intrapulmonary part of right inferior pulmonary vein and Right inferior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Lower lobe of right lung.

FMA8672.name: right superior basal vein
FMA8672.text: Right superior basal vein is a superior basal vein. It is a tributary of Right common basal vein. It is a regional part of Right common basal vein.

FMA8674.name: right inferior basal vein
FMA8674.text: Right inferior basal vein is an inferior basal vein. It is a tributary of Right common basal vein. It is a regional part of Right common basal vein.

FMA8676.name: left common basal vein
FMA8676.text: Left common basal vein is a common basal vein. It is a tributary of Left inferior pulmonary vein. It is a regional part of Intrapulmonary part of left inferior pulmonary vein and Left inferior pulmonary vein. It forms part of Lower lobe of left lung.

FMA8677.name: left superior basal vein
FMA8677.text: Left superior basal vein is a superior basal vein. It is a tributary of Left common basal vein. It is a regional part of Left common basal vein.

FMA8679.name: left inferior basal vein
FMA8679.text: Left inferior basal vein is an inferior basal vein. It is a tributary of Left common basal vein. It is a regional part of Left common basal vein.

FMA9140.name: thoracic vertebral column
FMA9140.text: Thoracic vertebral column is a subdivision of vertebral column. It is a regional part of Vertebral column and Skeletal system of thoracic segment of trunk. It forms part of Back of thorax, Back and Skeletal system of back of thorax, among other structures.

FMA9348.name: subaortic curtain of left ventricle
FMA9348.text: Region of wall of left ventricle which has as its parts the right and left posterior cusps of aortic valve and the anterior leaflet of mitral valve that is attached to the semilunar fibrous scallop of aortic valve anulus. It is a regional part of Fibrous ring of mitral valve. It forms part of Outflow part of left ventricle. It is continuous with Anterior leaflet of mitral valve.

FMA9352.name: papillary muscle of left ventricle
FMA9352.text: Papillary muscle which consists of the lateral and posterior papillary muscles of left ventricle and is continuous with the chorda tendinea of the left ventricle. It forms part of Wall of left ventricle and Subendocardial layer of myocardium of left ventricle. It is continuous with Chorda tendinea of left ventricle, Subendocardial layer of myocardium of ventricle and Trabecula carnea of left ventricle.

FMA9473.name: outflow part of left ventricle
FMA9473.text: Outflow part of ventricle which is continuous with the aorta. It is a regional part of Left ventricle. It is continuous with Ascending trunk of arch of aorta, Commencement of arch of aorta and Aorta.

FMA9496.name: fibrous skeleton of heart
FMA9496.text: Fibrous connective tissue which attaches the leaf and cusp of cardiac valve to the wall of heart. It forms part of Heart.

FMA9498.name: fibrous ring of mitral valve
FMA9498.text: left fibrous ring of heart which consists of the anulus proper, the interfilar connective tissue, the left fibrous trigone and the subaortic curtain of left ventricle that attaches the leaflets of mitral valve to the wall of heart. It is a regional part of Fibrous skeleton of heart and Mitral valve. It forms part of Left atrium and Left ventricle. It is continuous with Myocardium of outflow part of left atrium, Myocardium of biventricular part of heart and Myocardium of inflow part of left ventricle, among other structures.

FMA9533.name: wall of right ventricle
FMA9533.text: Wall of ventricle which is continuous with the wall of pulmonary trunk. It is a regional part of Wall of right side of heart and Wall of biventricular part of heart. It forms part of Right ventricle. It is continuous with Wall of pulmonary trunk, Septomarginal trabecula and Wall of right atrium proper, among other structures.

FMA9535.name: myocardium of right ventricle
FMA9535.text: Myocardium of ventricle which is continuous with the tunica media of the pulmonary trunk. It is a regional part of Myocardium of biventricular part of heart. It forms part of Wall of right ventricle and Wall of right side of heart. Its arterial supply includes Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery, Anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery and Ventricular branch of right coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA9550.name: outflow part of right atrium
FMA9550.text: Outflow part of atrium which consists of wall and cavity of the outflow part of right atrium and the tricuspid valve. It is a regional part of Right atrium, Right atrium proper and Mid zone of heart. It is continuous with Inflow part of right ventricle.

FMA9551.name: outflow part of left atrium
FMA9551.text: Outflow part of left atrium is an outflow part of atrium. It is a regional part of Left atrium and Left atrium proper. It is continuous with Inflow part of left ventricle.

FMA9552.name: inflow part of right ventricle
FMA9552.text: Inflow part of right ventricle is an inflow part of ventricle. It is a regional part of Right ventricle. It is continuous with Outflow part of right atrium.

FMA9553.name: anterior wall of right ventricle
FMA9553.text: Region of wall of right ventricle which is continuous with the lateral and septal walls of right ventricle. It is a regional part of Wall of right ventricle and Free wall of right ventricle. Its arterial supply includes Conus artery and Right anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery. It is continuous with Lateral wall of right ventricle and Septal wall of right ventricle.

FMA9555.name: inferior wall of right ventricle
FMA9555.text: Region of wall of right ventricle which is continuous with lateral and septal walls of right ventricle. It is a regional part of Free wall of right ventricle and Wall of right ventricle. It is continuous with Lateral wall of right ventricle and Septal wall of right ventricle.

FMA9556.name: wall of left ventricle
FMA9556.text: Wall of ventricle which is continuous with the wall of aorta. It is a regional part of Wall of biventricular part of heart and Wall of left side of heart. It forms part of Left ventricle. It is continuous with Muscular part of interventricular septum, Wall proper of left atrium proper and Wall of ascending aorta, among other structures.

FMA9558.name: myocardium of left ventricle
FMA9558.text: Myocardium of ventricle which is continuous with the tunica media of aorta. It is a regional part of Myocardium of biventricular part of heart. It forms part of Wall of left side of heart and Wall of left ventricle. Its arterial supply includes Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery, Left marginal artery and Anterior ventricular branch of circumflex coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA9560.name: anterior wall of left ventricle
FMA9560.text: Region of wall of left ventricle which consists of the endocardium, basal, mid and apical anterior zones of myocardium of left ventricle and epicardium of anterior wall of left ventricle and is continuous with the lateral and septal walls of left ventricle. It is a regional part of Free wall of left ventricle, Anteroseptal wall of left ventricle and Wall of left ventricle. Its nerve supply includes Deep cardiac nerve plexus and Superficial cardiac nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Left anterior branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery, Left marginal artery and Marginal branch of right coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA9561.name: inferior wall of left ventricle
FMA9561.text: Region of wall of left ventricle which consists of the endocardium, basal, mid and apical zones of myocardium of left ventricle and epicardium of inferior wall of myocardium of left ventricle and is continuous witht the lateral and septal walls of left ventricle. It is a regional part of Wall of left ventricle and Free wall of left ventricle. Its nerve supply includes Deep cardiac nerve plexus and Left coronary nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Marginal branch of right coronary artery, Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery and Posterior ventricular branch of circumflex coronary artery, among other structures.

FMA9563.name: lateral wall of left ventricle
FMA9563.text: Region of wall of left ventricle which consists of endocardium, basal, mid and apical lateral zones of myocardium of left ventricle and epicardium of lateral wall of left ventricle and is continuous with the anterior and inferior walls of left ventricle. It is a regional part of Wall of left ventricle and Free wall of left ventricle. Its nerve supply includes Deep cardiac nerve plexus and Superficial cardiac nerve plexus. Its arterial supply includes Posterior ventricular branch of circumflex coronary artery, Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery and Left marginal artery, among other structures.

FMA9564.name: inflow part of left ventricle
FMA9564.text: Inflow part of left ventricle is an inflow part of ventricle. It is a regional part of Left ventricle. It is continuous with Outflow part of left atrium.

FMA9576.name: thorax
FMA9576.text: subdivision of front of trunk, each instance of which has as its constitutional part some complete set of thoracic vertebral bodies (T1-T12) and some ribcage. It is a regional part of Front of trunk, Thoracic segment of trunk and Trunk proper.

FMA9577.name: abdomen
FMA9577.text: subdivision of front of trunk, each instance of which has as its constitutional part some complete set of lumbar vertebral arches (L1-L5); it is demarcated from the abdomen internally by the superior surface of the diaphragm and externally by the costal margin and from the pelvis by the plane of the superior pelvic aperture; together with the abdomen and pelvis constitutes the trunk. It is a regional part of Abdominal segment of trunk, Front of trunk and Trunk proper.

FMA9578.name: pelvis
FMA9578.text: subdivision of front of trunk, each instance of which has as its constitutional part the bony pelvis; it is demarcated from the abdomen by the plane of superior pelvic aperture; together with the thorax and abdomen constitutes the trunk. It is a regional part of Abdomen.

FMA9579.name: perineum
FMA9579.text: Subdivision of trunk proper, which is demarcated from the pelvis by the inferior surface of the pelvic diaphragm and from the lower limbs by the perineofemoral lines; together with the thorax, and abdomen, it constitutes the trunk proper. It is a regional part of Trunk.

FMA9584.name: peritoneum
FMA9584.text: Peritoneum is a viscus serous membrane. It forms part of Peritoneal sac.

FMA9607.name: thymus
FMA9607.text: Corticomedullary organ, each instance of which is some lymphoid organ consisting of two pyramidal lobes located in some anterior superior mediastinum, anterior to some heart and posterior to some sternum. It forms part of Content of superior mediastinum and Content of anterior mediastinum. It is contained in Anterior mediastinal space and Superior mediastinal space. Its nerve supply includes Cervicothoracic ganglion, Left vagus nerve and Right vagus nerve, among other structures.

FMA9668.name: endocrine system
FMA9668.text: Endocrine system is a set of heterogeneous anatomical structures. Anatomical type — Set of heterogeneous anatomical structures: Anatomical set which has as its direct members, organs, organ parts and tissues of same or different types.

FMA9713.name: right hand
FMA9713.text: Right hand is a hand. It is a regional part of Right free upper limb. It belongs to Set of hands.

FMA9714.name: left hand
FMA9714.text: Left hand is a hand. It is a regional part of Left free upper limb. It belongs to Set of hands.

FMA9826.name: mediastinum
FMA9826.text: Subdivsion of thoracic compartment which has as its parts the superior mediastinum and inferior mediastinum. It is a regional part of Compartment of thorax.

FMA9827.name: superior mediastinum
FMA9827.text: Superior mediastinum is a subdivision of mediastinum. It is a regional part of Mediastinum. It is continuous with Inferior mediastinum.

FMA9828.name: inferior mediastinum
FMA9828.text: Inferior mediastinum is a subdivision of mediastinum. It is a regional part of Mediastinum. It is continuous with Superior mediastinum.

FMA9838.name: anterior mediastinum
FMA9838.text: Anterior mediastinum is a subdivision of inferior mediastinum. It is a regional part of Inferior mediastinum. It forms part of Male anterior chest and Anterior chest.

FMA9839.name: middle mediastinum
FMA9839.text: Middle mediastinum is a subdivision of inferior mediastinum. It is a regional part of Inferior mediastinum. It forms part of Anterior chest and Male anterior chest.

FMA9840.name: posterior mediastinum
FMA9840.text: Posterior mediastinum is a subdivision of inferior mediastinum. It is a regional part of Inferior mediastinum. It forms part of Posterior chest.

FMA9908.name: peritoneal sac
FMA9908.text: Serous sac, which has as parts the peritoneum and the peritoneal cavity. It belongs to Set of viscera of abdomen, Set of viscera of female abdomen and Set of viscera of male abdomen.

FMA10427.name: body wall
FMA10427.text: Subdivision of trunk that consists of those organs that separate the body cavity from the body's exterior; together with the body cavity and its contents, the body wall constitutes the trunk (one of the principal body parts). It forms part of Trunk.

FMA10428.name: thoracic wall
FMA10428.text: Heterogeneous cluster which surrounds thoracic cavity and its content; and which includes the ribcage, muscle group of thoracic wall and costal pleura. It forms part of Male chest wall, Female chest wall and Chest wall, among other structures.

FMA10429.name: wall of abdomen proper
FMA10429.text: Wall of abdomen proper is a subdivision of abdomen. It is a regional part of Wall of abdominal segment of trunk and Wall of abdomen. It forms part of Abdomen proper.

FMA10430.name: pelvic wall
FMA10430.text: Wall of pelvis is a heterogeneous anatomical cluster. It is a regional part of Wall of abdominal segment of trunk and Wall of abdomen. It forms part of Pelvis.

FMA11343.name: right foot
FMA11343.text: Right foot is a foot. It is a regional part of Right free lower limb. It belongs to Set of feet.

FMA11344.name: left foot
FMA11344.text: Left foot is a foot. It is a regional part of Left free lower limb. It belongs to Set of feet.

FMA11345.name: right forearm
FMA11345.text: Right forearm is a forearm. It is a regional part of Right free upper limb. It belongs to Set of forearm.

FMA11346.name: left forearm
FMA11346.text: Left forearm is a forearm. It is a regional part of Left free upper limb. It belongs to Set of forearm.

FMA12514.name: right eyeball
FMA12514.text: Right eyeball is an eyeball. It forms part of Face and Right orbital content. It is contained in Right orbital cavity. It belongs to Set of eyeballs.

FMA12515.name: left eyeball
FMA12515.text: Left eyeball is an eyeball. It forms part of Face and Left orbital content. It is contained in Left orbital cavity. It belongs to Set of eyeballs.

FMA13362.name: right lobe of liver
FMA13362.text: Right lobe of liver (classical) is a lobe of liver. Anatomical type — Lobe of liver: Anatomical lobe in liver which is demarcated either by surface landmarks, such as falciform ligament and fissures for ligamentum teres and ligamentum venosum.

FMA13363.name: left lobe of liver
FMA13363.text: Hemiliver located to the left of the main portal scissura. It is a regional part of Liver.

FMA13373.name: right pectoralis major
FMA13373.text: Right pectoralis major is a pectoralis major. It forms part of Superficial chest wall, Male anterior superficial chest wall and Anterior superficial chest wall, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Branch of right lateral pectoral nerve to sternocostal part of right pectoralis major, Branch of right lateral pectoral nerve to clavicular part of right pectoralis major and Branch of right medial pectoral nerve to sternocostal part of right pectoralis major, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of thorax and Right pectoral musculature.

FMA13374.name: left pectoralis major
FMA13374.text: Left pectoralis major is a pectoralis major. It forms part of Female anterior superficial chest wall, Superficial chest wall and Anterior superficial chest wall, among other structures. Its nerve supply includes Branch of left medial pectoral nerve to clavicular part of left pectoralis major, Branch of left lateral pectoral nerve to sternocostal part of left pectoralis major and Branch of left lateral pectoral nerve to clavicular part of left pectoralis major, among other structures. It belongs to Musculature of thorax and Left pectoral musculature.

FMA13478.name: vertebral column
FMA13478.text: Vertebral column is a subdivision of postcranial axial skeletal system. It is a regional part of Postcranial axial skeletal system. It forms part of Back of body proper.

FMA14541.name: cecum
FMA14541.text: Cecum is a segment of large intestine. It is a regional part of Lower gastrointestinal tract and Large intestine. It is continuous with Wall of ascending colon, Appendix and Ileum, among other structures.

FMA14615.name: wall of small intestine
FMA14615.text: Wall of small intestine is a wall of organ. It is a regional part of Wall of intestine. It forms part of Small intestine. It is continuous with Wall of large intestine and Wall of stomach.

FMA14618.name: wall of ileum
FMA14618.text: Wall of ileum is a region of wall of small intestine. It is a regional part of Wall of small intestine. It forms part of Ileum. It drains into Juxta-intestinal lymph node group of ileum.

FMA14619.name: wall of large intestine
FMA14619.text: Wall of large intestine is a wall of organ. It is a regional part of Wall of intestine. It forms part of Large intestine. It is continuous with Wall of anal canal and Wall of small intestine.

FMA14627.name: anterior abdominal wall
FMA14627.text: Anterior abdominal wall is a subdivision of abdomen. It is a regional part of Wall of abdomen proper.

FMA14628.name: posterior abdominal wall
FMA14628.text: Posterior abdominal wall is a heterogeneous anatomical cluster. It is a regional part of Wall of abdomen proper.

FMA14665.name: biliary tree
FMA14665.text: Hollow tree organ which is continuous with the hepatic capillary bed and duodenum. It is a regional part of Biliary system. It belongs to Set of viscera of abdomen.

FMA14703.name: visceral peritoneum
FMA14703.text: Visceral peritoneum is a region of peritoneum. It is a regional part of Peritoneum.

FMA14775.name: gastroduodenal artery
FMA14775.text: Gastroduodenal artery is a branch of common hepatic artery. It branches from Common hepatic artery. It is a regional part of Common hepatic artery.

FMA14778.name: right hepatic artery
FMA14778.text: Right hepatic artery is a hepatic artery. It branches from Hepatic artery proper. It is a regional part of Hepatic artery proper and Vasculature of liver.

FMA14779.name: left hepatic artery
FMA14779.text: Left hepatic artery is a hepatic artery. It branches from Hepatic artery proper. It is a regional part of Hepatic artery proper and Vasculature of liver.

FMA14823.name: inferior branch of ileocolic artery
FMA14823.text: Inferior branch of ileocolic artery is a branch of ileocolic artery. It branches from Ileocolic artery. It is a regional part of Ileocolic artery. It supplies blood to Large intestine.

FMA14971.name: muscle layer of large intestine
FMA14971.text: Muscle layer of large intestine is a muscle layer of digestive tract. It forms part of Wall of large intestine.

FMA15419.name: anterior branch of right portal vein
FMA15419.text: Anterior branch of right portal vein is a subdivision of right hepatic portal vein. It branches from Right portal vein. It is a regional part of Right portal vein.

FMA15422.name: posterior branch of right portal vein
FMA15422.text: Posterior branch of right portal vein is a subdivision of right hepatic portal vein. It branches from Right portal vein. It is a regional part of Right portal vein.

FMA15427.name: medial branch of left portal vein
FMA15427.text: Medial branch of left portal vein is a subdivision of left hepatic portal vein. It branches from Left portal vein. It is a regional part of Left portal vein.

FMA15430.name: lateral branch of left portal vein
FMA15430.text: Lateral branch of left portal vein is a subdivision of left hepatic portal vein. It branches from Left portal vein. It is a regional part of Left portal vein.

FMA15748.name: anterior sector of right liver
FMA15748.text: Anterior sector of right liver is a hepatovenous sector. It is a regional part of Right lobe of liver.

FMA15749.name: posterior sector of right liver
FMA15749.text: Posterior sector of right liver is a hepatovenous sector. It is a regional part of Right lobe of liver.

FMA15750.name: anterior sector of left liver
FMA15750.text: Anterior sector of left liver is a hepatovenous sector. It is a regional part of Left lobe of liver.

FMA15751.name: posterior sector of left liver
FMA15751.text: Posterior sector of left liver is a hepatovenous sector. Anatomical type — Lobular segment of liver: Lobular segment in liver demarcated by the internal distribution pattern of the portal triad and/or the hepatic veins.

FMA15809.name: right hemiliver
FMA15809.text: Hemiliver located to the right of the main portal scissura. It is a regional part of Liver.

FMA15810.name: left hemiliver
FMA15810.text: Hemiliver located to the left of the main portal scissura. It is a regional part of Liver.

FMA16203.name: lumbar vertebral column
FMA16203.text: Lumbar vertebral column is a subdivision of vertebral column. It is a regional part of Vertebral column, Lumbosacral vertebral column and Skeletal system of trunk. It forms part of Posterior abdominal wall, Wall of abdominal segment of trunk and Skeletal system of back of abdomen, among other structures.

FMA16580.name: bony pelvis
FMA16580.text: Bony pelvis is a subdivision of postcranial axial skeletal system. It is a regional part of Postcranial axial skeletal system and Skeletal system of trunk. It forms part of Wall of abdominal segment of trunk, Skeletal system of abdomen and Wall of pelvis.

FMA16581.name: pelvic girdle
FMA16581.text: Subdivision of skeletal system of lower limb, which is the proximal segment of skeletal system of lower limb and links the skeletal system of free lower limb to the trunk; it is demarcated by the plane of the surface of the acetabular fossa from the free lower limb; together with the skeletal system of free lower limb, it constitutes skeletal system of lower limb. It is a regional part of Lower limb.

FMA16582.name: right pelvic girdle
FMA16582.text: Right pelvic girdle is a pelvic girdle. It is a regional part of Right lower limb.

FMA16583.name: left pelvic girdle
FMA16583.text: Left pelvic girdle is a pelvic girdle. It is a regional part of Left lower limb.

FMA17181.name: wall of distal part of ileum
FMA17181.text: Wall of distal part of ileum is a region of wall of ileum. It is a regional part of Wall of ileum. It forms part of Distal part of ileum.

FMA20218.name: mons pubis
FMA20218.text: Mons pubis is a subdivision of pelvis. It is a regional part of Pelvis, Vulva and Female external genitalia.

FMA20224.name: right side of rib cage
FMA20224.text: Right side of rib cage is a subdivision of rib cage. It is a regional part of Rib cage.

FMA20225.name: left side of rib cage
FMA20225.text: Left side of rib cage is a subdivision of rib cage. It is a regional part of Rib cage.

FMA20226.name: right side of bony pelvis
FMA20226.text: Right side of bony pelvis is a subdivision of bony pelvis. Anatomical type — Subdivision of skeletal system: Organ system subdivision which has as its direct parts a combination of any of the following structures: skeleton, skeletal membrane organs, skeletal ligaments, bursae, skeletal cartilage organs and portions of synovial fluid.

FMA20227.name: left side of bony pelvis
FMA20227.text: Left side of bony pelvis is a subdivision of bony pelvis. Anatomical type — Subdivision of skeletal system: Organ system subdivision which has as its direct parts a combination of any of the following structures: skeleton, skeletal membrane organs, skeletal ligaments, bursae, skeletal cartilage organs and portions of synovial fluid.

FMA20347.name: anal part of perineum
FMA20347.text: Anal part of perineum is a subdivision of perineum. It is a regional part of Perineum, Male perineum and Female perineum.

FMA20394.name: human body
FMA20394.text: Human body that is fully developed and mature. Anatomical type — Human body: Anatomical structure which is the aggregate material substance of an individual member of the human species.

FMA20796.name: right deep femoral artery
FMA20796.text: Right deep femoral artery is a deep femoral artery. It branches from Trunk of right femoral artery and Right femoral artery. It is a regional part of Right femoral artery.

FMA20797.name: left deep femoral artery
FMA20797.text: Left deep femoral artery is a deep femoral artery. It branches from Left femoral artery and Trunk of left femoral artery. It is a regional part of Left femoral artery.

FMA22672.name: right thoraco-acromial artery
FMA22672.text: Right thoraco-acromial artery is a thoraco-acromial artery. It branches from Second part of right axillary artery, Right subclavian artery and Right axillary artery. It is a regional part of Right subclavian artery and Right axillary artery.

FMA22673.name: left thoraco-acromial artery
FMA22673.text: Left thoraco-acromial artery is a thoraco-acromial artery. It branches from First part of left axillary artery, Left axillary artery and Second part of left axillary artery, among other structures. It is a regional part of Left subclavian artery and Left axillary artery.

FMA23218.name: right pectoral girdle
FMA23218.text: Right pectoral girdle is a pectoral girdle. It is a regional part of Right upper limb.

FMA23219.name: left pectoral girdle
FMA23219.text: Left pectoral girdle is a pectoral girdle. It is a regional part of Left upper limb.

FMA23876.name: skeleton (in vivo)
FMA23876.text: Set of all bone organs and skeletal cartilage organs in the body. It forms part of Skeletal system.
FMA23876.note: Source anatomy: Skeleton. Model labels specify the represented side or subset.

FMA23881.name: skeletal system
FMA23881.text: Organ system subdivision, each instance of which has as its direct parts some skeleton, some maximal complement of skeletal membrane organs, skeletal ligaments, bursae, skeletal cartilage organs and portions of synovial fluid. It forms part of Musculoskeletal system.

FMA24138.name: cervical vertebral column
FMA24138.text: Cervical vertebral column is a subdivision of vertebral column. It is a regional part of Vertebral column. It forms part of Musculoskeletal system of neck and Back of neck.

FMA24163.name: skeleton of right pectoral girdle
FMA24163.text: Skeleton of right pectoral girdle is a skeleton of pectoral girdle. It forms part of Right side of pectoral girdle. It belongs to Skeleton of right upper limb.

FMA24164.name: skeleton of left pectoral girdle

ZA_C301888098.name: Posterior horn of spinal cord

HRA:VH_F_right_cardinal_ligament_of_uter.text: Mesentery, each instance of which attaches the lateral side of some vagina and cervix to some lateral pelvic wall. It forms part of Content of female pelvis and Adnexa of uterus.

FMA:14729.text: Uterovesical pouch is a subdivision of pelvic part of peritoneal cavity.

FMA:57789.text: Right round ligament of uterus is a round ligament of uterus. It forms part of Content of female pelvis.

FMA:57790.text: Left round ligament of uterus is a round ligament of uterus. It forms part of Content of female pelvis.

FMA:19119.text: Right uterosacral ligament is an uterosacral ligament. It is a regional part of Subperitoneal pelvic connective tissue, Subperitoneal connective tissue of female pelvis and Fascia of female pelvis.

FMA:19120.text: Left uterosacral ligament is an uterosacral ligament. It is a regional part of Subperitoneal pelvic connective tissue, Subperitoneal connective tissue of female pelvis and Fascia of female pelvis.

FMA:77064.name: Cardinal ligament
FMA:77064.text: Mesentery, each instance of which attaches the lateral side of some vagina and cervix to some lateral pelvic wall. It forms part of Content of female pelvis and Adnexa of uterus.

FMA:19823.name: Suspensory ligament of right ovary
FMA:19823.text: Suspensory ligament of right ovary is a suspensory ligament of ovary. It forms part of Content of female pelvis and Right adnexa of uterus.

FMA:19824.name: Suspensory ligament of left ovary
FMA:19824.text: Suspensory ligament of left ovary is a suspensory ligament of ovary. It forms part of Content of female pelvis and Left adnexa of uterus.

FMA:55423.name: Right ovarian ligament
FMA:55423.text: Right ovarian ligament is an ovarian ligament. It forms part of Content of female pelvis.

UBERON:0012332.name: broad ligament of uterus
UBERON:0012332.text: A broad fold of peritoneum that extends from the side of the uterus to the wall of the pelvis. Anatomical type — ligament: Dense regular connective tissue connecting two or more adjacent skeletal elements or supporting an organ.

FMA:19810.name: Left mesosalpinx
FMA:19810.text: Left mesosalpinx is a mesosalpinx. It is a regional part of Broad ligament of uterus. It forms part of Left adnexa of uterus.

FMA:19809.text: Right mesosalpinx is a mesosalpinx. It is a regional part of Broad ligament of uterus. It forms part of Right adnexa of uterus.

FMA:7214.name: Left ovary
FMA:7214.text: Left ovary is an ovary. It is a regional part of Female internal genitalia. It forms part of Content of female pelvis and Left adnexa of uterus. It is contained in Abdominopelvic cavity.

FMA:7213.name: Right ovary
FMA:7213.text: Right ovary is an ovary. It is a regional part of Female internal genitalia. It forms part of Right adnexa of uterus and Content of female pelvis. It is contained in Abdominopelvic cavity.

FMA:77049.name: Abdominal ostium of uterine tube
FMA:77049.text: Abdominal ostium of uterine tube is an anatomical orifice. Anatomical type — Anatomical orifice: Anatomical conduit space that connects two adjacent body spaces, surrounded by two or more subdivisions of two or more organs or organ parts.

UBERON:0009853.name: body of uterus
UBERON:0009853.text: The part of the uterus above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes. Anatomical type — reproductive structure: Any anatomical structure that is part of the reproductive system.

FMA:17561.name: Fundus of uterus
FMA:17561.text: Fundus of uterus is a zone of uterus. It is a regional part of Uterus.

FMA:17752.name: Lower uterine segment
FMA:17752.text: Lower uterine segment is a zone of body of uterus. It is a regional part of Body of uterus.

FMA:224878.name: Posterior wall of uterus
FMA:224878.text: Posterior wall of uterus is a zone of wall of uterus. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

FMA:224876.name: Anterior wall of uterus
FMA:224876.text: Anterior wall of uterus is a zone of wall of uterus. Anatomical type — Region of organ component: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component.

UBERON:0000002.name: uterine cervix
UBERON:0000002.text: Lower, narrow portion of the uterus where it joins with the top end of the vagina. Anatomical type — reproductive structure: Any anatomical structure that is part of the reproductive system.

UBERON:0013759.name: internal cervical os
UBERON:0013759.text: Opening of uterine cervix into the body of the uterus. Anatomical type — cervical os: One of two openings in the uterine cervix.

UBERON:0013760.name: external cervical os
UBERON:0013760.text: Opening of uterine cervix into the vagina. Anatomical type — cervical os: One of two openings in the uterine cervix.

UBERON:0003690.name: Sacrum
UBERON:0003690.text: A collection of sacral vertebrae in the sacral region that are fused and part of the bony pelvis. Anatomical type — abdominal segment bone: A bone that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0001350.name: Coccyx
UBERON:0001350.text: A collection of caudal vertebrae in the coccygeal region that are fused and part of the bony pelvis. Anatomical type — bone of dorsum: A bone that is part of the dorsal region of an animal.

UBERON:0001439.name: Right pubis
UBERON:0001439.text: The outer layers of solid, hard bone that covers spongy bone; consists of parallel osteons containing mineral deposits and interstitial lamellae. Anatomical type — bone tissue: Skeletal tissue with a collagen-rich extracellular matrix vascularized, mineralized with hydroxyapatite and typically including osteocytes located in lacunae that communicate with one another by cell processes (in canaliculi). Bone is deposited by osteoblasts.
